abomasnow.name: Abomasnow
abomasnow.flavor: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。 只要它摇动巨大的身体， 周围立刻会变得一片雪白。
abomasnow.flavorEn: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

abomasnowmega.name: Abomasnow-Mega
abomasnowmega.flavor: 会引发暴风雪的宝可梦。 只要它摇动巨大的身体， 周围立刻会变得一片雪白。
abomasnowmega.flavorEn: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

abra.name: Abra
abra.flavor: 能够在睡梦中使出瞬间移动。 据说它睡得越熟，就能 移动到越遥远的地方。
abra.flavorEn: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

absol.name: Absol
absol.flavor: 由于拥有感知危险的能力， 因此它被人们误解为是 会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
absol.flavorEn: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

absolmega.name: Absol-Mega
absolmega.flavor: 由于拥有感知危险的能力， 因此它被人们误解为是 会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
absolmega.flavorEn: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

absolmegaz.name: Absol-Mega-Z
absolmegaz.flavor: 由于拥有感知危险的能力， 因此它被人们误解为是 会招来灾祸的宝可梦。
absolmegaz.flavorEn: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

accelgor.name: Accelgor
accelgor.flavor: 脱壳后变得更轻巧了。 为了防止干燥，会将 带状的粘膜裹在身上。
accelgor.flavorEn: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

aegislash.name: Aegislash
aegislash.flavor: 坚盾剑怪曾经用强大的灵力 控制人和宝可梦，建立了 适合自己生活的国家。
aegislash.flavorEn: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

aegislashblade.name: Aegislash-Blade
aegislashblade.flavor: 坚盾剑怪曾经用强大的灵力 控制人和宝可梦，建立了 适合自己生活的国家。
aegislashblade.flavorEn: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

aerodactyl.name: Aerodactyl
aerodactyl.flavor: 长着锯子般的牙齿。 甚至连钢属性宝可梦的皮肤 都会被它的牙齿撕成碎片。
aerodactyl.flavorEn: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

aerodactylmega.name: Aerodactyl-Mega
aerodactylmega.flavor: 长着锯子般的牙齿。 甚至连钢属性宝可梦的皮肤 都会被它的牙齿撕成碎片。
aerodactylmega.flavorEn: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

aggron.name: Aggron
aggron.flavor: 很久以前，有位国王由于希望 像波士可多拉一样强大而戴上了 模仿它的头部制成的头盔。
aggron.flavorEn: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

aggronmega.name: Aggron-Mega
aggronmega.flavor: 很久以前，有位国王由于希望 像波士可多拉一样强大而戴上了 模仿它的头部制成的头盔。
aggronmega.flavorEn: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

aipom.name: Aipom
aipom.flavor: 会从树上寻找猎物。 发现喜食的甜竹竹后， 就会兴奋地飞扑过去。
aipom.flavorEn: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

alakazam.name: Alakazam
alakazam.flavor: 会操纵强大的超能力。 据说它双手握着的汤勺 就是用那力量制造出来的。
alakazam.flavorEn: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

alakazammega.name: Alakazam-Mega
alakazammega.flavor: 会操纵强大的超能力。 据说它双手握着的汤勺 就是用那力量制造出来的。
alakazammega.flavorEn: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

alcremie.name: Alcremie
alcremie.flavor: 当它感到幸福的时候， 手中产生出的鲜奶油 会变得更加香浓甜美。
alcremie.flavorEn: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

alcremiegmax.name: Alcremie-Gmax
alcremiegmax.flavor: 当它感到幸福的时候， 手中产生出的鲜奶油 会变得更加香浓甜美。
alcremiegmax.flavorEn: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

alomomola.name: Alomomola
alomomola.flavor: 之所以会救助体弱的宝可梦， 好像是因为盯上它们的 宝可梦也会攻击它自己。
alomomola.flavorEn: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

altaria.name: Altaria
altaria.flavor: 虽然性情温顺，但如果被惹怒， 就会用尖锐的叫声威吓对方， 并且毫不留情地发动进攻。
altaria.flavorEn: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

altariamega.name: Altaria-Mega
altariamega.flavor: 虽然性情温顺，但如果被惹怒， 就会用尖锐的叫声威吓对方， 并且毫不留情地发动进攻。
altariamega.flavorEn: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.

amaura.name: Amaura
amaura.flavor: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。 有时候它还会以冰封的 状态被发现喔。
amaura.flavorEn: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

ambipom.name: Ambipom
ambipom.flavor: 无论做什么都会用到尾巴。 如果被它的２条尾巴抱紧， 那就证明是真的和你很亲近。
ambipom.flavorEn: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

amoonguss.name: Amoonguss
amoonguss.flavor: 平常一般不太动。 只是一动不动地待在 掉落于地面的精灵球旁边。
amoonguss.flavorEn: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

ampharos.name: Ampharos
ampharos.flavor: 尾巴会发出很强的亮光。 从以前起，它就被船员们 当做路标而深受重视。
ampharos.flavorEn: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

ampharosmega.name: Ampharos-Mega
ampharosmega.flavor: 尾巴会发出很强的亮光。 从以前起，它就被船员们 当做路标而深受重视。
ampharosmega.flavorEn: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

annihilape.name: Annihilape
annihilape.flavorEn: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
annihilape.evoCondition: Use Rage Fist 20 times and level-up

anorith.name: Anorith
anorith.flavor: 会把８根翅膀当做船桨划水， 并且游泳的速度相当快。 是虫宝可梦的一种祖先。
anorith.flavorEn: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

appletun.name: Appletun
appletun.flavor: 身体被甜甜的蜜汁包裹， 背部的皮尤其甘甜， 过去曾经是小孩的零食。
appletun.flavorEn: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

appletungmax.name: Appletun-Gmax
appletungmax.flavor: 身体被甜甜的蜜汁包裹， 背部的皮尤其甘甜， 过去曾经是小孩的零食。
appletungmax.flavorEn: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

applin.name: Applin
applin.flavor: 一出生就躲进了苹果中。 一边吃果肉一边成长。 进化方向因苹果的味道而定。
applin.flavorEn: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

araquanid.name: Araquanid
araquanid.flavor: 把滴蛛放进头上的水泡里， 一边喂它吃剩的食物， 一边照顾它。
araquanid.flavorEn: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

araquanidtotem.name: Araquanid-Totem
araquanidtotem.flavor: 把滴蛛放进头上的水泡里， 一边喂它吃剩的食物， 一边照顾它。
araquanidtotem.flavorEn: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

arbok.name: Arbok
arbok.flavor: 根据研究证实，它腹部 那可怕的纹路大约有 ６个种类已经得到确认。
arbok.flavorEn: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

arboliva.name: Arboliva
arboliva.flavorEn: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

arcanine.name: Arcanine
arcanine.flavor: 从古时候起就是俘获了 众多人心的美丽宝可梦。 能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。
arcanine.flavorEn: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

arcaninehisui.name: Arcanine-Hisui
arcaninehisui.flavor: 从古时候起就是俘获了 众多人心的美丽宝可梦。 能像飞一样轻巧地奔跑。
arcaninehisui.flavorEn: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

arceus.name: Arceus
arceus.flavorEn: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

arceusbug.name: Arceus-Bug
arceusbug.flavorEn: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

arceuswater.name: Arceus-Water
arceuswater.flavorEn: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

archaludon.name: Archaludon
archaludon.flavorEn: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

archen.name: Archen
archen.flavor: 被称为鸟宝可梦的祖先。 栖息在树上，以树果和 虫宝可梦为食。
archen.flavorEn: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

archeops.name: Archeops
archeops.flavor: 虽然也会飞行， 但是似乎更擅长在 地面上捕捉猎物。
archeops.flavorEn: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

arctibax.name: Arctibax
arctibax.flavorEn: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

arctovish.name: Arctovish
arctovish.flavor: 面部的皮肤无论受到什么攻击 都不会受伤，但由于呼吸起来 不方便而灭绝了。
arctovish.flavorEn: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.

arctozolt.name: Arctozolt
arctozolt.flavor: 曾经生活在古代的海边， 能用身体的冰来保存食物， 但由于动作太迟缓而灭绝了。
arctozolt.flavorEn: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

ariados.name: Ariados
ariados.flavor: 会通过吐丝来捕捉猎物。 到了晚上，就会离开 巢穴并积极地狩猎。
ariados.flavorEn: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

armaldo.name: Armaldo
armaldo.flavor: 栖息在陆地，但也擅长游泳。 会潜入大海寻找猎物， 用锋利的爪子给予致命一击。
armaldo.flavorEn: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

armarouge.name: Armarouge
armarouge.flavorEn: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

aromatisse.name: Aromatisse
aromatisse.flavor: 会发出恶臭让敌人丧失战意， 或者发出芳香的味道 来帮助自己的伙伴。
aromatisse.flavorEn: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

aron.name: Aron
aron.flavor: 进化的时候，钢铁盔甲会 全部脱落。人们曾经 将其捡来活用于生活。
aron.flavorEn: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

arrokuda.name: Arrokuda
arrokuda.flavor: 吃饱了之后动作会变得 极度迟缓，于是就被 古月鸟整只吞了下去。
arrokuda.flavorEn: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

articuno.name: Articuno
articuno.flavor: 拥有能够自由操纵冰 的能力。据说它栖息在 永久冻土的雪山。
articuno.flavorEn: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

articunogalar.name: Articuno-Galar
articunogalar.flavor: 拥有能够自由操纵冰 的能力。据说它栖息在 永久冻土的雪山。
articunogalar.flavorEn: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

audino.name: Audino
audino.flavor: 心地善良的宝可梦。 通过触角接触，就能了解 对方的心情和身体状况。
audino.flavorEn: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

audinomega.name: Audino-Mega
audinomega.flavor: 心地善良的宝可梦。 通过触角接触，就能了解 对方的心情和身体状况。
audinomega.flavorEn: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

aurorus.name: Aurorus
aurorus.flavor: 当它被激怒时， 就会喷出猛烈的冷气， 把周围都冰封起来。
aurorus.flavorEn: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

avalugg.name: Avalugg
avalugg.flavor: 虽然身体的裂缝会因 白天的活动而变大， 但只要一晚就能全部长好。
avalugg.flavorEn: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

avalugghisui.name: Avalugg-Hisui
avalugghisui.flavor: 虽然身体的裂缝会因 白天的活动而变大， 但只要一晚就能全部长好。
avalugghisui.flavorEn: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

axew.name: Axew
axew.flavor: 会和伙伴们一起互撞牙齿来玩。 折断的牙齿会马上长出来， 所以丝毫都不会去在意。
axew.flavorEn: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

azelf.name: Azelf
azelf.flavorEn: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

azumarill.name: Azumarill
azumarill.flavor: 会制作填满空气的泡泡。 当露力丽在河里玩的时候， 它就会用这个泡泡包住露力丽。
azumarill.flavorEn: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.

azurill.name: Azurill
azurill.flavor: 虽然是种性情温顺的宝可梦， 但生起气来，便会嗖嗖地挥舞起 尾巴上的大球来猛烈击打对手。
azurill.flavorEn: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.

bagon.name: Bagon
bagon.flavor: 不会成群结队，喜欢单独生活。 脑袋很硬，只要猛地一撞， 就能把坚硬的岩石一分为二。
bagon.flavorEn: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.

baltoy.name: Baltoy
baltoy.flavor: 在古代遗迹被发现。 会一边旋转一边移动。 晚上睡觉的时候也是单脚站着。
baltoy.flavorEn: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

banette.name: Banette
banette.flavor: 因被丢弃的怨念而诞生。 听说，如果满足它受重视的需求， 就会变回原来的玩偶。
banette.flavorEn: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

banettemega.name: Banette-Mega
banettemega.flavor: 因被丢弃的怨念而诞生。 听说，如果满足它受重视的需求， 就会变回原来的玩偶。
banettemega.flavorEn: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

barbaracle.name: Barbaracle
barbaracle.flavor: 用手掌上的眼珠来观察 前后左右的状况。遇上危机时 手脚会自己动起来打倒对手。
barbaracle.flavorEn: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

barbaraclemega.name: Barbaracle-Mega
barbaraclemega.flavor: 用手掌上的眼珠来观察 前后左右的状况。遇上危机时 手脚会自己动起来打倒对手。
barbaraclemega.flavorEn: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

barboach.name: Barboach
barboach.flavor: 会用２根长长的胡须 探索浑浊的河底。 用湿滑的粘膜保护着身体。
barboach.flavorEn: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

barraskewda.name: Barraskewda
barraskewda.flavor: 会旋转着自己的尾鳍 一口气突击。能够以超过 １００节的速度贯穿猎物。
barraskewda.flavorEn: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

basculegion.name: Basculegion
basculegion.flavorEn: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

basculegionf.name: Basculegion-F
basculegionf.flavorEn: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

basculin.name: Basculin
basculin.flavor: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。 红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高， 适合年轻人食用。
basculin.flavorEn: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

basculinbluestriped.name: Basculin-Blue-Striped
basculinbluestriped.flavor: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。 红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高， 适合年轻人食用。
basculinbluestriped.flavorEn: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

basculinwhitestriped.name: Basculin-White-Striped
basculinwhitestriped.flavor: 从前也曾经登上餐桌。 红条纹野蛮鲈鱼的肉脂肪含量高， 适合年轻人食用。
basculinwhitestriped.flavorEn: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

bastiodon.name: Bastiodon
bastiodon.flavor: 大约１亿年前的宝可梦。 极其结实的脸有着超越钢铁的硬度。
bastiodon.flavorEn: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

baxcalibur.name: Baxcalibur
baxcalibur.flavorEn: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

baxcaliburmega.name: Baxcalibur-Mega
baxcaliburmega.flavorEn: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

bayleef.name: Bayleef
bayleef.flavorEn: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

beartic.name: Beartic
beartic.flavor: 在冰冷的大海里精力十足地游泳。 感到疲劳的时候会吐出气息 冻结海水，在冰面上休息。
beartic.flavorEn: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

beautifly.name: Beautifly
beautifly.flavorEn: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

beedrill.name: Beedrill
beedrill.flavor: 它会用双手和 尾部的３根毒针 反复刺伤敌人。
beedrill.flavorEn: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

beedrillmega.name: Beedrill-Mega
beedrillmega.flavor: 它会用双手和 尾部的３根毒针 反复刺伤敌人。
beedrillmega.flavorEn: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

beheeyem.name: Beheeyem
beheeyem.flavor: 能控制对方的记忆。 经常有人看到它 在麦田的上方徘徊。
beheeyem.flavorEn: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

beldum.name: Beldum
beldum.flavor: 身体的细胞由磁铁构成。 循环于全身的不是血液， 而是磁力。
beldum.flavorEn: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

bellibolt.name: Bellibolt
bellibolt.flavorEn: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

bellossom.name: Bellossom
bellossom.flavor: 有时能看到美丽花聚在一起 做着像是跳舞一样的动作。 据说这是呼唤太阳的仪式。
bellossom.flavorEn: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

bellsprout.name: Bellsprout
bellsprout.flavor: 喜欢温度高，有一定 湿度的地方。它会用 身上的藤蔓抓小虫来吃。
bellsprout.flavorEn: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

bergmite.name: Bergmite
bergmite.flavor: 栖息在极其寒冷的地域。 会把自己的脚冻在 冰岩怪的背上固定起来。
bergmite.flavorEn: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

bewear.name: Bewear
bewear.flavor: 会用令格斗家都无地自容的技术 把逮住的猎物夹在腋下， 带回自己的住处。
bewear.flavorEn: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

bibarel.name: Bibarel
bibarel.flavorEn: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

bidoof.name: Bidoof
bidoof.flavorEn: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

binacle.name: Binacle
binacle.flavor: 如果２只龟脚脚配合得不好， 不但无法有效地攻击和防御， 甚至没办法生存下去。
binacle.flavorEn: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

bisharp.name: Bisharp
bisharp.flavor: 为了抢占能找到磨刀石 的地方，和斧牙龙展开了 激烈的斗争。
bisharp.flavorEn: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

blacephalon.name: Blacephalon
blacephalon.flavor: 从究极之洞里出现的究极异兽。 用爆炸吓唬对手， 趁那空当夺走对方的生命气息。
blacephalon.flavorEn: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

blastoise.name: Blastoise
blastoise.flavor: 从龟壳上的大炮里 放出的喷射水流 足以贯穿厚实的铁板。
blastoise.flavorEn: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

blastoisegmax.name: Blastoise-Gmax
blastoisegmax.flavor: 从龟壳上的大炮里 放出的喷射水流 足以贯穿厚实的铁板。
blastoisegmax.flavorEn: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

blastoisemega.name: Blastoise-Mega
blastoisemega.flavor: 从龟壳上的大炮里 放出的喷射水流 足以贯穿厚实的铁板。
blastoisemega.flavorEn: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

blaziken.name: Blaziken
blaziken.flavorEn: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

blazikenmega.name: Blaziken-Mega
blazikenmega.flavorEn: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

blipbug.name: Blipbug
blipbug.flavor: 经常出现在田地里的宝可梦。 会通过长在身体上的毛 来感应周围发生的事。
blipbug.flavorEn: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

blissey.name: Blissey
blissey.flavor: 会生下装满幸福的奇妙之蛋。 据说，吃下它的蛋的人， 能够对所有人都温柔相待。
blissey.flavorEn: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

blitzle.name: Blitzle
blitzle.flavorEn: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

boldore.name: Boldore
boldore.flavor: 通过声音来探测四周。 要是惹它生气了，它会连 身体方向也不转就朝你追来。
boldore.flavorEn: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

boltund.name: Boltund
boltund.flavor: 电力增强了它的脚力。 当以最高速度奔跑时， 时速可以轻易超过９０公里。
boltund.flavorEn: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

bombirdier.name: Bombirdier
bombirdier.flavorEn: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

bonsly.name: Bonsly
bonsly.flavor: 栖息在空气干燥岩石裸露的地方。 空气越是干燥，它身上的绿球 就越是会泛出暗淡的光泽。
bonsly.flavorEn: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

bouffalant.name: Bouffalant
bouffalant.flavor: 会以约２０只的规模群居。 不知为何，背叛了族群的 爆炸头水牛脑袋上的毛会脱落。
bouffalant.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

bounsweet.name: Bounsweet
bounsweet.flavor: 受到袭击时流下的汗水 非常甜美可口。那种香气 会吸引更多敌人的注意。
bounsweet.flavorEn: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

braixen.name: Braixen
braixen.flavorEn: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

brambleghast.name: Brambleghast
brambleghast.flavorEn: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

bramblin.name: Bramblin
bramblin.flavorEn: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

braviary.name: Braviary
braviary.flavor: 性格粗暴、血气方刚， 因此被钢铠鸦夺走了 伽勒尔运送员的地位。
braviary.flavorEn: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

braviaryhisui.name: Braviary-Hisui
braviaryhisui.flavor: 性格粗暴、血气方刚， 因此被钢铠鸦夺走了 伽勒尔运送员的地位。
braviaryhisui.flavorEn: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

breloom.name: Breloom
breloom.flavorEn: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.

brionne.name: Brionne
brionne.flavor: 到了风平浪静的夜晚， 会配合领队西狮海壬的歌声 和伙伴们一起跳舞。
brionne.flavorEn: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

bronzong.name: Bronzong
bronzong.flavor: 它身上的纹路让 许多学者都认为它 原本并不存在于伽勒尔。
bronzong.flavorEn: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

bronzor.name: Bronzor
bronzor.flavor: 虽然人们说把铜镜怪打磨到发光， 它就能映照出真相， 但其实它非常讨厌被打磨。
bronzor.flavorEn: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

brutebonnet.name: Brute Bonnet
brutebonnet.flavorEn: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

bruxish.name: Bruxish
bruxish.flavor: 厚实的皮肤连好坏星的针 也穿不透。会用结实的牙齿 嘎嘣嘎嘣地咬碎针吃下去。
bruxish.flavorEn: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

budew.name: Budew
budew.flavor: 对气温的变化很敏感。 当它开始打开花苞， 便是冬去春来之时。
budew.flavorEn: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

buizel.name: Buizel
buizel.flavorEn: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

bulbasaur.name: Bulbasaur
bulbasaur.flavor: 在出生后的一段时间内， 它会吸收背上种子里 储存着的营养成长。
bulbasaur.flavorEn: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

buneary.name: Buneary
buneary.flavor: 会利用把卷卷的耳朵伸直 时产生的威力进行攻击。 越训练，这一招式的威力就越强。
buneary.flavorEn: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

bunnelby.name: Bunnelby
bunnelby.flavor: 对危险很敏感。只要听到 钢铠鸦拍打翅膀的声音， 就会马上挖洞钻进地下藏身。
bunnelby.flavorEn: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

burmy.name: Burmy
burmy.flavorEn: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

butterfree.name: Butterfree
butterfree.flavor: 每天都忙着采集花蜜。 习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜， 然后带回巢穴里。
butterfree.flavorEn: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

butterfreegmax.name: Butterfree-Gmax
butterfreegmax.flavor: 每天都忙着采集花蜜。 习惯往腿部的细毛上涂满花蜜， 然后带回巢穴里。
butterfreegmax.flavorEn: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

buzzwole.name: Buzzwole
buzzwole.flavor: 会炫耀膨胀到异常程度的肌肉。 是究极异兽中的一种。
buzzwole.flavorEn: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

cacnea.name: Cacnea
cacnea.flavorEn: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

cacturne.name: Cacturne
cacturne.flavorEn: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.

calyrex.name: Calyrex
calyrex.flavor: 曾经在很久以前统治着 伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有 治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
calyrex.flavorEn: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

calyrexice.name: Calyrex-Ice
calyrexice.flavor: 曾经在很久以前统治着 伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有 治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
calyrexice.flavorEn: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

calyrexshadow.name: Calyrex-Shadow
calyrexshadow.flavor: 曾经在很久以前统治着 伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有 治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。
calyrexshadow.flavorEn: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

camerupt.name: Camerupt
camerupt.flavorEn: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

cameruptmega.name: Camerupt-Mega
cameruptmega.flavorEn: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.

capsakid.name: Capsakid
capsakid.flavorEn: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

carbink.name: Carbink
carbink.flavor: 据说在世界上的某处，有个 沉睡着许多小碎钻的矿脉， 它们的女王也在那里。
carbink.flavorEn: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

carkol.name: Carkol
carkol.flavor: 能通过高速旋转自己的脚， 以３０公里的时速奔跑。 能喷出１０００度的火焰。
carkol.flavorEn: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

carnivine.name: Carnivine
carnivine.flavorEn: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

carracosta.name: Carracosta
carracosta.flavor: 虽然和在水中相比动作 会变得迟缓，但是为了寻找 猎物也会登上陆地活动。
carracosta.flavorEn: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

carvanha.name: Carvanha
carvanha.flavor: 拥有锋利的牙齿和 结实的下颚。水手们绝不会 主动靠近利牙鱼的栖息地。
carvanha.flavorEn: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cascoon.name: Cascoon
cascoon.flavorEn: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

castform.name: Castform
castform.flavor: 样子会根据天气发生变化。 天气越恶劣， 性格也会变得越暴躁。
castform.flavorEn: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

castformrainy.name: Castform-Rainy
castformrainy.flavor: 样子会根据天气发生变化。 天气越恶劣， 性格也会变得越暴躁。
castformrainy.flavorEn: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

castformsnowy.name: Castform-Snowy
castformsnowy.flavor: 样子会根据天气发生变化。 天气越恶劣， 性格也会变得越暴躁。
castformsnowy.flavorEn: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

castformsunny.name: Castform-Sunny
castformsunny.flavor: 样子会根据天气发生变化。 天气越恶劣， 性格也会变得越暴躁。
castformsunny.flavorEn: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!

caterpie.name: Caterpie
caterpie.flavor: 别看它的脚很短， 因为是吸盘，所以无论是 斜坡还是墙壁都能轻松前进。
caterpie.flavorEn: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

celebi.name: Celebi
celebi.flavor: 从未来穿越时光而来。 能够治愈伤痛， 也会把自己的力量分给草木。
celebi.flavorEn: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

celesteela.name: Celesteela
celesteela.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险， 但在它原本栖息的世界， 好像只是寻常能见的生物。
celesteela.flavorEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

centiskorch.name: Centiskorch
centiskorch.flavor: 性格极具攻击性。 危险的不只是它烧烫的身体， 大大的獠牙也锐利无比。
centiskorch.flavorEn: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

centiskorchgmax.name: Centiskorch-Gmax
centiskorchgmax.flavor: 性格极具攻击性。 危险的不只是它烧烫的身体， 大大的獠牙也锐利无比。
centiskorchgmax.flavorEn: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

ceruledge.name: Ceruledge
ceruledge.flavorEn: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

cetitan.name: Cetitan
cetitan.flavorEn: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

cetoddle.name: Cetoddle
cetoddle.flavorEn: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

chandelure.name: Chandelure
chandelure.flavor: 据说在用水晶灯火灵 来充当照明设备的房子里， 丧事会接连不断。
chandelure.flavorEn: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

chandeluremega.name: Chandelure-Mega
chandeluremega.flavor: 据说在用水晶灯火灵 来充当照明设备的房子里， 丧事会接连不断。
chandeluremega.flavorEn: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

chansey.name: Chansey
chansey.flavor: 原本动作迟缓。 为了保护蛋不被抢走， 逃跑的速度才变快了。
chansey.flavorEn: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

charcadet.name: Charcadet
charcadet.flavorEn: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

charizard.name: Charizard
charizard.flavor: 能用翅膀飞到距地面 １４００米的高度。 会吐出高温火焰。
charizard.flavorEn: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

charizardgmax.name: Charizard-Gmax
charizardgmax.flavor: 能用翅膀飞到距地面 １４００米的高度。 会吐出高温火焰。
charizardgmax.flavorEn: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

charizardmegax.name: Charizard-Mega-X
charizardmegax.flavor: 能用翅膀飞到距地面 １４００米的高度。 会吐出高温火焰。
charizardmegax.flavorEn: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

charizardmegay.name: Charizard-Mega-Y
charizardmegay.flavor: 能用翅膀飞到距地面 １４００米的高度。 会吐出高温火焰。
charizardmegay.flavorEn: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

charjabug.name: Charjabug
charjabug.flavor: 虫电宝消化吃掉的落叶时 会产生电能。它会把这些电能 储存在自己肚子上的电囊中。
charjabug.flavorEn: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

charmander.name: Charmander
charmander.flavor: 生下来的时候， 尾巴上就有火焰在燃烧。 火焰熄灭时，它的生命也会结束。
charmander.flavorEn: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

charmeleon.name: Charmeleon
charmeleon.flavor: 如果它在战斗中亢奋起来， 就会喷出灼热的火焰， 把周围的东西烧得一干二净。
charmeleon.flavorEn: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

chatot.name: Chatot
chatot.flavorEn: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

cherrim.name: Cherrim
cherrim.flavor: 盖起来的花瓣很硬。 即使被鸟宝可梦啄到， 也完全没问题。
cherrim.flavorEn: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

cherrimsunshine.name: Cherrim-Sunshine
cherrimsunshine.flavor: 盖起来的花瓣很硬。 即使被鸟宝可梦啄到， 也完全没问题。
cherrimsunshine.flavorEn: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

cherubi.name: Cherubi
cherubi.flavor: 身体越红的樱花宝 含有的营养越丰富， 味道也很甜很好吃。
cherubi.flavorEn: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

chesnaught.name: Chesnaught
chesnaught.flavorEn: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

chesnaughtmega.name: Chesnaught-Mega
chesnaughtmega.flavorEn: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

chespin.name: Chespin
chespin.flavorEn: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

chewtle.name: Chewtle
chewtle.flavor: 会用头上硬如岩石的角攻击敌人。 趁其不备之时大口咬住对方， 一旦咬住便再也不会松口。
chewtle.flavorEn: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

chienpao.name: Chien-Pao
chienpao.flavorEn: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

chikorita.name: Chikorita
chikorita.flavorEn: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

chimchar.name: Chimchar
chimchar.flavorEn: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

chimecho.name: Chimecho
chimecho.flavorEn: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

chimechomega.name: Chimecho-Mega
chimechomega.flavorEn: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

chinchou.name: Chinchou
chinchou.flavor: 在黑暗的海底， 触手上不断闪烁着的光 是它们唯一的通信手段。
chinchou.flavorEn: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

chingling.name: Chingling
chingling.flavorEn: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

chiyu.name: Chi-Yu
chiyu.flavorEn: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

cinccino.name: Cinccino
cinccino.flavor: 覆盖着特别油脂的毛发 可以挡住攻击。这种油 以高价在市场上流通。
cinccino.flavorEn: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

cinderace.name: Cinderace
cinderace.flavor: 拥有熟练的进攻和防守技巧。 只要得到声援就会更有冲劲， 但有时会为了出风头而弄巧成拙。
cinderace.flavorEn: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cinderacegmax.name: Cinderace-Gmax
cinderacegmax.flavor: 拥有熟练的进攻和防守技巧。 只要得到声援就会更有冲劲， 但有时会为了出风头而弄巧成拙。
cinderacegmax.flavorEn: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

clamperl.name: Clamperl
clamperl.flavor: 珍珠贝的珍珠非常贵重。 据说，其价值或许是 大舌贝珍珠的１０倍以上。
clamperl.flavorEn: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.

clauncher.name: Clauncher
clauncher.flavor: 通过引爆积蓄在右臂钳子中的 气体，像发射子弹般 将水喷射出去，击倒敌人。
clauncher.flavorEn: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

clawitzer.name: Clawitzer
clawitzer.flavor: 右臂是能够喷射 海水炮弹的大炮。 威力大到足以击沉油轮。
clawitzer.flavorEn: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

claydol.name: Claydol
claydol.flavor: 似乎是从古代人做的 泥偶诞生而来的宝可梦。 能靠念力浮在空中移动。
claydol.flavorEn: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

clefable.name: Clefable
clefable.flavor: 听觉灵敏，连１公里以外 针落地的声音都听得见， 因此平时会待在安静的地方。
clefable.flavorEn: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

clefablemega.name: Clefable-Mega
clefablemega.flavor: 听觉灵敏，连１公里以外 针落地的声音都听得见， 因此平时会待在安静的地方。
clefablemega.flavorEn: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

clefairy.name: Clefairy
clefairy.flavor: 因可爱的举止和叫声 而广受欢迎的宝可梦。 不过很少被人发现。
clefairy.flavorEn: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

cleffa.name: Cleffa
cleffa.flavor: 有着星星一样的轮廓。 由于那外形，人们相信 它是乘着流星而来的。
cleffa.flavorEn: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

clobbopus.name: Clobbopus
clobbopus.flavor: 智商大致相当于３岁的儿童。 虽然触手经常断掉，但因为 能再生，所以它并不在意。
clobbopus.flavorEn: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

clodsire.name: Clodsire
clodsire.flavorEn: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

cloyster.name: Cloyster
cloyster.flavor: 一旦它把壳闭上， 无论是拥有什么样怪力的人 都无法将其打开。
cloyster.flavorEn: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

coalossal.name: Coalossal
coalossal.flavor: 进入战斗状态后， 它会把煤炭山燃烧得通红， 飞撒火花来烧焦四周。
coalossal.flavorEn: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

coalossalgmax.name: Coalossal-Gmax
coalossalgmax.flavor: 进入战斗状态后， 它会把煤炭山燃烧得通红， 飞撒火花来烧焦四周。
coalossalgmax.flavorEn: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

cobalion.name: Cobalion
cobalion.flavor: 生来就具有领导风范。 即使是性格狂暴的宝可梦， 在勾帕路翁面前也会变得温顺。
cobalion.flavorEn: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

cofagrigus.name: Cofagrigus
cofagrigus.flavor: 迭失棺象征着国王的财富， 因此许多古墓里 都有它的壁画。
cofagrigus.flavorEn: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

combee.name: Combee
combee.flavor: 从早到晚都在采集花蜜。 这一切都是为了 自己的族群和蜂女王。
combee.flavorEn: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

combusken.name: Combusken
combusken.flavorEn: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

comfey.name: Comfey
comfey.flavor: 散发着迷人香气的宝可梦。 由于每只花疗环环身上的花都 不一样，所以香味也各不相同。
comfey.flavorEn: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

conkeldurr.name: Conkeldurr
conkeldurr.flavor: 要是认真起来就会 扔掉手中的混凝土柱， 赤手空拳地扑向敌人。
conkeldurr.flavorEn: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

copperajah.name: Copperajah
copperajah.flavor: 群居的宝可梦。 鼻子的握力十分强劲， 甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。
copperajah.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

copperajahgmax.name: Copperajah-Gmax
copperajahgmax.flavor: 群居的宝可梦。 鼻子的握力十分强劲， 甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。
copperajahgmax.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.

corphish.name: Corphish
corphish.flavor: 来自于外国的宝可梦， 现在已经回归了野生环境。 不管多么污浊的河水都能适应。
corphish.flavorEn: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

corsola.name: Corsola
corsola.flavor: 在温暖的大海里生活。 也曾经大量栖息于 上古时期的伽勒尔近海。
corsola.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

corsolagalar.name: Corsola-Galar
corsolagalar.flavor: 在温暖的大海里生活。 也曾经大量栖息于 上古时期的伽勒尔近海。
corsolagalar.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

corviknight.name: Corviknight
corviknight.flavor: 拥有优秀飞行能力和极度 聪明头脑的它在伽勒尔地区 从事飞翔出租车的工作。
corviknight.flavorEn: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

corviknightgmax.name: Corviknight-Gmax
corviknightgmax.flavor: 拥有优秀飞行能力和极度 聪明头脑的它在伽勒尔地区 从事飞翔出租车的工作。
corviknightgmax.flavorEn: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

corvisquire.name: Corvisquire
corvisquire.flavor: 经历无数次艰难的战斗后， 它学会了该如何正确地 判断敌人的力量。
corvisquire.flavorEn: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

cosmoem.name: Cosmoem
cosmoem.flavor: 以惊人的气势吸入 大气中的尘埃，努力用 内核制造着进化的能源。
cosmoem.flavorEn: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

cosmog.name: Cosmog
cosmog.flavor: 没有警戒心且好奇心强， 所以经常会遇到麻烦。 危急时会用瞬间移动来逃跑。
cosmog.flavorEn: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

cottonee.name: Cottonee
cottonee.flavor: 将木棉球和白蓬蓬的棉花 混合后编织出的布料极其精致， 因此常被高级品牌选用。
cottonee.flavorEn: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

crabominable.name: Crabominable
crabominable.flavor: 比起思考，会先试着打打看。 曾经有过用拳头猛攻 打退雪崩的记录。
crabominable.flavorEn: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

crabominablemega.name: Crabominable-Mega
crabominablemega.flavor: 比起思考，会先试着打打看。 曾经有过用拳头猛攻 打退雪崩的记录。
crabominablemega.flavorEn: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

crabrawler.name: Crabrawler
crabrawler.flavor: 有时会把椰蛋树错认为椰子树 而爬上去。惹怒椰蛋树后 被抖落下来，并遭到踩踏。
crabrawler.flavorEn: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

cradily.name: Cradily
cradily.flavor: 用触手将猎物缠住后， 会用消化液将其溶化， 然后吸收其中的养分。
cradily.flavorEn: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

cramorant.name: Cramorant
cramorant.flavor: 非常贪吃，会把刺梭鱼整只 吞进嘴里。偶尔也会搞错对象 去咬其他的宝可梦。
cramorant.flavorEn: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

cramorantgorging.name: Cramorant-Gorging
cramorantgorging.flavor: 非常贪吃，会把刺梭鱼整只 吞进嘴里。偶尔也会搞错对象 去咬其他的宝可梦。
cramorantgorging.flavorEn: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

cramorantgulping.name: Cramorant-Gulping
cramorantgulping.flavor: 非常贪吃，会把刺梭鱼整只 吞进嘴里。偶尔也会搞错对象 去咬其他的宝可梦。
cramorantgulping.flavorEn: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

cranidos.name: Cranidos
cranidos.flavor: 坚硬的头盖骨是其特征。 会用头锤撞断树木， 吃树上结的树果。
cranidos.flavorEn: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

crawdaunt.name: Crawdaunt
crawdaunt.flavor: 有着热爱战斗的性格。 当遇到靠近自己领地的对手， 会毫不留情地将之打倒。
crawdaunt.flavorEn: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

cresselia.name: Cresselia
cresselia.flavorEn: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

croagunk.name: Croagunk
croagunk.flavor: 毒素在稀释后能制成药品。 它是制药公司的吉祥物， 广受众人的欢迎。
croagunk.flavorEn: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

crobat.name: Crobat
crobat.flavor: 可以自由地控制４根翅膀 振翅而飞。即使在狭窄的 洞窟内也能保持速度飞来飞去。
crobat.flavorEn: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

crocalor.name: Crocalor
crocalor.flavorEn: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

croconaw.name: Croconaw
croconaw.flavorEn: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

crustle.name: Crustle
crustle.flavor: 厚实的钳子是它最大的武器。 硬度高到甚至能让 超甲狂犀的护具裂开。
crustle.flavorEn: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

cryogonal.name: Cryogonal
cryogonal.flavor: 天气一热就会化为水蒸气。 到了夏天几乎到处都 看不到它的踪影。
cryogonal.flavorEn: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

cubchoo.name: Cubchoo
cubchoo.flavor: 使出招式前会先倒吸鼻涕。 鼻涕里所含有的强烈冷气 是冰属性招式的能量来源。
cubchoo.flavorEn: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

cubone.name: Cubone
cubone.flavor: 它头上戴着死去母亲的头骨。 虽然也会因悲伤的梦境而哭泣， 但每流一次泪，都会变得更加坚强。
cubone.flavorEn: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

cufant.name: Cufant
cufant.flavor: 擅长需要力气的工作。 铜质的身体会因雨水而生锈， 转变成鲜艳的绿色。
cufant.flavorEn: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.

cursola.name: Cursola
cursola.flavor: 一定要小心它那包覆着 灵魂的灵体。如果触摸到， 就会像石头一样动弹不得。
cursola.flavorEn: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

cutiefly.name: Cutiefly
cutiefly.flavor: 从敌人散发出的气场 来判断对方下一步的行动。 能轻盈地躲开攻击并进行反击。
cutiefly.flavorEn: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

cyclizar.name: Cyclizar
cyclizar.flavorEn: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

cyndaquil.name: Cyndaquil
cyndaquil.flavorEn: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

dachsbun.name: Dachsbun
dachsbun.flavorEn: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

darkrai.name: Darkrai
darkrai.flavorEn: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

darkraimega.name: Darkrai-Mega
darkraimega.flavorEn: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

darmanitan.name: Darmanitan
darmanitan.flavor: 体内的火焰燃得越旺， 力量就越大。火焰的温度 有时甚至能超过１４００度。
darmanitan.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

darmanitangalar.name: Darmanitan-Galar
darmanitangalar.flavor: 体内的火焰燃得越旺， 力量就越大。火焰的温度 有时甚至能超过１４００度。
darmanitangalar.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

darmanitangalarzen.name: Darmanitan-Galar-Zen
darmanitangalarzen.flavor: 体内的火焰燃得越旺， 力量就越大。火焰的温度 有时甚至能超过１４００度。
darmanitangalarzen.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

darmanitanzen.name: Darmanitan-Zen
darmanitanzen.flavor: 体内的火焰燃得越旺， 力量就越大。火焰的温度 有时甚至能超过１４００度。
darmanitanzen.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

dartrix.name: Dartrix
dartrix.flavor: 对整理翅膀丝毫不会怠慢。 这不单是因为它注重形象， 也是为了让刃羽保持锐利。
dartrix.flavorEn: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

darumaka.name: Darumaka
darumaka.flavor: 在它睡觉的时候， 无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。 因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。
darumaka.flavorEn: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

darumakagalar.name: Darumaka-Galar
darumakagalar.flavor: 在它睡觉的时候， 无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。 因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。
darumakagalar.flavorEn: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

decidueye.name: Decidueye
decidueye.flavor: 只要０.１秒就可以在翅膀的 藤蔓上搭好箭羽、射向敌人， 并在敌人发现前贯穿其要害。
decidueye.flavorEn: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

decidueyehisui.name: Decidueye-Hisui
decidueyehisui.flavor: 只要０.１秒就可以在翅膀的 藤蔓上搭好箭羽、射向敌人， 并在敌人发现前贯穿其要害。
decidueyehisui.flavorEn: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

dedenne.name: Dedenne
dedenne.flavor: 由于发电的能力弱， 会从插座或其他的 电气宝可梦那里偷电。
dedenne.flavorEn: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

deerling.name: Deerling
deerling.flavorEn: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

deino.name: Deino
deino.flavor: 因为眼睛看不见， 所以会又撞又咬， 来判断四周的状况。
deino.flavorEn: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

delcatty.name: Delcatty
delcatty.flavorEn: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.

delibird.name: Delibird
delibird.flavor: 因为有跟人类及宝可梦 分享自己食物的习性， 所以一直都在到处寻找食物。
delibird.flavorEn: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.

delphox.name: Delphox
delphox.flavorEn: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

delphoxmega.name: Delphox-Mega
delphoxmega.flavorEn: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

deoxys.name: Deoxys
deoxys.flavorEn: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

deoxysattack.name: Deoxys-Attack
deoxysattack.flavorEn: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

deoxysdefense.name: Deoxys-Defense
deoxysdefense.flavorEn: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

deoxysspeed.name: Deoxys-Speed
deoxysspeed.flavorEn: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.

dewgong.name: Dewgong
dewgong.flavor: 全身像雪一样白。十分耐寒， 即使是在有浮冰的大海里 也能很精神地游来游去。
dewgong.flavorEn: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

dewott.name: Dewott
dewott.flavorEn: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

dewpider.name: Dewpider
dewpider.flavor: 平时生活在水中， 也会戴上水泡去 陆地上寻找食物。
dewpider.flavorEn: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

dhelmise.name: Dhelmise
dhelmise.flavor: 把锚抛到海里，伏击猎物。 会去捕捉巨大的吼鲸王， 吸取它们的精气。
dhelmise.flavorEn: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

dialga.name: Dialga
dialga.flavorEn: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

dialgaorigin.name: Dialga-Origin
dialgaorigin.flavorEn: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

diancie.name: Diancie
diancie.flavorEn: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

dianciemega.name: Diancie-Mega
dianciemega.flavorEn: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

diggersby.name: Diggersby
diggersby.flavor: 肚子上的体毛保温性能优秀。 在过去，人们会用它的落毛 来制作保暖服装。
diggersby.flavorEn: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

diglett.name: Diglett
diglett.flavor: 在地下较浅的地方移动。 被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来， 所以非常容易发现。
diglett.flavorEn: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

diglettalola.name: Diglett-Alola
diglettalola.flavor: 在地下较浅的地方移动。 被它挖掘过的地面会鼓起来， 所以非常容易发现。
diglettalola.flavorEn: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

dipplin.name: Dipplin
dipplin.flavorEn: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

ditto.name: Ditto
ditto.flavor: 当两只百变怪相遇的时候， 为了能变成和对方相同的样子， 它们动起来会比平常更加剧烈。
ditto.flavorEn: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

dodrio.name: Dodrio
dodrio.flavor: 由嘟嘟的某个头分裂 出的变种。以60千米的 时速在草原上奔跑。
dodrio.flavorEn: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

doduo.name: Doduo
doduo.flavor: 羽毛较短所以不擅长飞行， 但是拥有发达的双脚， 能够以很快的速度奔跑。
doduo.flavorEn: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

dolliv.name: Dolliv
dolliv.flavorEn: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

dondozo.name: Dondozo
dondozo.flavorEn: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

donphan.name: Donphan
donphan.flavorEn: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.

dottler.name: Dottler
dottler.flavor: 正在壳里成长着。 用精神力量掌握外界的 状况，做好进化的准备。
dottler.flavorEn: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

doublade.name: Doublade
doublade.flavor: ２把剑会用令人眼花缭乱的 速度不断交替攻击和防御， 借以制服猎物。
doublade.flavorEn: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

dracovish.name: Dracovish
dracovish.flavor: 虽然能用自豪的脚力 以６０公里的时速奔跑， 但是只能在水中呼吸。
dracovish.flavorEn: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

dracozolt.name: Dracozolt
dracozolt.flavor: 会用尾部结实的肌肉 发电。与下半身相比， 上半身真的太小了。
dracozolt.flavorEn: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.

dragalge.name: Dragalge
dragalge.flavor: 会通过将头上的伞状部分 伸出海面吸收阳光的方式， 在体内制造龙之能量。
dragalge.flavorEn: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

dragalgemega.name: Dragalge-Mega
dragalgemega.flavor: 会通过将头上的伞状部分 伸出海面吸收阳光的方式， 在体内制造龙之能量。
dragalgemega.flavorEn: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

dragapult.name: Dragapult
dragapult.flavor: 它角里的多龙梅西亚 似乎满心期待着能被 以音速发射出去。
dragapult.flavorEn: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

dragonair.name: Dragonair
dragonair.flavor: 把力量集中在尾巴的 珠子上操纵天气。 散发气场的样子非常神秘。
dragonair.flavorEn: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

dragonite.name: Dragonite
dragonite.flavor: 被称为大海的化身。 很多船都会把快龙的 雕像设置在船头。
dragonite.flavorEn: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

dragonitemega.name: Dragonite-Mega
dragonitemega.flavor: 被称为大海的化身。 很多船都会把快龙的 雕像设置在船头。
dragonitemega.flavorEn: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

drakloak.name: Drakloak
drakloak.flavor: 要是没让自己在照顾的多龙梅西亚 乘在头上就静不下心来，甚至会 因此试图把别的宝可梦放到头上。
drakloak.flavorEn: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

drampa.name: Drampa
drampa.flavor: 心地善良爱亲近人， 但只要生气就会 刮起强风吹倒一切。
drampa.flavorEn: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

drampamega.name: Drampa-Mega
drampamega.flavor: 心地善良爱亲近人， 但只要生气就会 刮起强风吹倒一切。
drampamega.flavorEn: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

drapion.name: Drapion
drapion.flavor: 虽然狰狞凶猛到被人们 称为沙之恶魔，但在河马兽 面前却表现得低调温顺。
drapion.flavorEn: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

dratini.name: Dratini
dratini.flavor: 长久以来被认为只存在于 幻想之中。额头小小的突起 是正在发育的角。
dratini.flavorEn: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

drednaw.name: Drednaw
drednaw.flavor: 颈部可以伸缩。 能从远处迅速伸长颈部， 用锐利的牙齿解决对手。
drednaw.flavorEn: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

drednawgmax.name: Drednaw-Gmax
drednawgmax.flavor: 颈部可以伸缩。 能从远处迅速伸长颈部， 用锐利的牙齿解决对手。
drednawgmax.flavorEn: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

dreepy.name: Dreepy
dreepy.flavor: 虽然单独１只弱得甚至敌不过小孩， 但会和伙伴合作一起锻炼， 通过进化而变得更强。
dreepy.flavorEn: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

drifblim.name: Drifblim
drifblim.flavor: 会抓住人和宝可梦， 然后运到某个地方。 没人知道那地方是哪里。
drifblim.flavorEn: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

drifloon.name: Drifloon
drifloon.flavor: 因魂魄聚集在一起而诞生。 到了湿气大的季节 就有可能大量出现。
drifloon.flavorEn: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

drilbur.name: Drilbur
drilbur.flavor: 会用爪子在地底挖掘前进。 一些农民因为担心它会 因此糟蹋蔬菜而讨厌它。
drilbur.flavorEn: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

drizzile.name: Drizzile
drizzile.flavor: 头脑聪明但是怕麻烦。 为了不让敌人接近自己的地盘， 在各个地方都设下了陷阱。
drizzile.flavorEn: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

drowzee.name: Drowzee
drowzee.flavor: 如果你每晚与它一起睡觉， 它偶尔会让你梦见 它以前吃过的梦。
drowzee.flavorEn: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

druddigon.name: Druddigon
druddigon.flavor: 性情凶暴而狡猾。 会把其他宝可梦挖出的巢穴 抢来当做自己的住处。
druddigon.flavorEn: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

dubwool.name: Dubwool
dubwool.flavor: 长得长长的角是为了 向异性求爱而存在的。 它从不会把角当做武器。
dubwool.flavorEn: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

ducklett.name: Ducklett
ducklett.flavorEn: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

dudunsparce.name: Dudunsparce
dudunsparce.flavorEn: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

dudunsparcethreesegment.name: Dudunsparce-Three-Segment
dudunsparcethreesegment.flavorEn: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

dugtrio.name: Dugtrio
dugtrio.flavor: 三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到 地下１００公里深的潜力。没人知道 它在地下的部分究竟长成什么样子。
dugtrio.flavorEn: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

dugtrioalola.name: Dugtrio-Alola
dugtrioalola.flavor: 三胞胎的地鼠，拥有能够挖掘到 地下１００公里深的潜力。没人知道 它在地下的部分究竟长成什么样子。
dugtrioalola.flavorEn: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

dunsparce.name: Dunsparce
dunsparce.flavor: 栖息在像迷宫一样的巢穴里。 能通过土壤的气味来判断自己的 位置，所以绝对不会迷路。
dunsparce.flavorEn: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

duosion.name: Duosion
duosion.flavor: 由于它一分为二的大脑 思考的内容几乎完全不同， 导致它的行动非常难以预测。
duosion.flavorEn: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

duraludon.name: Duraludon
duraludon.flavor: 由特殊金属构成的身体 十分轻盈，能够灵活地活动。 不喜欢下雨，所以住在洞窟里。
duraludon.flavorEn: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

duraludongmax.name: Duraludon-Gmax
duraludongmax.flavor: 由特殊金属构成的身体 十分轻盈，能够灵活地活动。 不喜欢下雨，所以住在洞窟里。
duraludongmax.flavorEn: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

durant.name: Durant
durant.flavor: 巨大的颚部能咬碎岩石。 为了不让沙螺蟒把蛋抢走， 会和其他同类一起并肩战斗。
durant.flavorEn: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

dusclops.name: Dusclops
dusclops.flavor: 寻找游走的灵魂，吸入自己 空洞的身体里。没人知道 被吸入后会发生什么事。
dusclops.flavorEn: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

dusknoir.name: Dusknoir
dusknoir.flavor: 用腹部的嘴将猎物整个吞下。 只会吃掉对方的魂魄， 离去时会把肉体吐出来。
dusknoir.flavorEn: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

duskull.name: Duskull
duskull.flavor: 会让身体变透明， 然后偷偷地靠近猎物。 拥有穿过厚墙壁的能力。
duskull.flavorEn: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

dustox.name: Dustox
dustox.flavorEn: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

dwebble.name: Dwebble
dwebble.flavor: 如果找不到大小合适 的石头来当成自己的家， 它也会住到河马兽的洞里。
dwebble.flavorEn: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

eelektrik.name: Eelektrik
eelektrik.flavorEn: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

eelektross.name: Eelektross
eelektross.flavorEn: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

eelektrossmega.name: Eelektross-Mega
eelektrossmega.flavorEn: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

eevee.name: Eevee
eevee.flavor: 由于不稳定的遗传基因， 蕴含着各种各样进化 可能性的特殊宝可梦。
eevee.flavorEn: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

eeveegmax.name: Eevee-Gmax
eeveegmax.flavor: 由于不稳定的遗传基因， 蕴含着各种各样进化 可能性的特殊宝可梦。
eeveegmax.flavorEn: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

eeveestarter.name: Eevee-Starter
eeveestarter.flavor: 由于不稳定的遗传基因， 蕴含着各种各样进化 可能性的特殊宝可梦。
eeveestarter.flavorEn: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

eiscue.name: Eiscue
eiscue.flavor: 无论何时都用冰块冰镇着 自己怕热的脸。会把头顶 上的毛垂到海里钓食物吃。
eiscue.flavorEn: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

eiscuenoice.name: Eiscue-Noice
eiscuenoice.flavor: 无论何时都用冰块冰镇着 自己怕热的脸。会把头顶 上的毛垂到海里钓食物吃。
eiscuenoice.flavorEn: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

ekans.name: Ekans
ekans.flavor: 身体会随着年龄增长不断变长。 每到夜里，它会一圈圈地 将身体缠绕在树枝上休息。
ekans.flavorEn: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

eldegoss.name: Eldegoss
eldegoss.flavor: 用它头上的棉絮制成的线 有着十分美丽动人的光泽， 是伽勒尔地区的名产。
eldegoss.flavorEn: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

electabuzz.name: Electabuzz
electabuzz.flavor: 暴风雨来临时，它们就会 集结在高高的大树周围， 耐心地等待落雷。
electabuzz.flavorEn: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

electivire.name: Electivire
electivire.flavor: 发电量在电气宝可梦当中 属于最高级别。可以从 尾巴尖端释放高压电流。
electivire.flavorEn: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

electrike.name: Electrike
electrike.flavor: 会在体毛中储存静电。 在空气干燥的季节 会从全身散发出火花。
electrike.flavorEn: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

electrode.name: Electrode
electrode.flavor: 只要受到一点撞击， 就会由于体内的 电能溢出导致爆炸。
electrode.flavorEn: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

electrodehisui.name: Electrode-Hisui
electrodehisui.flavor: 只要受到一点撞击， 就会由于体内的 电能溢出导致爆炸。
electrodehisui.flavorEn: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

elekid.name: Elekid
elekid.flavor: 储存电力的本领还不到家。 为了吸取电力，会偷偷 潜入民宅寻找插座。
elekid.flavorEn: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

elgyem.name: Elgyem
elgyem.flavor: 在大约５０年前被发现的宝可梦。 会用又大又发达的大脑 操纵精神力量。
elgyem.flavorEn: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

emboar.name: Emboar
emboar.flavorEn: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

emboarmega.name: Emboar-Mega
emboarmega.flavorEn: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

emolga.name: Emolga
emolga.flavor: 最喜欢甜甜的树果。有时也会 因为在脸颊的袋子里囤了太多 食物而无法好好飞行。
emolga.flavorEn: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

empoleon.name: Empoleon
empoleon.flavorEn: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

enamorus.name: Enamorus
enamorus.flavorEn: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

enamorustherian.name: Enamorus-Therian
enamorustherian.flavorEn: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

entei.name: Entei
entei.flavorEn: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

escavalier.name: Escavalier
escavalier.flavor: 会举起长矛突击敌人。 有一幅名画描绘着 它和葱游兵决斗的场景。
escavalier.flavorEn: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

espathra.name: Espathra
espathra.flavorEn: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

espeon.name: Espeon
espeon.flavor: 从额头的珠子放射出精神力量 进行战斗。当力量用尽时， 珠子的颜色也会褪去。
espeon.flavorEn: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

espurr.name: Espurr
espurr.flavor: 虽然拥有可以弹飞 职业摔角手的精神力量， 却因无法好好控制而感到烦恼。
espurr.flavorEn: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

eternatus.name: Eternatus
eternatus.flavor: 来自于２万年前坠落 到地上的陨石之中。 似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。
eternatus.flavorEn: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

eternatuseternamax.name: Eternatus-Eternamax
eternatuseternamax.flavor: 来自于２万年前坠落 到地上的陨石之中。 似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。
eternatuseternamax.flavorEn: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

excadrill.name: Excadrill
excadrill.flavor: 别名钻头王。在地底下 挖掘前进的速度 达到了每小时１５０公里。
excadrill.flavorEn: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

excadrillmega.name: Excadrill-Mega
excadrillmega.flavor: 别名钻头王。在地底下 挖掘前进的速度 达到了每小时１５０公里。
excadrillmega.flavorEn: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

exeggcute.name: Exeggcute
exeggcute.flavor: ６只不在一起就不安心。 哪怕只是少了１只， 都会马上想要逃跑。
exeggcute.flavorEn: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

exeggutor.name: Exeggutor
exeggutor.flavor: ３个脑袋联合起来 能使出强大的精神力量。 天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。
exeggutor.flavorEn: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

exeggutoralola.name: Exeggutor-Alola
exeggutoralola.flavor: ３个脑袋联合起来 能使出强大的精神力量。 天气变阴时动作会变得迟钝。
exeggutoralola.flavorEn: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

exploud.name: Exploud
exploud.flavor: 它不仅仅会大喊大叫。为了和 伙伴相互传情达意，它会从 身体的洞里发出各种各样的音色。
exploud.flavorEn: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.

falinks.name: Falinks
falinks.flavor: ６只为一体的宝可梦。 惯于团队行动，会一边 变换阵形一边战斗。
falinks.flavorEn: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

falinksmega.name: Falinks-Mega
falinksmega.flavor: ６只为一体的宝可梦。 惯于团队行动，会一边 变换阵形一边战斗。
falinksmega.flavorEn: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

farfetchd.name: Farfetch’d
farfetchd.flavor: 用植物的茎来战斗。 茎的挥舞方式存在着 好几种不同的流派。
farfetchd.flavorEn: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

farfetchdgalar.name: Farfetch’d-Galar
farfetchdgalar.flavor: 用植物的茎来战斗。 茎的挥舞方式存在着 好几种不同的流派。
farfetchdgalar.flavorEn: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

farigiraf.name: Farigiraf
farigiraf.flavorEn: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

fearow.name: Fearow
fearow.flavor: 很久以前就存在的宝可梦。 哪怕只察觉到一丝危险， 都会立即飞向高空。
fearow.flavorEn: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

feebas.name: Feebas
feebas.flavor: 虽然外表丑陋， 但拥有顽强的生命力， 只要少量的水就能存活。
feebas.flavorEn: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

fennekin.name: Fennekin
fennekin.flavorEn: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

feraligatr.name: Feraligatr
