feraligatr.flavorEn: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

feraligatrmega.name: Feraligatr-Mega
feraligatrmega.flavorEn: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

ferroseed.name: Ferroseed
ferroseed.flavor: 偏爱长着青苔的洞窟。 青苔中所含的酶能使它的 尖刺成长得又大又结实。
ferroseed.flavorEn: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

ferrothorn.name: Ferrothorn
ferrothorn.flavor: 拥有比钢铁还坚硬的尖刺。 会利用触手上的尖刺 攀附在岩壁上移动。
ferrothorn.flavorEn: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

fezandipiti.name: Fezandipiti
fezandipiti.flavorEn: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

fidough.name: Fidough
fidough.flavorEn: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

finizen.name: Finizen
finizen.flavorEn: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

finneon.name: Finneon
finneon.flavor: 用发光的尾鳍引诱猎物。 白天会在海面附近， 到了夜里就向海的深处移动。
finneon.flavorEn: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

flaaffy.name: Flaaffy
flaaffy.flavor: 能将电力储存在松软的毛发中。 因为储存了太多电力，所以身上 有些地方已经变得光秃秃的了。
flaaffy.flavorEn: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

flabebe.name: Flabébé
flabebe.flavor: 头上的冠是收集花粉做成的。 蕴藏着治愈的效果。
flabebe.flavorEn: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

flamigo.name: Flamigo
flamigo.flavorEn: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

flapple.name: Flapple
flapple.flavor: 会用苹果皮的翅膀飞翔， 并吐出强酸性的唾液。 可以变成苹果的形状。
flapple.flavorEn: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

flapplegmax.name: Flapple-Gmax
flapplegmax.flavor: 会用苹果皮的翅膀飞翔， 并吐出强酸性的唾液。 可以变成苹果的形状。
flapplegmax.flavorEn: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

flareon.name: Flareon
flareon.flavor: 会将吸入的空气的一部分 传送到自己体内的火囊里， 制造出１７００度的火焰。
flareon.flavorEn: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

fletchinder.name: Fletchinder
fletchinder.flavor: 领地意识很强，性格好战。 火箭雀彼此之间会为了 觅食的地方发生争斗。
fletchinder.flavorEn: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

fletchling.name: Fletchling
fletchling.flavor: 一旦兴奋体温就会 急剧上升。赤手去摸 甚至有可能会被灼伤。
fletchling.flavorEn: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

flittle.name: Flittle
flittle.flavorEn: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

floatzel.name: Floatzel
floatzel.flavorEn: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

floette.name: Floette
floette.flavor: 把自己的力量给花，用心地照料。 绝不原谅那些破坏花坛者。
floette.flavorEn: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

floetteeternal.name: Floette-Eternal
floetteeternal.flavor: 把自己的力量给花，用心地照料。 绝不原谅那些破坏花坛者。
floetteeternal.flavorEn: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

floettemega.name: Floette-Mega
floettemega.flavor: 把自己的力量给花，用心地照料。 绝不原谅那些破坏花坛者。
floettemega.flavorEn: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

floragato.name: Floragato
floragato.flavorEn: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

florges.name: Florges
florges.flavor: 拥有几百年的寿命。 据说会终其一生不断地守护着庭园。
florges.flavorEn: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

fluttermane.name: Flutter Mane
fluttermane.flavorEn: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

flygon.name: Flygon
flygon.flavor: 由于它挥动翅膀的声音 好似女性优美的歌声， 因此被称为沙漠精灵。
flygon.flavorEn: It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.

fomantis.name: Fomantis
fomantis.flavor: 白天沐浴阳光， 呼呼大睡。到了半夜 才醒来并开始活动。
fomantis.flavorEn: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

foongus.name: Foongus
foongus.flavor: 从双手喷出的孢子虽然 含有剧毒，但据说彻底干燥后 可以用作治疗肠胃的药。
foongus.flavorEn: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

forretress.name: Forretress
forretress.flavor: 仅在吞下猎物的瞬间，壳里面的 身体才会出现，但至今仍未有 人或宝可梦见过其真面目。
forretress.flavorEn: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

fraxure.name: Fraxure
fraxure.flavor: 皮肤像盔甲一样坚硬。 非常擅长在撞击的同时 用牙齿猛刺的战法。
fraxure.flavorEn: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

frigibax.name: Frigibax
frigibax.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

frillish.name: Frillish
frillish.flavor: 据流传至今的传说里所述， 它是由沉没到海底的古代都市 的居民变成的宝可梦。
frillish.flavorEn: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

froakie.name: Froakie
froakie.flavorEn: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

frogadier.name: Frogadier
frogadier.flavorEn: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

froslass.name: Froslass
froslass.flavor: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气 冻住猎物，并把它们带回 自己的巢穴，整齐地摆成一排。
froslass.flavorEn: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

froslassmega.name: Froslass-Mega
froslassmega.flavor: 会吐出零下５０度的冷气 冻住猎物，并把它们带回 自己的巢穴，整齐地摆成一排。
froslassmega.flavorEn: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

frosmoth.name: Frosmoth
frosmoth.flavor: 绝不放过破坏山野环境的人。 会用冰冷的翅膀四处飞翔， 制造出暴风雪来惩罚他们。
frosmoth.flavorEn: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

fuecoco.name: Fuecoco
fuecoco.flavorEn: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

furfrou.name: Furfrou
furfrou.flavor: 如果置之不理， 体毛会不断地长长， 但只允许信赖的人修剪。
furfrou.flavorEn: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

furret.name: Furret
furret.flavorEn: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

gabite.name: Gabite
gabite.flavor: 会把宝石埋藏在栖息的洞窟内。 入侵者闯入洞窟后，会立刻 被它用爪子和牙齿撕碎。
gabite.flavorEn: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

gallade.name: Gallade
gallade.flavor: 能够敏锐地感知到 寻求帮助的感情， 并且火速赶去援助对方。
gallade.flavorEn: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

gallademega.name: Gallade-Mega
gallademega.flavor: 能够敏锐地感知到 寻求帮助的感情， 并且火速赶去援助对方。
gallademega.flavorEn: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

galvantula.name: Galvantula
galvantula.flavor: 为了捕捉不太会飞的幼鸟， 会在鸟宝可梦的巢穴附近 用带电的丝设下陷阱。
galvantula.flavorEn: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

garbodor.name: Garbodor
garbodor.flavor: 从右臂喷出的毒液十分危险， 虚弱的生物只要一沾到， 立刻就会丢掉性命。
garbodor.flavorEn: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

garbodorgmax.name: Garbodor-Gmax
garbodorgmax.flavor: 从右臂喷出的毒液十分危险， 虚弱的生物只要一沾到， 立刻就会丢掉性命。
garbodorgmax.flavorEn: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

garchomp.name: Garchomp
garchomp.flavor: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷， 在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前 干掉猎物并返回住处。
garchomp.flavorEn: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

garchompmega.name: Garchomp-Mega
garchompmega.flavor: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷， 在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前 干掉猎物并返回住处。
garchompmega.flavorEn: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

garchompmegaz.name: Garchomp-Mega-Z
garchompmegaz.flavor: 身手在陆地上也很矫捷， 在雪山上会赶在身体冻僵前 干掉猎物并返回住处。
garchompmegaz.flavorEn: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

gardevoir.name: Gardevoir
gardevoir.flavor: 如果是为了保护训练家， 它就会用尽自己的精神力量 制造出小型黑洞。
gardevoir.flavorEn: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

gardevoirmega.name: Gardevoir-Mega
gardevoirmega.flavor: 如果是为了保护训练家， 它就会用尽自己的精神力量 制造出小型黑洞。
gardevoirmega.flavorEn: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

garganacl.name: Garganacl
garganacl.flavorEn: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

gastly.name: Gastly
gastly.flavor: 能用稀薄气体状的 身体潜入任何地方， 但只要起风就会被吹跑。
gastly.flavorEn: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

gastrodon.name: Gastrodon
gastrodon.flavor: 身体软瘫瘫的但十分强韧。 因为它身体的软度可以 帮助分散它所受到的冲击。
gastrodon.flavorEn: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

genesect.name: Genesect
genesect.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

genesectburn.name: Genesect-Burn
genesectburn.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

genesectchill.name: Genesect-Chill
genesectchill.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

genesectdouse.name: Genesect-Douse
genesectdouse.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

genesectshock.name: Genesect-Shock
genesectshock.flavorEn: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

gengar.name: Gengar
gengar.flavor: 据说它会为了夺取 山中遇难者的生命 而从黑暗中出现。
gengar.flavorEn: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

gengargmax.name: Gengar-Gmax
gengargmax.flavor: 据说它会为了夺取 山中遇难者的生命 而从黑暗中出现。
gengargmax.flavorEn: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

gengarmega.name: Gengar-Mega
gengarmega.flavor: 据说它会为了夺取 山中遇难者的生命 而从黑暗中出现。
gengarmega.flavorEn: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

geodude.name: Geodude
geodude.flavor: 大多栖息于山路。由于 不留神踩到它会使它 大发雷霆，得多加小心。
geodude.flavorEn: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

geodudealola.name: Geodude-Alola
geodudealola.flavor: 大多栖息于山路。由于 不留神踩到它会使它 大发雷霆，得多加小心。
geodudealola.flavorEn: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

gholdengo.name: Gholdengo
gholdengo.flavorEn: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
gholdengo.evoCondition: Level up with 999 Coins in the bag

gible.name: Gible
gible.flavor: 遇到会动的东西就会扑上去 将其拉回到自己住的横洞内。 虽然嘴很大，但胃口却比较小。
gible.flavorEn: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

gigalith.name: Gigalith
gigalith.flavor: 它射出的能量弹具有 可以击飞翻斗车的破坏力。 不过只有在晴天才能射击。
gigalith.flavorEn: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

gimmighoul.name: Gimmighoul
gimmighoul.flavorEn: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

gimmighoulroaming.name: Gimmighoul-Roaming
gimmighoulroaming.flavorEn: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

girafarig.name: Girafarig
girafarig.flavorEn: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

giratina.name: Giratina
giratina.flavorEn: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

giratinaorigin.name: Giratina-Origin
giratinaorigin.flavorEn: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

glaceon.name: Glaceon
glaceon.flavor: 冰伊布释放出的冷气能 制造出粉状的雪。这使它受到 各个滑雪场的热烈欢迎。
glaceon.flavorEn: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

glalie.name: Glalie
glalie.flavor: 用令空气中的水分 瞬间冻结的力量， 将猎物冰冻起来。
glalie.flavorEn: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

glaliemega.name: Glalie-Mega
glaliemega.flavor: 用令空气中的水分 瞬间冻结的力量， 将猎物冰冻起来。
glaliemega.flavorEn: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

glameow.name: Glameow
glameow.flavorEn: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

glastrier.name: Glastrier
glastrier.flavor: 拥有十分惊人的怪力。 戴在脸上的冰之面罩 硬度是钻石的１００倍
glastrier.flavorEn: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.

gligar.name: Gligar
gligar.flavorEn: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

glimmet.name: Glimmet
glimmet.flavorEn: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

glimmora.name: Glimmora
glimmora.flavorEn: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

glimmoramega.name: Glimmora-Mega
glimmoramega.flavorEn: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

gliscor.name: Gliscor
gliscor.flavorEn: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

gloom.name: Gloom
gloom.flavor: 看似口水的东西其实是 甜甜的蜜。非常黏稠， 只要碰到就会一直黏住。
gloom.flavorEn: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

gogoat.name: Gogoat
gogoat.flavorEn: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

golbat.name: Golbat
golbat.flavor: 用小而灵活的脚走路。 会悄悄接近正在睡觉的猎物， 用尖牙咬住对方吸取血液。
golbat.flavorEn: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

goldeen.name: Goldeen
goldeen.flavor: 背鳍和尾鳍像肌肉 那样发达。能够以 ５节的速度在水中游泳。
goldeen.flavorEn: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

golduck.name: Golduck
golduck.flavor: 古老的故事中说， 它会把污染河水的 人类拖进水中带走。
golduck.flavorEn: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

golem.name: Golem
golem.flavor: 刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的 非常柔软，但是接触到 空气之后会迅速变坚硬。
golem.flavorEn: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

golemalola.name: Golem-Alola
golemalola.flavor: 刚蜕皮时浑身都白白的 非常柔软，但是接触到 空气之后会迅速变坚硬。
golemalola.flavorEn: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

golett.name: Golett
golett.flavor: 用黏土制成的宝可梦。 即使现在也一直遵循着 数千年前主人的命令。
golett.flavorEn: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

golisopod.name: Golisopod
golisopod.flavor: 生活在海底的洞窟或沉船里。 会去和八爪武师决战， 输掉的一方便会成为对方的食物。
golisopod.flavorEn: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

golisopodmega.name: Golisopod-Mega
golisopodmega.flavor: 生活在海底的洞窟或沉船里。 会去和八爪武师决战， 输掉的一方便会成为对方的食物。
golisopodmega.flavorEn: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

golurk.name: Golurk
golurk.flavor: 虽然有人认为它体内 有着生成能量的永动机， 但至今仍未得到证实。
golurk.flavorEn: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

golurkmega.name: Golurk-Mega
golurkmega.flavor: 虽然有人认为它体内 有着生成能量的永动机， 但至今仍未得到证实。
golurkmega.flavorEn: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

goodra.name: Goodra
goodra.flavor: 用伸长角产生的力道来 攻击对手，产生的威力比 重量级拳击手的拳击还强１００倍。
goodra.flavorEn: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

goodrahisui.name: Goodra-Hisui
goodrahisui.flavor: 用伸长角产生的力道来 攻击对手，产生的威力比 重量级拳击手的拳击还强１００倍。
goodrahisui.flavorEn: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

goomy.name: Goomy
goomy.flavor: 它的触角是优秀的感觉器官。 只要感觉到有敌人就会立刻 藏起来，以此存活到了现在。
goomy.flavorEn: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

gorebyss.name: Gorebyss
gorebyss.flavor: 吸食猎物的体液。 剩下的肉会沉入海底， 成为其他宝可梦的食物。
gorebyss.flavorEn: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.

gossifleur.name: Gossifleur
gossifleur.flavor: 会随着微风一边转圈圈一边 愉快地唱歌。许多人因为喜欢 这可爱的模样而培育它。
gossifleur.flavorEn: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

gothita.name: Gothita
gothita.flavor: 哥德宝宝会在看似无人的地方 轻声地叫。它好像是在与某种 只有它才看得见的东西说话。
gothita.flavorEn: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

gothitelle.name: Gothitelle
gothitelle.flavor: 从哥德小姐那里 看到了自己下场的恶人 在那之后便销声匿迹了。
gothitelle.flavorEn: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

gothorita.name: Gothorita
gothorita.flavor: 哥德小童的精神力量似乎会 在星光闪耀的夜晚达到最高点。 它与宇宙的关系至今不明。
gothorita.flavorEn: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

gougingfire.name: Gouging Fire
gougingfire.flavorEn: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

gourgeist.name: Gourgeist
gourgeist.flavor: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里 去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人 会被它带往另一个世界。
gourgeist.flavorEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

gourgeistlarge.name: Gourgeist-Large
gourgeistlarge.flavor: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里 去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人 会被它带往另一个世界。
gourgeistlarge.flavorEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

gourgeistsmall.name: Gourgeist-Small
gourgeistsmall.flavor: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里 去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人 会被它带往另一个世界。
gourgeistsmall.flavorEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

gourgeistsuper.name: Gourgeist-Super
gourgeistsuper.flavor: 南瓜怪人会在朔月的夜里 去别人家门口敲门。开了门的人 会被它带往另一个世界。
gourgeistsuper.flavorEn: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

grafaiai.name: Grafaiai
grafaiai.flavorEn: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

granbull.name: Granbull
granbull.flavor: 虽然深受年轻女性的欢迎， 但它胆小怕事，内心柔弱， 所以无法成为一条看门犬。
granbull.flavorEn: Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.

grapploct.name: Grapploct
grapploct.flavor: 会为了试自己的身手 而登上陆地寻找对手。 战斗结束后就会回到海里。
grapploct.flavorEn: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

graveler.name: Graveler
graveler.flavor: 常在山路上滚来滚去。 滚动时从来不关心 前面的路上都有什么。
graveler.flavorEn: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

graveleralola.name: Graveler-Alola
graveleralola.flavor: 常在山路上滚来滚去。 滚动时从来不关心 前面的路上都有什么。
graveleralola.flavorEn: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

greattusk.name: Great Tusk
greattusk.flavorEn: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

greavard.name: Greavard
greavard.flavorEn: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

greedent.name: Greedent
greedent.flavor: 无论多么坚硬的树果壳 都能用引以为傲的大牙咬碎。 在伽勒尔是很常见的宝可梦。
greedent.flavorEn: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

greninja.name: Greninja
greninja.flavorEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

greninjaash.name: Greninja-Ash
greninjaash.flavorEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

greninjabond.name: Greninja-Bond
greninjabond.flavorEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

greninjamega.name: Greninja-Mega
greninjamega.flavorEn: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

grimer.name: Grimer
grimer.flavor: 它由囤积的淤泥而形成。 臭到让人无法碰触，凡是 它走过的地方都寸草不生。
grimer.flavorEn: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

grimeralola.name: Grimer-Alola
grimeralola.flavor: 它由囤积的淤泥而形成。 臭到让人无法碰触，凡是 它走过的地方都寸草不生。
grimeralola.flavorEn: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

grimmsnarl.name: Grimmsnarl
grimmsnarl.flavor: 毛发能发挥肌肉纤维般的作用。 伸展开来时会像触手那样 把对手缠绕起来。
grimmsnarl.flavorEn: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

grimmsnarlgmax.name: Grimmsnarl-Gmax
grimmsnarlgmax.flavor: 毛发能发挥肌肉纤维般的作用。 伸展开来时会像触手那样 把对手缠绕起来。
grimmsnarlgmax.flavorEn: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

grookey.name: Grookey
grookey.flavor: 会用木棒连续击打来攻击。 在以飞快的速度击打的同时， 情绪也会变得越来越高涨。
grookey.flavorEn: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

grotle.name: Grotle
grotle.flavorEn: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

groudon.name: Groudon
groudon.flavorEn: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

groudonprimal.name: Groudon-Primal
groudonprimal.flavorEn: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

grovyle.name: Grovyle
grovyle.flavorEn: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

growlithe.name: Growlithe
growlithe.flavor: 性格忠诚。 为了保护自己的训练家， 会拼命地朝对手狂吠。
growlithe.flavorEn: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

growlithehisui.name: Growlithe-Hisui
growlithehisui.flavor: 性格忠诚。 为了保护自己的训练家， 会拼命地朝对手狂吠。
growlithehisui.flavorEn: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

grubbin.name: Grubbin
grubbin.flavor: 会用巨大的颚部 在森林中挖地制造巢穴。 最喜欢甜甜的树汁。
grubbin.flavorEn: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

grumpig.name: Grumpig
grumpig.flavorEn: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.

gulpin.name: Gulpin
gulpin.flavorEn: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

gumshoos.name: Gumshoos
gumshoos.flavor: 忍耐力非常强， 但如果见到它爱吃的小拉达， 就会忘乎所以地扑过去。
gumshoos.flavorEn: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

gumshoostotem.name: Gumshoos-Totem
gumshoostotem.flavor: 忍耐力非常强， 但如果见到它爱吃的小拉达， 就会忘乎所以地扑过去。
gumshoostotem.flavorEn: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

gurdurr.name: Gurdurr
gurdurr.flavor: 能够灵巧地操纵工字钢。 虽然对拆除得心应手， 但却不太擅长组装。
gurdurr.flavorEn: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

guzzlord.name: Guzzlord
guzzlord.flavor: 被称为究极异兽的未知生命。 不知是不是经常觉得肚子饿， 一直都在吃着什么东西。
guzzlord.flavorEn: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

gyarados.name: Gyarados
gyarados.flavor: 就算是在狂风暴雨中， 只要发狂的暴鲤龙出现， 一切都会被它烧毁殆尽。
gyarados.flavorEn: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

gyaradosmega.name: Gyarados-Mega
gyaradosmega.flavor: 就算是在狂风暴雨中， 只要发狂的暴鲤龙出现， 一切都会被它烧毁殆尽。
gyaradosmega.flavorEn: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

hakamoo.name: Hakamo-o
hakamoo.flavor: 敲响鳞片，发出吼声， 接着向对手发起挑战， 并用锋利的爪子撕裂对手。
hakamoo.flavorEn: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

happiny.name: Happiny
happiny.flavor: 会把自己珍贵的浑圆石头 借给关系变得很要好的对象。 如果不还给它，它便会大哭大闹。
happiny.flavorEn: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

hariyama.name: Hariyama
hariyama.flavor: 体型粗壮的铁掌力士未必强大。 即便身型矮小，也有身轻如燕， 擅长巧力的铁掌力士。
hariyama.flavorEn: Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

hatenna.name: Hatenna
hatenna.flavor: 喜欢没有人烟的地方。 一旦感觉到强烈的感情， 就会一溜烟地逃走。
hatenna.flavorEn: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

hatterene.name: Hatterene
hatterene.flavor: 又被称为森林魔女。 如果有人大吵大闹，可能会 被它用触手上的爪子撕碎。
hatterene.flavorEn: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

hatterenegmax.name: Hatterene-Gmax
hatterenegmax.flavor: 又被称为森林魔女。 如果有人大吵大闹，可能会 被它用触手上的爪子撕碎。
hatterenegmax.flavorEn: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

hattrem.name: Hattrem
hattrem.flavor: 会用头上的辫子攻击对手， 让对方安静下来。破坏力 强到能一击ＫＯ职业拳击手。
hattrem.flavorEn: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

haunter.name: Haunter
haunter.flavor: 如果黑暗中空空如也， 但你却感觉被什么盯上了， 那么鬼斯通一定就在那里。
haunter.flavorEn: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

hawlucha.name: Hawlucha
hawlucha.flavor: 在使出致命的绝招之前 一定要先摆出华丽的姿势。 有时也会在这一刻遭到反击。
hawlucha.flavorEn: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

hawluchamega.name: Hawlucha-Mega
hawluchamega.flavor: 在使出致命的绝招之前 一定要先摆出华丽的姿势。 有时也会在这一刻遭到反击。
hawluchamega.flavorEn: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

haxorus.name: Haxorus
haxorus.flavor: 性格温和，但生起气来非常恐怖。 会用自己那引以为傲，可以 削铁如泥的牙齿攻击敌人。
haxorus.flavorEn: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

heatmor.name: Heatmor
heatmor.flavor: 将火焰当成舌头来使用。 会一点一点地熔化铁蚁 坚硬的外骨骼，然后把它吃掉。
heatmor.flavorEn: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

heatran.name: Heatran
heatran.flavorEn: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

heatranmega.name: Heatran-Mega
heatranmega.flavorEn: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

heliolisk.name: Heliolisk
heliolisk.flavor: 如果展开颈伞沐浴阳光， 单凭１只光电伞蜥就能 制造出大城市所需的电力。
heliolisk.flavorEn: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

helioptile.name: Helioptile
helioptile.flavor: 拥有太阳能发电的结构。 如果有人打扰它发电， 它就会因心理压力而衰弱。
helioptile.flavorEn: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

heracross.name: Heracross
heracross.flavor: 能轻轻松松地举起比自己 体重还重１００倍的东西， 是以一身怪力为傲的宝可梦。
heracross.flavorEn: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

heracrossmega.name: Heracross-Mega
heracrossmega.flavor: 能轻轻松松地举起比自己 体重还重１００倍的东西， 是以一身怪力为傲的宝可梦。
heracrossmega.flavorEn: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

herdier.name: Herdier
herdier.flavor: 覆盖在身上的黑色体毛 既厚又有弹性，甚至能 把尖锐的牙齿也反弹回去。
herdier.flavorEn: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

hippopotas.name: Hippopotas
hippopotas.flavor: 主要在白天活动。 因为沙漠的夜晚会降温， 所以会钻到沙子的深处睡觉。
hippopotas.flavorEn: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

hippowdon.name: Hippowdon
hippowdon.flavor: 生气的时候非常凶暴。 会喷出储存在体内的 沙子来引发沙尘暴。
hippowdon.flavorEn: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

hitmonchan.name: Hitmonchan
hitmonchan.flavor: 打出的拳击甚至能劈开空气。 但攻击３分钟后， 它似乎就会想休息一下。
hitmonchan.flavorEn: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
hitmonchan.evoCondition: with an Atk stat < its Def stat

hitmonlee.name: Hitmonlee
hitmonlee.flavor: 腿能自由地伸缩， 即使离得很远， 也能把对手踢飞。
hitmonlee.flavorEn: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
hitmonlee.evoCondition: with an Atk stat > its Def stat

hitmontop.name: Hitmontop
hitmontop.flavor: 会通过倒立来扰乱 对方的节奏，然后 趁隙施展华丽的踢击。
hitmontop.flavorEn: After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
hitmontop.evoCondition: with an Atk stat equal to its Def stat

honchkrow.name: Honchkrow
honchkrow.flavor: 和敌人战斗的基本都是跟班。 只有在最后刺入对手的致命一击 才会弄脏自己的手。
honchkrow.flavorEn: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

honedge.name: Honedge
honedge.flavor: 独剑鞘剑格上的 蓝色眼珠是它的本体。 会用陈旧的布吸取人类的精气。
honedge.flavorEn: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

hooh.name: Ho-Oh
hooh.flavorEn: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

hoopa.name: Hoopa
hoopa.flavorEn: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

hoopaunbound.name: Hoopa-Unbound
hoopaunbound.flavorEn: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

hoothoot.name: Hoothoot
hoothoot.flavor: 总是在固定的时间鸣叫， 因此也有训练家 拿它来代替钟表带出门。
hoothoot.flavorEn: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.

hoppip.name: Hoppip
hoppip.flavorEn: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

horsea.name: Horsea
horsea.flavor: 会像跳舞一样在水中游动 以制造漩涡。作为娱乐， 会和伙伴比拼谁的漩涡更大。
horsea.flavorEn: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

houndoom.name: Houndoom
houndoom.flavor: 恐怖的长嚎是其特征。 过去人们曾认为它是来自 地狱的使者而对其心存畏惧。
houndoom.flavorEn: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

houndoommega.name: Houndoom-Mega
houndoommega.flavor: 恐怖的长嚎是其特征。 过去人们曾认为它是来自 地狱的使者而对其心存畏惧。
houndoommega.flavorEn: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

houndour.name: Houndour
houndour.flavor: 会在天亮之前反复发出恐怖的长嚎， 并以此来彰显自己群体的存在。
houndour.flavorEn: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

houndstone.name: Houndstone
houndstone.flavorEn: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

huntail.name: Huntail
huntail.flavor: 栖息在深海中。 传说，如果猎斑鱼被冲上沙滩， 就会有不祥的事情发生。
huntail.flavorEn: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.

hydrapple.name: Hydrapple
hydrapple.flavorEn: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

hydreigon.name: Hydreigon
hydreigon.flavor: ３个头会轮流去咬敌人。 在对方倒下之前， 绝对不会停止攻击。
hydreigon.flavorEn: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

hypno.name: Hypno
hypno.flavor: 无意中遇到它的时候，如果 不小心和它对上视线会很危险。 它手里拿着的钟摆会让人睡着。
hypno.flavorEn: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

igglybuff.name: Igglybuff
igglybuff.flavor: 用柔软的身体弹跳著移动。 当它的体温上升时， 身体会变成深粉红色。
igglybuff.flavorEn: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.

illumise.name: Illumise
illumise.flavorEn: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

impidimp.name: Impidimp
impidimp.flavor: 不但会溜进民宅偷盗， 还会吸收人们悔恨时 的负面能量。
impidimp.flavorEn: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

incineroar.name: Incineroar
incineroar.flavor: 虽然行为举止十分粗野， 却也有着会去帮助 弱小宝可梦的温柔一面。
incineroar.flavorEn: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

indeedee.name: Indeedee
indeedee.flavor: 能通过自己的角去 感受附近生物的情感。 正面情绪是它的能量之源。
indeedee.flavorEn: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

indeedeef.name: Indeedee-F
indeedeef.flavor: 能通过自己的角去 感受附近生物的情感。 正面情绪是它的能量之源。
indeedeef.flavorEn: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

infernape.name: Infernape
infernape.flavorEn: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

inkay.name: Inkay
inkay.flavor: 会让敌人看到自己闪烁的 发光体来让对方丧失战意， 然后趁机逃之夭夭。
inkay.flavorEn: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

inteleon.name: Inteleon
inteleon.flavor: 能从指尖射出速度高达３马赫 的水枪。它的瞬膜能帮助它看穿 敌人的弱点，准确地击中要害。
inteleon.flavorEn: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

inteleongmax.name: Inteleon-Gmax
inteleongmax.flavor: 能从指尖射出速度高达３马赫 的水枪。它的瞬膜能帮助它看穿 敌人的弱点，准确地击中要害。
inteleongmax.flavorEn: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

ironboulder.name: Iron Boulder
ironboulder.flavorEn: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

ironbundle.name: Iron Bundle
ironbundle.flavorEn: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

ironcrown.name: Iron Crown
ironcrown.flavorEn: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

ironhands.name: Iron Hands
ironhands.flavorEn: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

ironjugulis.name: Iron Jugulis
ironjugulis.flavorEn: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

ironleaves.name: Iron Leaves
ironleaves.flavorEn: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

ironmoth.name: Iron Moth
ironmoth.flavorEn: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

ironthorns.name: Iron Thorns
ironthorns.flavorEn: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

irontreads.name: Iron Treads
irontreads.flavorEn: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

ironvaliant.name: Iron Valiant
ironvaliant.flavorEn: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

ivysaur.name: Ivysaur
ivysaur.flavor: 沐浴在阳光下越久， 身体内会涌出越多力量， 背上的花苞也会渐渐成长。
ivysaur.flavorEn: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

jangmoo.name: Jangmo-o
jangmoo.flavor: 体毛变成了像金属一般 坚硬的鳞片。通过敲击 鳞片来和伙伴交流。
jangmoo.flavorEn: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

jellicent.name: Jellicent
jellicent.flavor: 每到满月时，胖嘟嘟会 成群结队地来到海面上。 这么做是为了等待猎物上门。
jellicent.flavorEn: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

jigglypuff.name: Jigglypuff
jigglypuff.flavor: 能够随意改变声音的波长， 唱出听了绝对会 犯困的神奇旋律。
jigglypuff.flavorEn: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.

jirachi.name: Jirachi
jirachi.flavor: 传说当它从１０００年的 沉睡中醒来时，会实现 写在它头部许愿笺上的愿望。
jirachi.flavorEn: It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.

jolteon.name: Jolteon
jolteon.flavor: 能够吸入空气中的负离子， 有时会吐出大约有 １００００伏特的高压电。
jolteon.flavorEn: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

joltik.name: Joltik
joltik.flavor: 会附在其他宝可梦身上 吸取静电。经常会把自己 贴在来电汪的屁股上。
joltik.flavorEn: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

jumpluff.name: Jumpluff
jumpluff.flavorEn: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

jynx.name: Jynx
jynx.flavor: 伽勒尔的迷唇姐外表靓丽， 拥有纤细叫声的也不在少数， 甚至有为其着迷的粉丝。
jynx.flavorEn: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

kabuto.name: Kabuto
kabuto.flavor: 虽然存在已经灭绝的说法， 但据说在一部分地区 还是经常能见到它的身影。
kabuto.flavorEn: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

kabutops.name: Kabutops
kabutops.flavor: 灭绝的原因尚不明确。 曾经栖息在温暖的大海， 是性格残暴的古代宝可梦。
kabutops.flavorEn: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

kadabra.name: Kadabra
kadabra.flavor: 念力的威力大得惊人。 会把精神力量储存在额头的 星星里，以备进化之需。
kadabra.flavorEn: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

kakuna.name: Kakuna
kakuna.flavor: 虽然几乎动也动不了， 但是如果遇到了危险， 有时似乎会竖起毒刺来反抗。
kakuna.flavorEn: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

kangaskhan.name: Kangaskhan
kangaskhan.flavor: 据记载，曾有没孩子的 袋兽将遇难人类的 小孩抚养长大。
kangaskhan.flavorEn: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

kangaskhanmega.name: Kangaskhan-Mega
kangaskhanmega.flavor: 据记载，曾有没孩子的 袋兽将遇难人类的 小孩抚养长大。
kangaskhanmega.flavorEn: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

karrablast.name: Karrablast
karrablast.flavor: 用嘴里吐出的液体 来溶化小嘴蜗的壳， 只会去吃里面的身体。
karrablast.flavorEn: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

kartana.name: Kartana
kartana.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险， 但在它原本栖息的世界， 好像只是寻常能见的生物。
kartana.flavorEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

kecleon.name: Kecleon
kecleon.flavor: 在不隐身的时候，身体的颜色 也会随着心情和状态改变。 颜色越浓的时候越有精神。
kecleon.flavorEn: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.

keldeo.name: Keldeo
keldeo.flavor: 据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗， 额头上的角就能得到锻炼， 从而激发出自己真正的力量。
keldeo.flavorEn: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

keldeoresolute.name: Keldeo-Resolute
keldeoresolute.flavor: 据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗， 额头上的角就能得到锻炼， 从而激发出自己真正的力量。
keldeoresolute.flavorEn: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

kilowattrel.name: Kilowattrel
kilowattrel.flavorEn: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

kingambit.name: Kingambit
kingambit.flavorEn: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
kingambit.evoCondition: Defeat 3 Bisharp leading Pawniard and level-up

kingdra.name: Kingdra
kingdra.flavor: 身上掉下的鳞片闪耀着 高雅而有深度的光泽， 甚至会被拿去进献给王族。
kingdra.flavorEn: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.

kingler.name: Kingler
kingler.flavor: 巨大的钳子破坏力十足， 但是因为太过沉重， 不战斗的时候就很碍事。
kingler.flavorEn: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

kinglergmax.name: Kingler-Gmax
kinglergmax.flavor: 巨大的钳子破坏力十足， 但是因为太过沉重， 不战斗的时候就很碍事。
kinglergmax.flavorEn: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

kirlia.name: Kirlia
kirlia.flavor: 可以通过操纵精神力量 扭曲周围的空间来看清未来。
kirlia.flavorEn: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

klang.name: Klang
klang.flavor: 被认为是工业技术的象征。 有许多伽勒尔当地的公司 选择它作为企业的标志。
klang.flavorEn: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

klawf.name: Klawf
klawf.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

kleavor.name: Kleavor
kleavor.flavorEn: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

klefki.name: Klefki
klefki.flavor: 会用头的前端吸取金属离子。 之所以长得像钥匙，据说是因为 太过喜欢钥匙，情不自禁进行了模仿。
klefki.flavorEn: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

klink.name: Klink
klink.flavor: 据说在很久以前， 是看到了齿轮儿的人 发明了齿轮的构造。
klink.flavorEn: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

klinklang.name: Klinklang
klinklang.flavor: 让３个齿轮高速旋转。 新增出来的那个带着 尖刺的齿轮并不是生物。
klinklang.flavorEn: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

koffing.name: Koffing
koffing.flavor: 污浊的空气是它的美味大餐。 据说在昔日的伽勒尔地区 曾经存在着更多的瓦斯弹。
koffing.flavorEn: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

komala.name: Komala
komala.flavor: 到死都一直是睡着的状态， 是因为吃的叶子里含有 类似麻醉药的成分。
komala.flavorEn: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

kommoo.name: Kommo-o
kommoo.flavor: 遗迹壁画中古代战士 身上穿着的盔甲是用 杖尾鳞甲龙的鳞片制成的。
kommoo.flavorEn: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

kommoototem.name: Kommo-o-Totem
kommoototem.flavor: 遗迹壁画中古代战士 身上穿着的盔甲是用 杖尾鳞甲龙的鳞片制成的。
kommoototem.flavorEn: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

koraidon.name: Koraidon
koraidon.flavorEn: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

krabby.name: Krabby
krabby.flavor: 如果危险逼近， 就会从嘴里吐出泡沫包裹全身， 让身体看起来更大。
krabby.flavorEn: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

kricketot.name: Kricketot
kricketot.flavorEn: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

kricketune.name: Kricketune
kricketune.flavorEn: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

krokorok.name: Krokorok
krokorok.flavor: 虽然拥有能在黑暗中看清事物的 特殊双眼，但由于沙漠的夜晚寒冷， 所以一般不怎么活动。
krokorok.flavorEn: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

krookodile.name: Krookodile
krookodile.flavor: 虽然凶暴，但也有擅长忍耐的一面。 为了捕获猎物，可以在 沙子里静静等上好几天。
krookodile.flavorEn: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

kubfu.name: Kubfu
kubfu.flavor: 拉紧头上又白又长的体毛， 就会变得斗气势高昂， 并从丹田涌出力量。
kubfu.flavorEn: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.

kyogre.name: Kyogre
kyogre.flavorEn: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

kyogreprimal.name: Kyogre-Primal
kyogreprimal.flavorEn: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

kyurem.name: Kyurem
kyurem.flavor: 为了稳定细胞组织， 它似乎用自己制造出 的冷气冰冻着身体。
kyurem.flavorEn: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

kyuremblack.name: Kyurem-Black
kyuremblack.flavor: 为了稳定细胞组织， 它似乎用自己制造出 的冷气冰冻着身体。
kyuremblack.flavorEn: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

kyuremwhite.name: Kyurem-White
kyuremwhite.flavor: 为了稳定细胞组织， 它似乎用自己制造出 的冷气冰冻着身体。
kyuremwhite.flavorEn: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

lairon.name: Lairon
lairon.flavor: 会用钢铁之躯互相撞击 来争夺地盘。仔细看会发现 钢铁盔甲上有伤痕和凹陷。
lairon.flavorEn: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

lampent.name: Lampent
lampent.flavor: 伪装成灯的样子藏身在城镇里。 一旦发现了临近死期的人， 便会悄悄地跟在后面。
lampent.flavorEn: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

landorus.name: Landorus
landorus.flavorEn: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

landorustherian.name: Landorus-Therian
landorustherian.flavorEn: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

lanturn.name: Lanturn
lanturn.flavor: 发出强光蒙住猎物的眼睛。 抓住那一瞬间的空档， 使其遭受电的攻击。
lanturn.flavorEn: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

lapras.name: Lapras
lapras.flavor: 十分耐寒，不畏冰海。 皮肤滑滑的， 摸上去会有点凉。
lapras.flavorEn: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

laprasgmax.name: Lapras-Gmax
laprasgmax.flavor: 十分耐寒，不畏冰海。 皮肤滑滑的， 摸上去会有点凉。
laprasgmax.flavorEn: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

larvesta.name: Larvesta
larvesta.flavor: 全身都相当温暖。 会从角的尖端喷出火焰， 借此威吓天敌或猎物。
larvesta.flavorEn: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

larvitar.name: Larvitar
larvitar.flavor: 以吃土为生。 吃掉一座大山后， 就会为了成长而开始沉睡。
larvitar.flavorEn: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

latias.name: Latias
latias.flavorEn: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

latiasmega.name: Latias-Mega
latiasmega.flavorEn: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

latios.name: Latios
latios.flavorEn: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

latiosmega.name: Latios-Mega
latiosmega.flavorEn: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.

leafeon.name: Leafeon
leafeon.flavor: 尾巴好似锐利的刀刃， 锋利得无与伦比， 连大树都能一斩为二。
leafeon.flavorEn: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

leavanny.name: Leavanny
leavanny.flavorEn: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

lechonk.name: Lechonk
lechonk.flavorEn: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

ledian.name: Ledian
ledian.flavor: 在夜空中飞翔的同时 会抛撒闪闪发光的粉末。 据说粉末沾到身上就会有好事发生。
ledian.flavorEn: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

ledyba.name: Ledyba
ledyba.flavor: 非常胆小的宝可梦。 会和伙伴一起张开反射壁来保护巢穴。
ledyba.flavorEn: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

lickilicky.name: Lickilicky
lickilicky.flavor: 舌头的灵巧程度甚至不输给 人手，没有它做不到的事。 相反，手指却相当笨拙，
lickilicky.flavorEn: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

lickitung.name: Lickitung
lickitung.flavor: 主要以虫宝可梦为食。 会用长长的舌头舔对手， 等对手麻痹后将其整个吞下。
lickitung.flavorEn: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

liepard.name: Liepard
liepard.flavor: 和猾大狐争抢地盘。 能够悄无声息地 从背后偷偷靠近猎物。
liepard.flavorEn: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

lileep.name: Lileep
lileep.flavor: 会吸附在海底岩石上， 用花瓣一样的触手 缠住接近自己的猎物。
lileep.flavorEn: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

lilligant.name: Lilligant
lilligant.flavor: 用它的花朵制成的精油 虽有着极致香气，但价格 同时也贵得令人大跌眼镜。
lilligant.flavorEn: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

lilliganthisui.name: Lilligant-Hisui
lilliganthisui.flavor: 用它的花朵制成的精油 虽有着极致香气，但价格 同时也贵得令人大跌眼镜。
lilliganthisui.flavorEn: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

lillipup.name: Lillipup
lillipup.flavor: 比普通的小孩子还要 聪明许多。对于得到的关爱 和受到的伤害都不会忘怀。
lillipup.flavorEn: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

linoone.name: Linoone
linoone.flavor: 用自己超群的爆发力 和锐利的爪子来制服猎物。 不擅长在弯曲的道路上奔跑。
linoone.flavorEn: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

linoonegalar.name: Linoone-Galar
linoonegalar.flavor: 用自己超群的爆发力 和锐利的爪子来制服猎物。 不擅长在弯曲的道路上奔跑。
linoonegalar.flavorEn: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

litleo.name: Litleo
litleo.flavor: 血气方刚且好奇心旺盛。 如果生气或是开始战斗， 短短的鬃毛就会变热。
litleo.flavorEn: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

litten.name: Litten
litten.flavor: 如果在得到火斑喵的 信任前就想抚摸它的话， 要小心它用尖锐的爪子抓你。
litten.flavorEn: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

litwick.name: Litwick
litwick.flavor: 吸取到的灵魂越年轻， 头上的烛光就会 燃烧得越旺越诡异。
litwick.flavorEn: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

lokix.name: Lokix
lokix.flavorEn: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

lombre.name: Lombre
lombre.flavor: 住在日照良好的水边。 白天在水草做的床上睡觉， 太阳下山后就会出来活动。
lombre.flavorEn: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

lopunny.name: Lopunny
lopunny.flavor: 当高温的季节结束后， 就会换上富含空气的 体毛，准备抵御寒冷。
lopunny.flavorEn: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

lopunnymega.name: Lopunny-Mega
lopunnymega.flavor: 当高温的季节结束后， 就会换上富含空气的 体毛，准备抵御寒冷。
lopunnymega.flavorEn: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

lotad.name: Lotad
lotad.flavor: 因为叶子长得太大太重， 所以才会改变习性， 漂浮在水面上生活。
lotad.flavorEn: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.

loudred.name: Loudred
loudred.flavor: 它发出的大叫声不仅会刺激听觉， 还会压缩空气造成冲击波 将敌人吹飞给予伤害。
loudred.flavorEn: The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

lucario.name: Lucario
lucario.flavor: 他能理解人类的想法， 因此只会去亲近 内心端正的训练家。
lucario.flavorEn: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

lucariomega.name: Lucario-Mega
lucariomega.flavor: 他能理解人类的想法， 因此只会去亲近 内心端正的训练家。
lucariomega.flavorEn: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

lucariomegaz.name: Lucario-Mega-Z
lucariomegaz.flavor: 他能理解人类的想法， 因此只会去亲近 内心端正的训练家。
lucariomegaz.flavorEn: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

ludicolo.name: Ludicolo
ludicolo.flavor: 乐天河童会跟着 欢快的音乐摇摆身体， 从而增强自己的力量。
ludicolo.flavorEn: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.

lugia.name: Lugia
lugia.flavorEn: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

lumineon.name: Lumineon
lumineon.flavor: 像是爬行一样在深海的海底游泳。 鳍上发出的充满幻想的光 就像是夜空的星星。
lumineon.flavorEn: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

lunala.name: Lunala
lunala.flavor: 夺走四周所有的光， 自己则变身为满月的模样， 在黑夜中散发出光芒。
lunala.flavorEn: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

lunatone.name: Lunatone
lunatone.flavor: 第一次发现它是在 ４０年前陨石坠落的地方。 只要注视敌人就能使其入睡。
lunatone.flavorEn: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

lurantis.name: Lurantis
lurantis.flavor: 双臂的花瓣既薄 又锋利。还能够 积蓄阳光发射光束。
lurantis.flavorEn: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

lurantistotem.name: Lurantis-Totem
lurantistotem.flavor: 双臂的花瓣既薄 又锋利。还能够 积蓄阳光发射光束。
lurantistotem.flavorEn: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

luvdisc.name: Luvdisc
luvdisc.flavor: 温暖海域的珊瑚礁是它的栖息地。 特别喜欢在太阳珊瑚的枝条间睡觉。
luvdisc.flavorEn: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.

luxio.name: Luxio
luxio.flavor: 遇到敌人时会从脚 伸出有着百万伏特 威力的爪子来迎战。
luxio.flavorEn: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

luxray.name: Luxray
luxray.flavor: 由于透视需要消耗 大量的电能，因此它会 睡很长时间来积蓄能量。
luxray.flavorEn: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

lycanroc.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc.flavor: 会用敏捷的动作将猎物 一点一点逼入绝境。 利齿总是瞄准着对方的要害。
lycanroc.flavorEn: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

lycanrocdusk.name: Lycanroc-Dusk
lycanrocdusk.flavor: 会用敏捷的动作将猎物 一点一点逼入绝境。 利齿总是瞄准着对方的要害。
lycanrocdusk.flavorEn: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.
lycanrocdusk.evoCondition: from a special Rockruff during the evening

lycanrocmidnight.name: Lycanroc-Midnight
lycanrocmidnight.flavor: 会用敏捷的动作将猎物 一点一点逼入绝境。 利齿总是瞄准着对方的要害。
lycanrocmidnight.flavorEn: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

mabosstiff.name: Mabosstiff
mabosstiff.flavorEn: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

machamp.name: Machamp
machamp.flavor: ４只手臂在思考之前 就会反射性地行动， 使出多发拳击。
machamp.flavorEn: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

machampgmax.name: Machamp-Gmax
machampgmax.flavor: ４只手臂在思考之前 就会反射性地行动， 使出多发拳击。
machampgmax.flavorEn: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

machoke.name: Machoke
machoke.flavor: 有着不会疲劳的强韧肉体。 会去帮助人类完成例如 搬运沉重行李之类的工作。
machoke.flavorEn: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

machop.name: Machop
machop.flavor: 时时刻刻都充满力量。 由于体力过剩而去举起岩石 消磨时间，也因此变得更强。
machop.flavorEn: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

magby.name: Magby
magby.flavor: 栖息在火山地带。 会浸泡在岩浆中， 疗愈一整天的疲劳。
magby.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

magcargo.name: Magcargo
magcargo.flavorEn: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

magearna.name: Magearna
magearna.flavor: 大约５００年前由科学家制作而成。 被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
magearna.flavorEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

magearnamega.name: Magearna-Mega
magearnamega.flavor: 大约５００年前由科学家制作而成。 被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
magearnamega.flavorEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

magearnaoriginal.name: Magearna-Original
magearnaoriginal.flavor: 大约５００年前由科学家制作而成。 被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
magearnaoriginal.flavorEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

magearnaoriginalmega.name: Magearna-Original-Mega
magearnaoriginalmega.flavor: 大约５００年前由科学家制作而成。 被称为魂心的部分是它的本体。
magearnaoriginalmega.flavorEn: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

magikarp.name: Magikarp
magikarp.flavor: 又弱又可怜的宝可梦。 在水流比较快的地方 只能任凭自己被水冲走。
magikarp.flavorEn: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

magmar.name: Magmar
magmar.flavor: 全身时刻都在燃烧。 大家认为它是引发火灾的 原因之一，非常惧怕它。
magmar.flavorEn: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

magmortar.name: Magmortar
magmortar.flavor: 由于栖息在火山口，因此 身体逐渐变得像火山一样， 还长着类似岩浆库的器官。
magmortar.flavorEn: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

magnemite.name: Magnemite
magnemite.flavor: 靠吃电来维持生命。 会一边从左右两边的组件 放射电磁波一边在空中飞行。
magnemite.flavorEn: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

magneton.name: Magneton
magneton.flavor: 会不断释放很强的的磁力。 在三合一磁怪接近时，大多数 电脑都会发生异常情况。
magneton.flavorEn: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

magnezone.name: Magnezone
magnezone.flavor: 人们认为，它是因为受到特殊 磁场的影响，身体的分子构造 发生了变化，才进化成这样的。
magnezone.flavorEn: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

makuhita.name: Makuhita
makuhita.flavor: 据说为了培育强大的幕下力士， 存在着一种训练家们按传统 手法制作的火锅料理。
makuhita.flavorEn: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

malamar.name: Malamar
malamar.flavor: 据说那些能够改变历史 的重大事件其实都和 乌贼王的催眠能力有关。
malamar.flavorEn: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

malamarmega.name: Malamar-Mega
malamarmega.flavor: 据说那些能够改变历史 的重大事件其实都和 乌贼王的催眠能力有关。
malamarmega.flavorEn: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

mamoswine.name: Mamoswine
mamoswine.flavor: 它的力量就如外表那样强大。 天气越是寒冷，它的冰牙 就会长得越粗、越长、越结实。
mamoswine.flavorEn: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

manaphy.name: Manaphy
manaphy.flavorEn: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

mandibuzz.name: Mandibuzz
mandibuzz.flavor: 把捡来的骨头装饰在身上。 在骨头形状这方面 似乎也是有流行趋势的。
mandibuzz.flavorEn: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

manectric.name: Manectric
manectric.flavor: 极少出现在人前。 据说它的住所就在雷电落下的地方。
manectric.flavorEn: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

manectricmega.name: Manectric-Mega
manectricmega.flavor: 极少出现在人前。 据说它的住所就在雷电落下的地方。
manectricmega.flavorEn: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

mankey.name: Mankey
mankey.flavor: 身体轻盈，在树上生活。 常因鸡毛蒜皮的小事发火 而飞扑到周围的东西上。
mankey.flavorEn: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

mantine.name: Mantine
mantine.flavor: 悠然地畅游在大海中。 就算有觊觎食物残渣的铁炮鱼 吸附在自己身上也毫不在意。
mantine.flavorEn: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

mantyke.name: Mantyke
mantyke.flavor: 混在铁炮鱼的大群里游泳。 受到敌人袭击的时候， 会和铁炮鱼们并肩作战。
mantyke.flavorEn: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

maractus.name: Maractus
maractus.flavor: 一年散播一次种子。 花的种子营养十足， 是沙漠中贵重的食粮。
maractus.flavorEn: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

mareanie.name: Mareanie
mareanie.flavor: 和阿罗拉的好坏星不同， 伽勒尔的好坏星还没发现到 太阳珊瑚的枝有多好吃。
mareanie.flavorEn: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

mareep.name: Mareep
mareep.flavor: 绒毛摩擦产生的电力会被储存起来。 如果觉得可爱而直接用手碰它的话， 就会被啪地一下电得又麻又痛。
mareep.flavorEn: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

marill.name: Marill
marill.flavor: 体毛的防水性能很好， 就算是从冰冷的海里上岸， 身体也会立刻干掉，一点都不冷。
marill.flavorEn: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.

marowak.name: Marowak
marowak.flavor: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的 母亲头骨完全融为一体， 而且性格也变得十分凶暴。
marowak.flavorEn: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

marowakalola.name: Marowak-Alola
marowakalola.flavor: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的 母亲头骨完全融为一体， 而且性格也变得十分凶暴。
marowakalola.flavorEn: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

marowakalolatotem.name: Marowak-Alola-Totem
marowakalolatotem.flavor: 进化后，与原本戴在头上的 母亲头骨完全融为一体， 而且性格也变得十分凶暴。
marowakalolatotem.flavorEn: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

marshadow.name: Marshadow
marshadow.flavor: 拥有潜入一切影子里的能力， 所以在很长一段时间里 都没有任何人发现它。
marshadow.flavorEn: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

marshtomp.name: Marshtomp
marshtomp.flavorEn: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

maschiff.name: Maschiff
maschiff.flavorEn: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

masquerain.name: Masquerain
masquerain.flavor: 像薄薄的翅膀一样的触角 很容易吸收湿气。 雨天会静静地待在树洞等地方度过。
masquerain.flavorEn: Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.

maushold.name: Maushold
maushold.flavorEn: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

mausholdfour.name: Maushold-Four
mausholdfour.flavorEn: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

mawile.name: Mawile
mawile.flavor: 大嘴娃能用自己那由钢角 变化而成的巨大颚部 将对手一口紧紧咬住。
mawile.flavorEn: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

mawilemega.name: Mawile-Mega
mawilemega.flavor: 大嘴娃能用自己那由钢角 变化而成的巨大颚部 将对手一口紧紧咬住。
mawilemega.flavorEn: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

medicham.name: Medicham
medicham.flavorEn: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

medichammega.name: Medicham-Mega
medichammega.flavorEn: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

meditite.name: Meditite
meditite.flavorEn: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.

meganium.name: Meganium
meganium.flavorEn: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

meganiummega.name: Meganium-Mega
meganiummega.flavorEn: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

melmetal.name: Melmetal
melmetal.flavor: 美录梅塔利用离心力带动 沉重的螺帽挥出的拳击 被认为是宝可梦界之最。
melmetal.flavorEn: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

melmetalgmax.name: Melmetal-Gmax
melmetalgmax.flavor: 美录梅塔利用离心力带动 沉重的螺帽挥出的拳击 被认为是宝可梦界之最。
melmetalgmax.flavorEn: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

meloetta.name: Meloetta
meloetta.flavorEn: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

meloettapirouette.name: Meloetta-Pirouette
meloettapirouette.flavorEn: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

meltan.name: Meltan
meltan.flavor: 美录坦们虽然聚在一起生活， 但当时机到来，会由最强的那１只 吸收其他的伙伴来进化。
meltan.flavorEn: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

meowscarada.name: Meowscarada
meowscarada.flavorEn: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

meowstic.name: Meowstic
meowstic.flavor: 雄性的防卫本能很强， 在保护自己和伙伴时 能发挥最大的威力。
meowstic.flavorEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

meowsticf.name: Meowstic-F
meowsticf.flavor: 雄性的防卫本能很强， 在保护自己和伙伴时 能发挥最大的威力。
meowsticf.flavorEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

meowsticfmega.name: Meowstic-F-Mega
meowsticfmega.flavor: 雄性的防卫本能很强， 在保护自己和伙伴时 能发挥最大的威力。
meowsticfmega.flavorEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

meowsticmmega.name: Meowstic-M-Mega
meowsticmmega.flavor: 雄性的防卫本能很强， 在保护自己和伙伴时 能发挥最大的威力。
meowsticmmega.flavorEn: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

meowth.name: Meowth
meowth.flavor: 为了不弄脏额头上的 金币，会常常洗脸。 和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
meowth.flavorEn: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

meowthalola.name: Meowth-Alola
meowthalola.flavor: 为了不弄脏额头上的 金币，会常常洗脸。 和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
meowthalola.flavorEn: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

meowthgalar.name: Meowth-Galar
meowthgalar.flavor: 为了不弄脏额头上的 金币，会常常洗脸。 和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
meowthgalar.flavorEn: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

meowthgmax.name: Meowth-Gmax
meowthgmax.flavor: 为了不弄脏额头上的 金币，会常常洗脸。 和伽勒尔的喵喵关系不好。
meowthgmax.flavorEn: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

mesprit.name: Mesprit
mesprit.flavorEn: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

metagross.name: Metagross
metagross.flavor: ２只金属怪组合起来的样子。 运用堪比超级计算机的 头脑打败敌人。
metagross.flavorEn: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

metagrossmega.name: Metagross-Mega
metagrossmega.flavor: ２只金属怪组合起来的样子。 运用堪比超级计算机的 头脑打败敌人。
metagrossmega.flavorEn: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

metang.name: Metang
metang.flavor: 依靠磁力飞行。能够在空中 以高速穿过险峻的山岳， 让追捕的猎物无处可逃。
metang.flavorEn: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

metapod.name: Metapod
metapod.flavor: 虽然有坚硬的外壳， 因为壳里的身体很软， 所以无法抵抗强力的攻击。
metapod.flavorEn: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
