mew.name: Mew
mew.flavor: 用显微镜可以看到 它身上极短极细 且密集的体毛。
mew.flavorEn: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

mewtwo.name: Mewtwo
mewtwo.flavor: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻 完全一样，但是大小和 性格却迥异得让人吃惊。
mewtwo.flavorEn: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

mewtwomegax.name: Mewtwo-Mega-X
mewtwomegax.flavor: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻 完全一样，但是大小和 性格却迥异得让人吃惊。
mewtwomegax.flavorEn: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

mewtwomegay.name: Mewtwo-Mega-Y
mewtwomegay.flavor: 超梦的基因几乎和梦幻 完全一样，但是大小和 性格却迥异得让人吃惊。
mewtwomegay.flavorEn: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

mienfoo.name: Mienfoo
mienfoo.flavor: 个头虽小脾气却很暴躁。 面对疏忽大意接近自己的 对手，会施展出华丽的连击。
mienfoo.flavorEn: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

mienshao.name: Mienshao
mienshao.flavor: 以迅雷不及掩耳的速度 使出踢击，即使是巨大的 岩石也能击得粉碎。
mienshao.flavorEn: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

mightyena.name: Mightyena
mightyena.flavorEn: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.

milcery.name: Milcery
milcery.flavor: 据说有小仙奶 现身过的蛋糕店 保证能生意兴隆。
milcery.flavorEn: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

milotic.name: Milotic
milotic.flavor: 据说目睹了美纳斯美丽 身姿的人，心中一切的 愤恨都能得到抚慰。
milotic.flavorEn: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

miltank.name: Miltank
miltank.flavor: 如果不每天帮它挤鲜奶， 它的身体就会不舒服。 鲜奶的味道会随季节改变。
miltank.flavorEn: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.

mimejr.name: Mime Jr.
mimejr.flavor: 像徒弟一样跟随着 擅长跳舞的踏冰人偶， 拼命模仿它的舞步。
mimejr.flavorEn: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

mimikyu.name: Mimikyu
mimikyu.flavor: 有一位学者为了研究 而看了它的破布里面， 结果患上怪病而离开人世。
mimikyu.flavorEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

mimikyubusted.name: Mimikyu-Busted
mimikyubusted.flavor: 有一位学者为了研究 而看了它的破布里面， 结果患上怪病而离开人世。
mimikyubusted.flavorEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

mimikyubustedtotem.name: Mimikyu-Busted-Totem
mimikyubustedtotem.flavor: 有一位学者为了研究 而看了它的破布里面， 结果患上怪病而离开人世。
mimikyubustedtotem.flavorEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

mimikyutotem.name: Mimikyu-Totem
mimikyutotem.flavor: 有一位学者为了研究 而看了它的破布里面， 结果患上怪病而离开人世。
mimikyutotem.flavorEn: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

minccino.name: Minccino
minccino.flavor: 用尾巴互相抚摸来打招呼。 尾巴的毛比较蓬松的那一方 会表现得稍微威风些。
minccino.flavorEn: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

minior.name: Minior
minior.flavor: 外壳非常坚固，但落到地上的 冲击会让它碎成细屑。
minior.flavorEn: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

miniormeteor.name: Minior-Meteor
miniormeteor.flavor: 外壳非常坚固，但落到地上的 冲击会让它碎成细屑。
miniormeteor.flavorEn: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

minun.name: Minun
minun.flavorEn: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.

miraidon.name: Miraidon
miraidon.flavorEn: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

misdreavus.name: Misdreavus
misdreavus.flavor: 会通过模仿人哭叫的声音 来吓唬大家并以此为乐。 不擅长对付胆大的对手。
misdreavus.flavorEn: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

mismagius.name: Mismagius
mismagius.flavor: 会吟诵诅咒的语言， 让对方极度头疼，或是看到 恐怖的幻觉，深受折磨。
mismagius.flavorEn: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

moltres.name: Moltres
moltres.flavor: 相传它会用燃烧着的 美丽翅膀照亮山道， 救助在此遇险的人。
moltres.flavorEn: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

moltresgalar.name: Moltres-Galar
moltresgalar.flavor: 相传它会用燃烧着的 美丽翅膀照亮山道， 救助在此遇险的人。
moltresgalar.flavorEn: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

monferno.name: Monferno
monferno.flavorEn: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

morelull.name: Morelull
morelull.flavor: 白天也生活在昏暗的森林里。 会一边闪烁一边散播发光的孢子 来让敌人陷入沉睡。
morelull.flavorEn: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

morgrem.name: Morgrem
morgrem.flavor: 喜欢动歪脑筋，把人们 引诱到深夜的森林中。 似乎拥有培育农作物的能力。
morgrem.flavorEn: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

morpeko.name: Morpeko
morpeko.flavor: 无论怎么吃都会马上肚子饿。 十分珍爱自己用电烘烤过的 种子，随时都带在身上。
morpeko.flavorEn: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

morpekohangry.name: Morpeko-Hangry
morpekohangry.flavor: 无论怎么吃都会马上肚子饿。 十分珍爱自己用电烘烤过的 种子，随时都带在身上。
morpekohangry.flavorEn: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

mothim.name: Mothim
mothim.flavorEn: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

mrmime.name: Mr. Mime
mrmime.flavor: 擅长表演默剧。 用手指放出的波动制造墙壁， 保护自己免于大多数攻击。
mrmime.flavorEn: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

mrmimegalar.name: Mr. Mime-Galar
mrmimegalar.flavor: 擅长表演默剧。 用手指放出的波动制造墙壁， 保护自己免于大多数攻击。
mrmimegalar.flavorEn: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

mrrime.name: Mr. Rime
mrrime.flavor: 幽默的动作使它获得了 众人的喜爱。能从腹部的 图案释放出精神力量。
mrrime.flavorEn: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

mudbray.name: Mudbray
mudbray.flavor: 在把自己吃土制造出的泥巴 涂在脚上之后，无论走在路况 多么差的路上都不会打滑。
mudbray.flavorEn: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

mudkip.name: Mudkip
mudkip.flavorEn: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

mudsdale.name: Mudsdale
mudsdale.flavor: 拥有很强的耐力， 可以不眠不休地拉着１０吨重的 货物纵贯伽勒尔地区。
mudsdale.flavorEn: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

muk.name: Muk
muk.flavor: 非常难闻！气味臭到让人 窒息，但由于鼻子的退化， 它自己完全闻不到味道。
muk.flavorEn: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

mukalola.name: Muk-Alola
mukalola.flavor: 非常难闻！气味臭到让人 窒息，但由于鼻子的退化， 它自己完全闻不到味道。
mukalola.flavorEn: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

munchlax.name: Munchlax
munchlax.flavor: 在体毛下面储存食物。 如果是自己信赖的对象， 也会把食物分给对方一口。
munchlax.flavorEn: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

munkidori.name: Munkidori
munkidori.flavorEn: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

munna.name: Munna
munna.flavor: 在吃掉梦之后会吐出烟雾。 吃了快乐的梦时，烟雾是粉红色的； 如果是噩梦，烟雾则是黑灰色的。
munna.flavorEn: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

murkrow.name: Murkrow
murkrow.flavor: 会为老大去寻找闪闪发光的东西。 据说它很不吉利，厌恶它的人也很多。
murkrow.flavorEn: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

musharna.name: Musharna
musharna.flavor: 总是在打瞌睡做梦。 刚睡醒的时候会闹脾气， 所以最好别去招惹它。
musharna.flavorEn: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

nacli.name: Nacli
nacli.flavorEn: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

naclstack.name: Naclstack
naclstack.flavorEn: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

naganadel.name: Naganadel
naganadel.flavor: 究极异兽中的一种。 会从毒针发射出 黏性很大又发光的毒液。
naganadel.flavorEn: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

natu.name: Natu
natu.flavor: 由于羽翼未丰， 所以会跳着移动。 一直在注视着什么。
natu.flavorEn: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

necrozma.name: Necrozma
necrozma.flavor: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。 会发射出激光， 将所有东西切成碎片。
necrozma.flavorEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

necrozmadawnwings.name: Necrozma-Dawn-Wings
necrozmadawnwings.flavor: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。 会发射出激光， 将所有东西切成碎片。
necrozmadawnwings.flavorEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

necrozmaduskmane.name: Necrozma-Dusk-Mane
necrozmaduskmane.flavor: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。 会发射出激光， 将所有东西切成碎片。
necrozmaduskmane.flavorEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

necrozmaultra.name: Necrozma-Ultra
necrozmaultra.flavor: 为生存而发狂般地寻找着光。 会发射出激光， 将所有东西切成碎片。
necrozmaultra.flavorEn: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

nickit.name: Nickit
nickit.flavor: 性格谨慎且狡猾。 在偷盗食物逃走的时候 会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。
nickit.flavorEn: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

nidoking.name: Nidoking
nidoking.flavor: 以力量为傲的宝可梦。 用自己的粗尾巴和连钻石 都能击碎的角，豪爽地战斗。
nidoking.flavorEn: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

nidoqueen.name: Nidoqueen
nidoqueen.flavor: 把孩子放在背上刺与刺的 空隙里来哄它们。在这时 绝对不会释放毒素。
nidoqueen.flavorEn: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

nidoranf.name: Nidoran-F
nidoranf.flavor: 用坚硬的门牙咬碎 树果吃。和雄性相比， 角的尖端稍圆一些。
nidoranf.flavorEn: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.

nidoranm.name: Nidoran-M
nidoranm.flavor: 身材虽小，却性格勇敢。 为了保护相好的雌性， 会不顾生命果敢地战斗。
nidoranm.flavorEn: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

nidorina.name: Nidorina
nidorina.flavor: 如果族群遇到了危险， 会和伙伴们团结起来， 施展出超音波大合唱。
nidorina.flavorEn: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

nidorino.name: Nidorino
nidorino.flavor: 神经敏感，动不动就打架。 体内的肾上腺素一增加， 毒素的浓度也会提高。
nidorino.flavorEn: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

nihilego.name: Nihilego
nihilego.flavor: 从究极之洞出现，来到这个世界。 好像会寄生在宝可梦或 人类的身上生存下去。
nihilego.flavorEn: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

nincada.name: Nincada
nincada.flavor: 有时能在土里生活１０年以上。 会从树木的根部那里吸取营养。
nincada.flavorEn: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

ninetales.name: Ninetales
ninetales.flavor: 聪明伶俐，但爱记仇。 据说如果敢乱抓它的尾巴， 它就会缠着你作祟１０００年。
ninetales.flavorEn: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

ninetalesalola.name: Ninetales-Alola
ninetalesalola.flavor: 聪明伶俐，但爱记仇。 据说如果敢乱抓它的尾巴， 它就会缠着你作祟１０００年。
ninetalesalola.flavorEn: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

ninjask.name: Ninjask
ninjask.flavor: 行动十分迅速的宝可梦。 说它无论什么攻击都能避开也不夸张。 非常喜欢甘甜的树液。
ninjask.flavorEn: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

noctowl.name: Noctowl
noctowl.flavor: 开始思考事情时， 会将脖子旋转１８０度， 以此提高大脑的工作效率。
noctowl.flavorEn: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

noibat.name: Noibat
noibat.flavor: 可以控制所有频率的音波。 就算是体型巨大的宝可梦， 也对它的超音波束手无策。
noibat.flavorEn: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

noivern.name: Noivern
noivern.flavor: 在黑暗中一边飞行一边发出 能粉碎岩石的超音波痛击敌人， 然后用利齿给予致命的一击。
noivern.flavorEn: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

nosepass.name: Nosepass
nosepass.flavor: 它会一动不动地用强力的 磁力将猎物吸过来狩猎。 但有时也会吸到天敌。
nosepass.flavorEn: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

numel.name: Numel
numel.flavorEn: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.

nuzleaf.name: Nuzleaf
nuzleaf.flavor: 长鼻叶居住在大树上的洞穴里， 它吹奏出的草笛声 会让听到的人感到不安。
nuzleaf.flavorEn: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

nymble.name: Nymble
nymble.flavorEn: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

obstagoon.name: Obstagoon
obstagoon.flavor: 在不断的斗争中得到了进化。 它交叉着双臂发出的怒吼 能让一切对手都为之胆怯。
obstagoon.flavorEn: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

octillery.name: Octillery
octillery.flavor: 有着结实的坚硬脑袋。 会用带吸盘的脚缠住对手， 然后再一个劲地用头猛撞。
octillery.flavorEn: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

oddish.name: Oddish
oddish.flavor: 白天会为躲避太阳 而钻入凉爽的地下。 会通过沐浴月光成长。
oddish.flavorEn: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

ogerpon.name: Ogerpon
ogerpon.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponcornerstone.name: Ogerpon-Cornerstone
ogerponcornerstone.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponcornerstonetera.name: Ogerpon-Cornerstone-Tera
ogerponcornerstonetera.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponhearthflame.name: Ogerpon-Hearthflame
ogerponhearthflame.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponhearthflametera.name: Ogerpon-Hearthflame-Tera
ogerponhearthflametera.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerpontealtera.name: Ogerpon-Teal-Tera
ogerpontealtera.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponwellspring.name: Ogerpon-Wellspring
ogerponwellspring.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

ogerponwellspringtera.name: Ogerpon-Wellspring-Tera
ogerponwellspringtera.flavorEn: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

oinkologne.name: Oinkologne
oinkologne.flavorEn: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

oinkolognef.name: Oinkologne-F
oinkolognef.flavorEn: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

okidogi.name: Okidogi
okidogi.flavorEn: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

omanyte.name: Omanyte
omanyte.flavor: 已经灭绝的古代宝可梦。 依靠１０只脚来划水， 在水中轻盈地游曳。
omanyte.flavorEn: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

omastar.name: Omastar
omastar.flavor: 拥有足以咬碎岩石的锋利牙齿， 但是能够袭击的猎物仅限 触手可以伸展的范围之内。
omastar.flavorEn: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

onix.name: Onix
onix.flavor: 弯曲扭动巨大结实的身体， 以时速８０公里的 猛烈劲头向前挖进。
onix.flavorEn: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

oranguru.name: Oranguru
oranguru.flavor: 对森林的各个角落都了如指掌。 如果有宝可梦受伤了， 就会去寻找药草为它们治疗。
oranguru.flavorEn: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

orbeetle.name: Orbeetle
orbeetle.flavor: 释放出精神力量来调查 周围的情况。它的侦测范围 甚至可以达到方圆１０公里。
orbeetle.flavorEn: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

orbeetlegmax.name: Orbeetle-Gmax
orbeetlegmax.flavor: 释放出精神力量来调查 周围的情况。它的侦测范围 甚至可以达到方圆１０公里。
orbeetlegmax.flavorEn: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

oricorio.name: Oricorio
oricorio.flavor: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。 训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。 是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
oricorio.flavorEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

oricoriopau.name: Oricorio-Pa'u
oricoriopau.flavor: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。 训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。 是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
oricoriopau.flavorEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

oricoriopompom.name: Oricorio-Pom-Pom
oricoriopompom.flavor: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。 训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。 是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
oricoriopompom.flavorEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

oricoriosensu.name: Oricorio-Sensu
oricoriosensu.flavor: 吸食了朱红色花蜜的花舞鸟。 训练家弄错指示的话就会非常生气。 是情感变化非常剧烈的家伙。
oricoriosensu.flavorEn: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

orthworm.name: Orthworm
orthworm.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

oshawott.name: Oshawott
oshawott.flavorEn: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

overqwil.name: Overqwil
overqwil.flavorEn: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
overqwil.evoCondition: Use Strong style Barb Barrage 20 times

pachirisu.name: Pachirisu
pachirisu.flavorEn: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

palafin.name: Palafin
palafin.flavorEn: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

palafinhero.name: Palafin-Hero
palafinhero.flavorEn: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

palkia.name: Palkia
palkia.flavorEn: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

palkiaorigin.name: Palkia-Origin
palkiaorigin.flavorEn: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

palossand.name: Palossand
palossand.flavor: 虽然住在沙滩上，但是 讨厌水。要是淋了大雨， 就无法维持城堡的造型。
palossand.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

palpitoad.name: Palpitoad
palpitoad.flavor: 有时也会发出悦耳的叫声。 身上突起物越大的蓝蟾蜍 越能在更广的音域来鸣叫。
palpitoad.flavorEn: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

pancham.name: Pancham
pancham.flavor: 为了不被小看而一直瞪着对手， 然而绷紧的神经一旦稍有放松， 它就会在无意中露出笑脸。
pancham.flavorEn: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

pangoro.name: Pangoro
pangoro.flavor: 通过叶子来洞悉敌人的动向。 只要使出一记拳击就能 让大型翻斗车变成废铁。
pangoro.flavorEn: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
pangoro.evoCondition: with a Dark-type in the party

panpour.name: Panpour
panpour.flavorEn: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

pansage.name: Pansage
pansage.flavorEn: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

pansear.name: Pansear
pansear.flavorEn: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

paras.name: Paras
paras.flavor: 它会通过挖洞来从树根里 吸取营养，但大部分营养 都会被背上的蘑菇抢走。
paras.flavorEn: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

parasect.name: Parasect
parasect.flavor: 由于虫子的精华不断被吸走， 在思考的似乎已经不是虫子， 而是背上的蘑菇了。
parasect.flavorEn: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

passimian.name: Passimian
passimian.flavor: ２０几只形成团队来生活。 靠着每个成员明确的分工， 在严苛的大自然中生存下来。
passimian.flavorEn: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

patrat.name: Patrat
patrat.flavorEn: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

pawmi.name: Pawmi
pawmi.flavorEn: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

pawmo.name: Pawmo
pawmo.flavorEn: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

pawmot.name: Pawmot
pawmot.flavorEn: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

pawniard.name: Pawniard
pawniard.flavor: 以劈斩司令为首领组成族群。 目标是有朝一日能统领同类， 所以每天都在不懈地锻炼。
pawniard.flavorEn: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

pecharunt.name: Pecharunt
pecharunt.flavorEn: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

pelipper.name: Pelipper
pelipper.flavor: 会贴着海面飞行， 用大大的鸟嘴连着海水一起 把食物捞起来带走。
pelipper.flavorEn: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

perrserker.name: Perrserker
perrserker.flavor: 在日复一日的战斗中得以进化。 进化的结果是那危险的指甲， 留长后能当作短剑来用。
perrserker.flavorEn: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

persian.name: Persian
persian.flavor: 拥有优雅高贵的身姿。 与野蛮的喵头目性格不合， 互相看不起对方。
persian.flavorEn: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

persianalola.name: Persian-Alola
persianalola.flavor: 拥有优雅高贵的身姿。 与野蛮的喵头目性格不合， 互相看不起对方。
persianalola.flavorEn: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

petilil.name: Petilil
petilil.flavor: 叶子的颜色越深就越健康。 有时也会在被精心照料过的 田地或花坛里定居下来。
petilil.flavorEn: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

phanpy.name: Phanpy
phanpy.flavorEn: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

phantump.name: Phantump
phantump.flavor: 用类似人类小孩的声音鸣叫， 把大人引到森林的深处， 让他们在其中迷失方向。
phantump.flavorEn: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

pheromosa.name: Pheromosa
pheromosa.flavor: 在这个世界是异类，很危险， 但在它原本栖息的世界， 好像只是寻常能见的生物。
pheromosa.flavorEn: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

phione.name: Phione
phione.flavorEn: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

pichu.name: Pichu
pichu.flavor: 脸颊上的电囊还很小， 如果囊里的电太多了， 就会漏出来电到自己。
pichu.flavorEn: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

pichuspikyeared.name: Pichu-Spiky-eared
pichuspikyeared.flavor: 脸颊上的电囊还很小， 如果囊里的电太多了， 就会漏出来电到自己。
pichuspikyeared.flavorEn: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

pidgeot.name: Pidgeot
pidgeot.flavor: 以２马赫的飞行速度来 觅食。它巨大的爪子是 非常令人惧怕的武器。
pidgeot.flavorEn: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

pidgeotmega.name: Pidgeot-Mega
pidgeotmega.flavor: 以２马赫的飞行速度来 觅食。它巨大的爪子是 非常令人惧怕的武器。
pidgeotmega.flavorEn: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

pidgeotto.name: Pidgeotto
pidgeotto.flavor: 拥有超群的体力，而且 飞翔范围广，经常飞到 很远的地方寻找食物。
pidgeotto.flavorEn: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

pidgey.name: Pidgey
pidgey.flavor: 性格沉着冷静，即使受到 攻击也很少反击，只会朝 对手扬起沙子保护自己。
pidgey.flavorEn: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

pidove.name: Pidove
pidove.flavor: 虽然既健忘又不太聪明， 因为性格认真且容易亲近人， 所以受到了许多训练家的喜爱。
pidove.flavorEn: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

pignite.name: Pignite
pignite.flavorEn: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

pikachu.name: Pikachu
pikachu.flavor: 皮卡丘们把尾巴 贴在一起交换电流， 其实是在互相打招呼。
pikachu.flavorEn: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

pikachualola.flavor: 皮卡丘们把尾巴 贴在一起交换电流， 其实是在互相打招呼。

pikachuunova.flavorEn: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

pikachuworld.name: Pikachu-World
pikachuworld.flavor: 皮卡丘们把尾巴 贴在一起交换电流， 其实是在互相打招呼。
pikachuworld.flavorEn: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

pikipek.name: Pikipek
pikipek.flavor: 拥有看着很细， 却很强韧的颈部肌肉。 能以每秒１６连击的速度猛啄树木。
pikipek.flavorEn: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

piloswine.name: Piloswine
piloswine.flavor: 虽然４只脚很短， 但因为蹄子很宽很粗糙， 所以就算在雪地上行走也不会打滑。
piloswine.flavorEn: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

pincurchin.name: Pincurchin
pincurchin.flavor: 每根刺里都储存着电力。 即使是折断的刺也至少 能连续放电３小时。
pincurchin.flavorEn: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.

pineco.name: Pineco
pineco.flavor: 会用唾液将树皮粘在自己身上， 从而让自己变得又厚又大。 上了年纪的榛果球是无比巨大的。
pineco.flavorEn: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

pinsir.name: Pinsir
pinsir.flavor: 用角夹住猎物后， 不是直接把对方切成两半， 就是强行把对方扔飞。
pinsir.flavorEn: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

pinsirmega.name: Pinsir-Mega
pinsirmega.flavor: 用角夹住猎物后， 不是直接把对方切成两半， 就是强行把对方扔飞。
pinsirmega.flavorEn: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

piplup.name: Piplup
piplup.flavorEn: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

plusle.name: Plusle
plusle.flavorEn: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

poipole.name: Poipole
poipole.flavor: 栖息在异世界的究极异兽。 会从头部的毒针朝对手 喷出毒液，咯咯咯大笑。
poipole.flavorEn: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

politoed.name: Politoed
politoed.flavor: 雄性的叫声更响亮。 叫声低沉可怕的蚊香蛙皇 更能受到雌性的欢迎。
politoed.flavorEn: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.

poliwag.name: Poliwag
poliwag.flavor: 在水流湍急的河里， 会把厚厚的嘴唇像吸盘那样 紧紧吸在岩石上避免被冲走。
poliwag.flavorEn: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

poliwhirl.name: Poliwhirl
poliwhirl.flavor: 流出的汗是黏滑的粘液状。 即使被敌人捉住， 也能哧溜一下滑走逃脱。
poliwhirl.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

poliwrath.name: Poliwrath
poliwrath.flavor: 除了游泳还擅长格斗技。 能用经过锻炼的手臂 使出豪迈强力的拳击。
poliwrath.flavorEn: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

poltchageist.name: Poltchageist
poltchageist.flavorEn: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

poltchageistartisan.name: Poltchageist-Artisan
poltchageistartisan.flavorEn: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

polteageist.name: Polteageist
polteageist.flavor: 每当发现喝剩的红茶， 它就会把自己的身体倒进去， 让那壶红茶变成怖思壶。
polteageist.flavorEn: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

polteageistantique.name: Polteageist-Antique
polteageistantique.flavor: 每当发现喝剩的红茶， 它就会把自己的身体倒进去， 让那壶红茶变成怖思壶。
polteageistantique.flavorEn: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

ponyta.name: Ponyta
ponyta.flavor: 得到了小火马认可的人， 在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时 不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。
ponyta.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

ponytagalar.name: Ponyta-Galar
ponytagalar.flavor: 得到了小火马认可的人， 在触摸它燃烧着的鬃毛时 不会觉得烫手，真是不可思议。
ponytagalar.flavorEn: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

poochyena.name: Poochyena
poochyena.flavorEn: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

popplio.name: Popplio
popplio.flavor: 每天拼命地练习， 才终于能够制造出 又大又好用的气球。
popplio.flavorEn: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

porygon.name: Porygon
porygon.flavor: 近年来十分活跃于 电脑空间。到处检查 有没有可疑的数据。
porygon.flavorEn: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

porygon2.name: Porygon2
porygon2.flavor: 在装载了ＡＩ功能后， 多边兽２型便开始用只有彼此 能懂的神秘语言互相交流了。
porygon2.flavorEn: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

porygonz.name: Porygon-Z
porygonz.flavor: 有人说它是通过追加程序进化的， 但关于它的改变是否真是进化， 在学会中也存在着意见分歧。
porygonz.flavorEn: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

primarina.name: Primarina
primarina.flavor: 对战就是西狮海壬的舞台。 它那歌声和舞动气球的样子 使观战的人们为之倾倒。
primarina.flavorEn: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

primeape.name: Primeape
primeape.flavor: 只有在谁都不在身边的 时候才不生气，但几乎 没有人目击过这种情况。
primeape.flavorEn: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

prinplup.name: Prinplup
prinplup.flavorEn: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

probopass.name: Probopass
probopass.flavor: 使用３个小部件获取食物， 或是和敌人战斗。 本体基本上只负责下命令。
probopass.flavorEn: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

psyduck.name: Psyduck
psyduck.flavor: 头痛会随着压力逐渐累积 而不断加剧。会用强大的 念力击垮周围的一切。
psyduck.flavorEn: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

pumpkaboo.name: Pumpkaboo
pumpkaboo.flavor: 南瓜的洞里发出的光 会催眠并控制 看到它的人和宝可梦。
pumpkaboo.flavorEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

pumpkaboolarge.name: Pumpkaboo-Large
pumpkaboolarge.flavor: 南瓜的洞里发出的光 会催眠并控制 看到它的人和宝可梦。
pumpkaboolarge.flavorEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

pumpkaboosmall.name: Pumpkaboo-Small
pumpkaboosmall.flavor: 南瓜的洞里发出的光 会催眠并控制 看到它的人和宝可梦。
pumpkaboosmall.flavorEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

pumpkaboosuper.name: Pumpkaboo-Super
pumpkaboosuper.flavor: 南瓜的洞里发出的光 会催眠并控制 看到它的人和宝可梦。
pumpkaboosuper.flavorEn: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

pupitar.name: Pupitar
pupitar.flavor: 虽然是蛹却不会呆着不动。 在坚硬的甲壳之下 已经长出了手脚。
pupitar.flavorEn: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

purrloin.name: Purrloin
purrloin.flavor: 会用可爱的动作让对手放下戒心， 趁对方靠过来时冷不防地用爪子 猛抓，然后得意地大笑。
purrloin.flavorEn: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

purugly.name: Purugly
purugly.flavorEn: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

pyroar.name: Pyroar
pyroar.flavor: 会吐出摄氏６０００度的气息， 但不会用于猎物。 因为更喜欢吃生的肉。
pyroar.flavorEn: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

pyroarmega.name: Pyroar-Mega
pyroarmega.flavor: 会吐出摄氏６０００度的气息， 但不会用于猎物。 因为更喜欢吃生的肉。
pyroarmega.flavorEn: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

pyukumuku.name: Pyukumuku
pyukumuku.flavor: 覆盖着皮肤的粘液 具有出众的保湿效果， 即使在陆地上待好几天也不会干掉。
pyukumuku.flavorEn: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

quagsire.name: Quagsire
quagsire.flavor: 身体总是滑溜溜的。 虽然游泳时头总会撞到河底， 但它自己毫不在意。
quagsire.flavorEn: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.

quaquaval.name: Quaquaval
quaquaval.flavorEn: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

quaxly.name: Quaxly
quaxly.flavorEn: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

quaxwell.name: Quaxwell
quaxwell.flavorEn: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

quilava.name: Quilava
quilava.flavorEn: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

quilladin.name: Quilladin
quilladin.flavorEn: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

qwilfish.name: Qwilfish
qwilfish.flavor: 全身上下的小针都是由鳞片 变化而来的。如果被刺中的话， 就会因中毒而昏迷。
qwilfish.flavorEn: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

qwilfishhisui.name: Qwilfish-Hisui
qwilfishhisui.flavor: 全身上下的小针都是由鳞片 变化而来的。如果被刺中的话， 就会因中毒而昏迷。
qwilfishhisui.flavorEn: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

raboot.name: Raboot
raboot.flavor: 会用脚把树果从树木上 踢落，用来练习颠球， 借此锻炼自己的脚法。
raboot.flavorEn: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

rabsca.name: Rabsca
rabsca.flavorEn: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

ragingbolt.name: Raging Bolt
ragingbolt.flavorEn: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

raichu.name: Raichu
raichu.flavor: 如果电囊空了， 它就会直直地竖起尾巴， 收集空气中的电流。
raichu.flavorEn: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

raichualola.name: Raichu-Alola
raichualola.flavor: 如果电囊空了， 它就会直直地竖起尾巴， 收集空气中的电流。
raichualola.flavorEn: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

raichumegax.name: Raichu-Mega-X
raichumegax.flavor: 如果电囊空了， 它就会直直地竖起尾巴， 收集空气中的电流。
raichumegax.flavorEn: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

raichumegay.name: Raichu-Mega-Y
raichumegay.flavor: 如果电囊空了， 它就会直直地竖起尾巴， 收集空气中的电流。
raichumegay.flavorEn: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

raikou.name: Raikou
raikou.flavorEn: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

ralts.name: Ralts
ralts.flavor: 用红色的角捕捉到 人和宝可梦的温情后， 全身也会稍稍变暖起来。
ralts.flavorEn: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

rampardos.name: Rampardos
rampardos.flavor: 擅长头锤的古代宝可梦。 因为大脑真的很小， 所以也有说法它是因愚笨而灭亡的。
rampardos.flavorEn: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

rapidash.name: Rapidash
rapidash.flavor: 奔跑速度最快的烈焰马 会成为首领，决定族群 前往的地点和奔跑速度。
rapidash.flavorEn: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

rapidashgalar.name: Rapidash-Galar
rapidashgalar.flavor: 奔跑速度最快的烈焰马 会成为首领，决定族群 前往的地点和奔跑速度。
rapidashgalar.flavorEn: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

raticate.name: Raticate
raticate.flavor: 它的后脚上长着 小蹼，以便它在 水中游泳寻找食物。
raticate.flavorEn: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

raticatealola.name: Raticate-Alola
raticatealola.flavor: 它的后脚上长着 小蹼，以便它在 水中游泳寻找食物。
raticatealola.flavorEn: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

raticatealolatotem.name: Raticate-Alola-Totem
raticatealolatotem.flavor: 它的后脚上长着 小蹼，以便它在 水中游泳寻找食物。
raticatealolatotem.flavorEn: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

rattata.name: Rattata
rattata.flavor: 有两颗大门牙，见什么咬什么。 只要看到１只小拉达出没， 附近肯定还住着40只以上。
rattata.flavorEn: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

rattataalola.name: Rattata-Alola
rattataalola.flavor: 有两颗大门牙，见什么咬什么。 只要看到１只小拉达出没， 附近肯定还住着40只以上。
rattataalola.flavorEn: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

rayquaza.name: Rayquaza
rayquaza.flavorEn: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

rayquazamega.name: Rayquaza-Mega
rayquazamega.flavorEn: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

regice.name: Regice
regice.flavor: 拥有一副由冰构成的身体。 据说是诞生于冰河时期 冻得厚厚实实的冰块之下。
regice.flavorEn: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.

regidrago.name: Regidrago
regidrago.flavor: 整个身体是龙之能量的 结晶。据说它拥有 所有龙宝可梦的能力。
regidrago.flavorEn: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

regieleki.name: Regieleki
regieleki.flavor: 整个身体是制造电能的 器官。可以制造出 伽勒尔全域所需的电力。
regieleki.flavorEn: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.

regigigas.name: Regigigas
regigigas.flavor: 据说它用各种各样的材料 制作了宝可梦后，把大陆 移动到了现在的位置。
regigigas.flavorEn: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

regirock.name: Regirock
regirock.flavor: 人们通过最新的科学技术 对它的岩石身体做了调查， 但是并未发现大脑和心脏。
regirock.flavorEn: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.

registeel.name: Registeel
registeel.flavor: 据说诞生于地幔之中， 在距今约１万年前 现身于地面之上。
registeel.flavorEn: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.

relicanth.name: Relicanth
relicanth.flavor: 在深海调查中被发现的宝可梦。 样子在１亿年间都没有任何变化， 被人们称为活化石。
relicanth.flavorEn: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.

rellor.name: Rellor
rellor.flavorEn: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

remoraid.name: Remoraid
remoraid.flavor: 会用变成吸盘状的背鳍 吸附在巨翅飞鱼身上， 让它分一点吃剩的东西给自己吃。
remoraid.flavorEn: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

reshiram.name: Reshiram
reshiram.flavor: 在神话的叙述里，如果人类 蔑视真实、放纵欲望，它就会 用火焰烧尽他们的王国。
reshiram.flavorEn: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

reuniclus.name: Reuniclus
reuniclus.flavor: 虽然有人说只要喝掉它特殊的液体 就能得到智慧，但对人造细胞卵 以外来说，那其实是剧毒。
reuniclus.flavorEn: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

revavroom.name: Revavroom
revavroom.flavorEn: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

rhydon.name: Rhydon
rhydon.flavor: 全身被铠甲般的皮肤保护着。 甚至能在２０００度的熔岩里生存。
rhydon.flavorEn: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

rhyhorn.name: Rhyhorn
rhyhorn.flavor: 脑子里只能记住一件事。 一旦开始猛冲，不管理由是什么 都会很快感到无所谓而忘掉。
rhyhorn.flavorEn: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

rhyperior.name: Rhyperior
rhyperior.flavor: 用护具弹开敌人的攻击， 在对手畏缩时用自己 引以为傲的钻头贯穿对方。
rhyperior.flavorEn: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

ribombee.name: Ribombee
ribombee.flavor: 最讨厌雨水弄湿自己。 因为伽勒尔地区阴天居多， 所以很难见得到它的身影。
ribombee.flavorEn: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

ribombeetotem.name: Ribombee-Totem
ribombeetotem.flavor: 最讨厌雨水弄湿自己。 因为伽勒尔地区阴天居多， 所以很难见得到它的身影。
ribombeetotem.flavorEn: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

rillaboom.name: Rillaboom
rillaboom.flavor: 打鼓技巧最高超的那一只 会成为首领。性情温和， 重视族群的和谐相处。
rillaboom.flavorEn: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

rillaboomgmax.name: Rillaboom-Gmax
rillaboomgmax.flavor: 打鼓技巧最高超的那一只 会成为首领。性情温和， 重视族群的和谐相处。
rillaboomgmax.flavorEn: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

riolu.name: Riolu
riolu.flavor: 除了能读懂对手的感情， 也能以“波导”这种形式的波 来观察大自然的样子。
riolu.flavorEn: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

roaringmoon.name: Roaring Moon
roaringmoon.flavorEn: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

rockruff.name: Rockruff
rockruff.flavor: 将脖子上的岩石向地面 发射，以此威吓对手。 在对方畏缩的刹那发起袭击。
rockruff.flavorEn: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

rockruffdusk.name: Rockruff-Dusk
rockruffdusk.flavor: 将脖子上的岩石向地面 发射，以此威吓对手。 在对方畏缩的刹那发起袭击。
rockruffdusk.flavorEn: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

roggenrola.name: Roggenrola
roggenrola.flavor: 会对声音产生反应而动起来。 在能量核心的影响下， 它摸起来暖暖的。
roggenrola.flavorEn: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

rolycoly.name: Rolycoly
rolycoly.flavor: 在满是岩石的崎岖之路上 也能像独轮车那样自在移动。 靠燃烧煤炭维持生命。
rolycoly.flavorEn: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

rookidee.name: Rookidee
rookidee.flavor: 娇小的体型让它能敏捷地飞翔。 利用攻其不备的战法将体型 巨大的对手玩弄于股掌之间。
rookidee.flavorEn: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

roselia.name: Roselia
roselia.flavor: 会用右手和左手分别放出 ２种不同的毒来进行攻击。 香气越浓越有精神。
roselia.flavorEn: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

roserade.name: Roserade
roserade.flavor: 右手的毒是速效的， 左手的毒则是慢性的。 无论哪边的毒性都能致命。
roserade.flavorEn: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

rotom.name: Rotom
rotom.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotom.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rotomfan.name: Rotom-Fan
rotomfan.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotomfan.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rotomfrost.name: Rotom-Frost
rotomfrost.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotomfrost.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rotomheat.name: Rotom-Heat
rotomheat.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotomheat.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rotommow.name: Rotom-Mow
rotommow.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotommow.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rotomwash.name: Rotom-Wash
rotomwash.flavor: 会用由离子构成的身体 潜入各种各样的机器里。 最喜欢恶作剧吓人。
rotomwash.flavorEn: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

rowlet.name: Rowlet
rowlet.flavor: 白天利用光合作用积蓄力量， 到了晚上则会悄无声息地 在空中飞翔，寻找猎物。
rowlet.flavorEn: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

rufflet.name: Rufflet
rufflet.flavor: 握力强，能把坚硬的树果 弄得粉碎。性急爱吵架， 无论对谁都会挑起战斗。
rufflet.flavorEn: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

runerigus.name: Runerigus
runerigus.flavor: 绝对不能触摸它影子般的 身体，否则它会让你看到 印刻在它画中的恐怖记忆。
runerigus.flavorEn: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
runerigus.evoCondition: Have 49+ HP lost and walk under stone sculpture in Dusty Bowl

sableye.name: Sableye
sableye.flavor: 会去吃宝石的结晶。 双眼在漆黑一片的地方 会发出宝石的光芒。
sableye.flavorEn: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

sableyemega.name: Sableye-Mega
sableyemega.flavor: 会去吃宝石的结晶。 双眼在漆黑一片的地方 会发出宝石的光芒。
sableyemega.flavorEn: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

salamence.name: Salamence
salamence.flavor: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它 乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒， 就会大闹一番，不可收拾。
salamence.flavorEn: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

salamencemega.name: Salamence-Mega
salamencemega.flavor: 虽然在空中翱翔能够让它 乐在其中，但是一旦被惹怒， 就会大闹一番，不可收拾。
salamencemega.flavorEn: While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.

salandit.name: Salandit
salandit.flavor: 悄悄地从背后靠近猎物， 在对方察觉之前释放毒气， 让对方动弹不得。
salandit.flavorEn: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

salazzle.name: Salazzle
salazzle.flavor: 据说焰后蜥之间在争斗时， 是通过比拼谁带着更多只 雄性夜盗火蜥来定胜负的。
salazzle.flavorEn: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

salazzletotem.name: Salazzle-Totem
salazzletotem.flavor: 据说焰后蜥之间在争斗时， 是通过比拼谁带着更多只 雄性夜盗火蜥来定胜负的。
salazzletotem.flavorEn: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

samurott.name: Samurott
samurott.flavorEn: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

samurotthisui.name: Samurott-Hisui
samurotthisui.flavorEn: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

sandaconda.name: Sandaconda
sandaconda.flavor: 它之所以会以独特的方式 盘绕自己的身体，是为了能 更高效地喷射砂囊中的沙子。
sandaconda.flavorEn: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

sandacondagmax.name: Sandaconda-Gmax
sandacondagmax.flavor: 它之所以会以独特的方式 盘绕自己的身体，是为了能 更高效地喷射砂囊中的沙子。
sandacondagmax.flavorEn: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

sandile.name: Sandile
sandile.flavor: 个头虽小，腰腿却很有力。 会拨开沙子，在沙漠里 犹如游泳般地自在移动。
sandile.flavorEn: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

sandshrew.name: Sandshrew
sandshrew.flavor: 会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。 挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石， 也能用尖锐的爪子弄碎后继续挖进。
sandshrew.flavorEn: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

sandshrewalola.name: Sandshrew-Alola
sandshrewalola.flavor: 会在地上挖洞建造巢穴。 挖洞时，即便遇到地里的坚硬岩石， 也能用尖锐的爪子弄碎后继续挖进。
sandshrewalola.flavorEn: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

sandslash.name: Sandslash
sandslash.flavor: 会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。 这是为了设法使树果掉落， 分给等在树下的穿山鼠们。
sandslash.flavorEn: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

sandslashalola.name: Sandslash-Alola
sandslashalola.flavor: 会将锐利的爪子钩在树上爬树。 这是为了设法使树果掉落， 分给等在树下的穿山鼠们。
sandslashalola.flavorEn: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

sandygast.name: Sandygast
sandygast.flavor: 主要栖息在沙滩上。 操纵把手伸进自己嘴里的 对手，从而让自己变得更大。
sandygast.flavorEn: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

sandyshocks.name: Sandy Shocks
sandyshocks.flavorEn: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

sawk.name: Sawk
sawk.flavor: 不断重复练习的打击鬼 所使出的空手劈拥有 足以劈开大海的破坏力。
sawk.flavorEn: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

sawsbuck.name: Sawsbuck
sawsbuck.flavorEn: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

scatterbug.name: Scatterbug
scatterbug.flavorEn: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

sceptile.name: Sceptile
sceptile.flavorEn: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

sceptilemega.name: Sceptile-Mega
sceptilemega.flavorEn: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

scizor.name: Scizor
scizor.flavor: 虽然身体纤细，却有着 惊人的攻击力。身体的 肌肉也是由金属构成的。
scizor.flavorEn: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

scizormega.name: Scizor-Mega
scizormega.flavor: 虽然身体纤细，却有着 惊人的攻击力。身体的 肌肉也是由金属构成的。
scizormega.flavorEn: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

scolipede.name: Scolipede
scolipede.flavor: 会和焚焰蚣激烈地争夺 领地。输掉的那一方 会成为另一方的猎物。
scolipede.flavorEn: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

scolipedemega.name: Scolipede-Mega
scolipedemega.flavor: 会和焚焰蚣激烈地争夺 领地。输掉的那一方 会成为另一方的猎物。
scolipedemega.flavorEn: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

scorbunny.name: Scorbunny
scorbunny.flavor: 一旦做好了战斗的准备， 它鼻头上和脚底的肉球 就会发出极度的高温。
scorbunny.flavorEn: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

scovillain.name: Scovillain
scovillain.flavorEn: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

scovillainmega.name: Scovillain-Mega
scovillainmega.flavorEn: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

scrafty.name: Scrafty
scrafty.flavor: 虽然性格非常粗鲁， 但也有重视家族、 伙伴和领地的另一面。
scrafty.flavorEn: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

scraftymega.name: Scrafty-Mega
scraftymega.flavor: 虽然性格非常粗鲁， 但也有重视家族、 伙伴和领地的另一面。
scraftymega.flavorEn: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

scraggy.name: Scraggy
scraggy.flavor: 用结实的皮保护身体。 据说在皮伸展到极限时， 它就会开始进化。
scraggy.flavorEn: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

screamtail.name: Scream Tail
screamtail.flavorEn: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

scyther.name: Scyther
scyther.flavor: 如果在森林中发现某个地方 有大量树木被砍倒，就说明 那里是飞天螳螂的领地。
scyther.flavorEn: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

seadra.name: Seadra
seadra.flavor: 嘴巴虽然细，吸引力却很强。 就算是比嘴巴还大的猎物， 也能一瞬间吸进嘴里吃掉。
seadra.flavorEn: Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.

seaking.name: Seaking
seaking.flavor: 金鱼王之所以会用角挖穿 河底的岩石来筑巢，是为了 防止产下的卵被水流冲走。
seaking.flavorEn: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

sealeo.name: Sealeo
sealeo.flavor: 不管是海豹球还是精灵球， 只要是圆的物体都会 顶在鼻子上转来转去。
sealeo.flavorEn: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

seedot.name: Seedot
seedot.flavor: 会将头顶粘在树枝上悬挂着。 也有被大风吹落的时候。
seedot.flavorEn: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.

seel.name: Seel
seel.flavor: 喜欢天寒地冻的地方， 就算零下10度 也能愉快地游泳。
seel.flavorEn: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

seismitoad.name: Seismitoad
seismitoad.flavor: 在老年人之间广受欢迎。 因为他们觉得它身上的瘤 发出的震动拿来按摩刚刚好。
seismitoad.flavorEn: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

sentret.name: Sentret
sentret.flavorEn: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

serperior.name: Serperior
serperior.flavorEn: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

servine.name: Servine
servine.flavorEn: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

seviper.name: Seviper
seviper.flavorEn: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.

sewaddle.name: Sewaddle
sewaddle.flavorEn: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

sharpedo.name: Sharpedo
sharpedo.flavor: 被称为大海恶霸。 进入它栖息海域的船只 会无一例外地遭到袭击。
sharpedo.flavorEn: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

sharpedomega.name: Sharpedo-Mega
sharpedomega.flavor: 被称为大海恶霸。 进入它栖息海域的船只 会无一例外地遭到袭击。
sharpedomega.flavorEn: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

shaymin.name: Shaymin
shaymin.flavorEn: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

shayminsky.name: Shaymin-Sky
shayminsky.flavorEn: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

shedinja.name: Shedinja
shedinja.flavor: 不拍动翅膀也能四处飞行。 身体里面空空的，是一种 不呼吸的奇妙宝可梦。
shedinja.flavorEn: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

shelgon.name: Shelgon
shelgon.flavor: 可以不吃食物忍受饥饿。 据说当它用尽积蓄的能量后， 就会开始进化。
shelgon.flavorEn: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.

shellder.name: Shellder
shellder.flavor: 坚硬的壳能反弹任何攻击。 壳打开时，如果里面的部分 受到攻击，就会变得很脆弱。
shellder.flavorEn: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

shellos.name: Shellos
shellos.flavor: 如果用力按住它， 它就会分泌出神秘的紫色液体。 虽然液体无害，不过黏糊糊的。
shellos.flavorEn: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

shelmet.name: Shelmet
shelmet.flavor: 有着会对电能产生反应 的奇异体质。不知为何， 和盖盖虫待在一起就会进化。
shelmet.flavorEn: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

shieldon.name: Shieldon
shieldon.flavor: 虽然从太古时代的地层中 发现了它的化石， 但尚未发现除了脸以外的部分。
shieldon.flavorEn: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

shiftry.name: Shiftry
shiftry.flavor: 在森林深处静静地生活。 据说当它扇动大大的团扇， 就会刮起冬日寒风。
shiftry.flavorEn: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

shiinotic.name: Shiinotic
shiinotic.flavor: 如果大半夜在森林的深处 看见光亮，记住千万不要接近。 灯罩夜菇会让你睡着的。
shiinotic.flavorEn: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

shinx.name: Shinx
shinx.flavor: 体毛通电后就会发光。 会摇晃明亮发光的尾巴 尖端来向伙伴发送信号。
shinx.flavorEn: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

shroodle.name: Shroodle
shroodle.flavorEn: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

shroomish.name: Shroomish
shroomish.flavorEn: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

shuckle.name: Shuckle
shuckle.flavor: 储存在壶形甲壳里的 树果会在不知不觉间 变成黏糊糊的果汁。
shuckle.flavorEn: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

shuppet.name: Shuppet
shuppet.flavor: 流传着这样的古老俗语， 日暮时分，不要去 排列着怨影娃娃的房子。
shuppet.flavorEn: There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”

sigilyph.name: Sigilyph
sigilyph.flavor: 人们在象征鸟飞过的沙漠 的地下调查，结果在那里 发现了疑似古代都市的遗迹。
sigilyph.flavorEn: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

silcoon.name: Silcoon
silcoon.flavorEn: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

silicobra.name: Silicobra
silicobra.flavor: 会从鼻孔喷射出沙子， 趁敌人看不清的时候 躲进地底下藏身。
silicobra.flavorEn: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

silvally.name: Silvally
silvally.flavor: 与所信赖的训练家之间的牵绊 是解放它真正力量的 最后一个要素。
silvally.flavorEn: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
