silvallywater.flavorEn: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

simipour.name: Simipour
simipour.flavorEn: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

simisage.name: Simisage
simisage.flavorEn: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

simisear.name: Simisear
simisear.flavorEn: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

sinistcha.name: Sinistcha
sinistcha.flavorEn: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

sinistchamasterpiece.name: Sinistcha-Masterpiece
sinistchamasterpiece.flavorEn: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

sinistea.name: Sinistea
sinistea.flavor: 被它当成住处的茶杯 是有名的古董餐具。 市面上有很多赝品。
sinistea.flavorEn: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

sinisteaantique.name: Sinistea-Antique
sinisteaantique.flavor: 被它当成住处的茶杯 是有名的古董餐具。 市面上有很多赝品。
sinisteaantique.flavorEn: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

sirfetchd.name: Sirfetch’d
sirfetchd.flavor: 会用坚硬的葱叶抵挡攻击， 接着用锋利的茎反击。 它的葱既是武器也是食材。
sirfetchd.flavorEn: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

sizzlipede.name: Sizzlipede
sizzlipede.flavor: 会用滚烫的身体勒紧猎物， 等到烤得恰到好处之时， 就把它们大口大口地吃掉。
sizzlipede.flavorEn: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

skarmory.name: Skarmory
skarmory.flavor: 由于它身上掉落下来的羽毛 可以用来制剑，因此作为纹章 的图案也很有人气。
skarmory.flavorEn: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

skarmorymega.name: Skarmory-Mega
skarmorymega.flavor: 由于它身上掉落下来的羽毛 可以用来制剑，因此作为纹章 的图案也很有人气。
skarmorymega.flavorEn: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

skeledirge.name: Skeledirge
skeledirge.flavorEn: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

skiddo.name: Skiddo
skiddo.flavorEn: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

skiploom.name: Skiploom
skiploom.flavorEn: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

skitty.name: Skitty
skitty.flavorEn: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.

skorupi.name: Skorupi
skorupi.flavor: 用尾巴上带毒的钩爪袭击对手。 一旦被夹住，毒素就会扩散开来， 导致全身无法动弹。
skorupi.flavorEn: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

skrelp.name: Skrelp
skrelp.flavor: 看上去很像腐烂的海藻， 因此会藏身于漂在海里的 碎藻中，骗过敌人的眼睛。
skrelp.flavorEn: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

skuntank.name: Skuntank
skuntank.flavor: 从尾巴尖端喷出的液体 带有强烈的恶臭。 会在地面上挖洞建造巢穴。
skuntank.flavorEn: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

skwovet.name: Skwovet
skwovet.flavor: 由于它无论何时都在吃树果， 使得它比外表看起来还要顽强。 会出现在田地里寻找树果。
skwovet.flavorEn: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

slaking.name: Slaking
slaking.flavorEn: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.

slakoth.name: Slakoth
slakoth.flavorEn: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

sliggoo.name: Sliggoo
sliggoo.flavor: 背上的突起物里装着它 小小的脑子，里面只想着 吃饭和逃离敌人这两件事。
sliggoo.flavorEn: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

sliggoohisui.name: Sliggoo-Hisui
sliggoohisui.flavor: 背上的突起物里装着它 小小的脑子，里面只想着 吃饭和逃离敌人这两件事。
sliggoohisui.flavorEn: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

slitherwing.name: Slither Wing
slitherwing.flavorEn: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

slowbro.name: Slowbro
slowbro.flavor: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它 变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝 离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。
slowbro.flavorEn: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

slowbrogalar.name: Slowbro-Galar
slowbrogalar.flavor: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它 变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝 离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。
slowbrogalar.flavorEn: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

slowbromega.name: Slowbro-Mega
slowbromega.flavor: 因为被大舌贝咬住而受到的刺激使它 变得能够两足直立行走。当大舌贝 离开后，它似乎就会变回呆呆兽。
slowbromega.flavorEn: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.

slowking.name: Slowking
slowking.flavor: 虽然无论向呆呆王提出 什么难题它都会帮忙解决， 但是谁都无法理解它的语言。
slowking.flavorEn: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

slowkinggalar.name: Slowking-Galar
slowkinggalar.flavor: 虽然无论向呆呆王提出 什么难题它都会帮忙解决， 但是谁都无法理解它的语言。
slowkinggalar.flavorEn: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.

slowpoke.name: Slowpoke
slowpoke.flavor: 把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出， 因此它会以尾巴为诱饵 吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。
slowpoke.flavorEn: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

slowpokegalar.name: Slowpoke-Galar
slowpokegalar.flavor: 把尾巴泡在水里后会有甜味渗出， 因此它会以尾巴为诱饵 吸引宝可梦并将其钓起。
slowpokegalar.flavorEn: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.

slugma.name: Slugma
slugma.flavorEn: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

slurpuff.name: Slurpuff
slurpuff.flavor: 因为体毛里富含空气， 所以摸起来十分柔软， 重量也比看起来要轻。
slurpuff.flavorEn: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

smeargle.name: Smeargle
smeargle.flavor: 会用尾巴前端渗出的体液画下标记。 对于有些标记，爱好者会以高价买卖。
smeargle.flavorEn: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

smoliv.name: Smoliv
smoliv.flavorEn: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

smoochum.name: Smoochum
smoochum.flavor: 好奇心旺盛的宝可梦。 不管是什么都会试着用 嘴唇去触碰，确认是否喜欢。
smoochum.flavorEn: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.

sneasel.name: Sneasel
sneasel.flavor: 狡黠凶恶的性格。 趁着双亲不在就侵入巢穴， 将蛋盗出。
sneasel.flavorEn: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

sneaselhisui.name: Sneasel-Hisui
sneaselhisui.flavor: 狡黠凶恶的性格。 趁着双亲不在就侵入巢穴， 将蛋盗出。
sneaselhisui.flavorEn: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

sneasler.name: Sneasler
sneasler.flavorEn: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

snivy.name: Snivy
snivy.flavorEn: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

snom.name: Snom
snom.flavor: 会吃地面上的积雪。 吃得越多，背上的 刺就会长得越挺拔。
snom.flavorEn: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.

snorlax.name: Snorlax
snorlax.flavor: 拥有一个结实的胃， 即使吃了发霉腐烂的东西， 也完全不会吃坏肚子。
snorlax.flavorEn: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

snorlaxgmax.name: Snorlax-Gmax
snorlaxgmax.flavor: 拥有一个结实的胃， 即使吃了发霉腐烂的东西， 也完全不会吃坏肚子。
snorlaxgmax.flavorEn: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

snorunt.name: Snorunt
snorunt.flavor: 只能在寒冷的土地上生存。 即使在零下１００度的环境下 也能充满活力地到处蹦蹦跳跳。
snorunt.flavorEn: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

snover.name: Snover
snover.flavor: 雪笠怪肚子上结出来的 口感好似冰棍的树果 是伽勒尔的火红不倒翁们的最爱。
snover.flavorEn: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

snubbull.name: Snubbull
snubbull.flavor: 它和看上去不同，其实很胆小。 所以如果把它和小狗宝可梦 放在一起，它就有可能会受到欺负。
snubbull.flavorEn: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

sobble.name: Sobble
sobble.flavor: 皮肤在湿掉时会变色， 仿佛像是隐身了一样， 谁都看不见它的身影。
sobble.flavorEn: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

solgaleo.name: Solgaleo
solgaleo.flavor: 曾经被称为 吞食太阳之兽。 能释放出无尽的光能。
solgaleo.flavorEn: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

solosis.name: Solosis
solosis.flavor: 身体被特殊的液体包裹着， 许多人因此认为它 即使在宇宙中也能存活。
solosis.flavorEn: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

solrock.name: Solrock
solrock.flavor: 太阳能量是其力量之源， 所以白天会很强。 旋转时身体会发光。
solrock.flavorEn: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

spearow.name: Spearow
spearow.flavor: 不擅长高空飞行。 会以超高速在地盘里四处盘旋， 以保护自己的地盘不被侵犯。
spearow.flavorEn: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

spectrier.name: Spectrier
spectrier.flavor: 在黑暗的夜晚中奔跑，吸取 正在睡觉的生物的生命能量。 喜欢孤独和静寂。
spectrier.flavorEn: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.

spewpa.name: Spewpa
spewpa.flavorEn: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

spheal.name: Spheal
spheal.flavor: 会漂浮在波浪当中观察 大海的状况。一旦发现猎物， 就会通知群体里的帝牙海狮。
spheal.flavorEn: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

spidops.name: Spidops
spidops.flavorEn: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

spinarak.name: Spinarak
spinarak.flavor: 牙齿上的毒并不强烈， 但用来削弱那些挂在网上 无法动弹的猎物是绰绰有余了。
spinarak.flavorEn: Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

spinda.name: Spinda
spinda.flavor: 每一只身上的斑点花纹都不同。 会用晃晃悠悠的动作 绝妙地躲避对手的攻击。
spinda.flavorEn: Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!

spiritomb.name: Spiritomb
spiritomb.flavor: 总是作恶多端， 于是被使用神奇法术的 旅人绑缚在楔石里。
spiritomb.flavorEn: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

spoink.name: Spoink
spoink.flavorEn: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

sprigatito.name: Sprigatito
sprigatito.flavorEn: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

spritzee.name: Spritzee
spritzee.flavor: 身上飘出的香气 能让人们神魂颠倒。 贵妇们对它钟爱万分。
spritzee.flavorEn: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

squawkabilly.name: Squawkabilly
squawkabilly.flavorEn: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

squawkabillyblue.name: Squawkabilly-Blue
squawkabillyblue.flavorEn: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

squawkabillywhite.name: Squawkabilly-White
squawkabillywhite.flavorEn: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

squawkabillyyellow.name: Squawkabilly-Yellow
squawkabillyyellow.flavorEn: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

squirtle.name: Squirtle
squirtle.flavor: 当它遇到危险的时候， 会将四肢收回龟壳里保护自己， 同时从嘴里喷出水来。
squirtle.flavorEn: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

stakataka.name: Stakataka
stakataka.flavor: 像是究极异兽的谜一般的生命体。 突然动起来并展开袭击的石墙， 正身就是这家伙。
stakataka.flavorEn: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

stantler.name: Stantler
stantler.flavorEn: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

staraptor.name: Staraptor
staraptor.flavorEn: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

staraptormega.name: Staraptor-Mega
staraptormega.flavorEn: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

staravia.name: Staravia
staravia.flavorEn: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

starly.name: Starly
starly.flavorEn: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

starmie.name: Starmie
starmie.flavor: 会高速旋转着身体 一边游泳一边吸收 微小的浮游生物。
starmie.flavorEn: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

starmiemega.name: Starmie-Mega
starmiemega.flavor: 会高速旋转着身体 一边游泳一边吸收 微小的浮游生物。
starmiemega.flavorEn: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

staryu.name: Staryu
staryu.flavor: 虽然会遭到鱼宝可梦的啄食， 但身体即使被咬掉一块也能 马上再生，所以完全不在意。
staryu.flavorEn: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

steelix.name: Steelix
steelix.flavor: 人们认为它的身体是因为 堆积了很多和泥土一起吞下的 铁元素，才会发生变化的。
steelix.flavorEn: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

steelixmega.name: Steelix-Mega
steelixmega.flavor: 人们认为它的身体是因为 堆积了很多和泥土一起吞下的 铁元素，才会发生变化的。
steelixmega.flavorEn: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

steenee.name: Steenee
steenee.flavor: 会用头部的壳盖击打 飞来啄食自己的蓝鸦， 并且对它使出猛烈的踢击。
steenee.flavorEn: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

stonjourner.name: Stonjourner
stonjourner.flavor: 每年会有一天，它们会在 特定的时间突然出现， 聚集在一起排成一个圈。
stonjourner.flavorEn: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

stoutland.name: Stoutland
stoutland.flavor: 以自己气派的胡须为傲。 据说，每只个体在族群中的地位， 就是根据胡须长度来决定的。
stoutland.flavorEn: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

stufful.name: Stufful
stufful.flavor: 为了保护自己的身体而 胡乱挥舞前脚的样子虽然可爱， 威力却大到能将大树折断。
stufful.flavorEn: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

stunfisk.name: Stunfisk
stunfisk.flavor: 当从身上的黄色斑纹 里释放出强大电流时， 它会莫名地露出微笑。
stunfisk.flavorEn: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

stunfiskgalar.name: Stunfisk-Galar
stunfiskgalar.flavor: 当从身上的黄色斑纹 里释放出强大电流时， 它会莫名地露出微笑。
stunfiskgalar.flavorEn: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

stunky.name: Stunky
stunky.flavor: 要是它翘起尾巴把屁股对准了你， 请一定要小心。因为这表示它将要 喷出足以让人窒息的臭液。
stunky.flavorEn: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

sudowoodo.name: Sudowoodo
sudowoodo.flavor: 为了不被袭击会模仿树的样子。 很讨厌水，所以下雨后， 不知什么时候就会消失。
sudowoodo.flavorEn: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

suicune.name: Suicune
suicune.flavorEn: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

sunflora.name: Sunflora
sunflora.flavorEn: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

sunkern.name: Sunkern
sunkern.flavorEn: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

surskit.name: Surskit
surskit.flavor: 栖息在水草丛生的池塘或沼泽里。 会经常和栖息地以及食物 都与自己相近的滴蛛争斗。
surskit.flavorEn: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.

swablu.name: Swablu
swablu.flavor: 看起来像是一团棉花云，因此 不易被敌人发现。据说翅膀是 随着世代演进逐渐变白的。
swablu.flavorEn: Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.

swadloon.name: Swadloon
swadloon.flavorEn: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

swalot.name: Swalot
swalot.flavorEn: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.

swampert.name: Swampert
swampert.flavorEn: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

swampertmega.name: Swampert-Mega
swampertmega.flavorEn: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

swanna.name: Swanna
swanna.flavorEn: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

swellow.name: Swellow
swellow.flavorEn: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.

swinub.name: Swinub
swinub.flavor: 嗅到诱人的香味时， 便会不顾一切地朝着 气味的方向飞奔过去。
swinub.flavorEn: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

swirlix.name: Swirlix
swirlix.flavor: 蓬松的体毛闻起来 就像棉花糖一样甜甜的。 会放出黏糊糊的丝缠住敌人。
swirlix.flavorEn: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

swoobat.name: Swoobat
swoobat.flavor: 据说有些地区的人觉得 它鼻子的形状很吉利， 而把它当成幸福的象征来祭拜。
swoobat.flavorEn: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

sylveon.name: Sylveon
sylveon.flavor: 伽勒尔地区的童话中有着 美丽的仙子伊布击退了 可怕的龙宝可梦的故事。
sylveon.flavorEn: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
sylveon.evoCondition: with a Fairy-type move and two levels of Affection

tadbulb.name: Tadbulb
tadbulb.flavorEn: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

taillow.name: Taillow
taillow.flavorEn: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.

talonflame.name: Talonflame
talonflame.flavor: 会以５００公里的时速进行突击。 不给猎物留下逃跑的机会， 直接以猛烈的踢击将其解决。
talonflame.flavorEn: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

tandemaus.name: Tandemaus
tandemaus.flavorEn: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

tangela.name: Tangela
tangela.flavor: 藤蔓有着独特的香气。 在伽勒尔的部分地区 被当做香草使用。
tangela.flavorEn: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

tangrowth.name: Tangrowth
tangrowth.flavor: 栖息的地域越是温暖，藤蔓 生长得就越快。藤蔓变长后， 它会亲手将其扯断使其变短。
tangrowth.flavorEn: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

tapubulu.name: Tapu Bulu
tapubulu.flavor: 会鸣响尾巴，告知自己的居所， 以避免不必要的战争。 是操纵草木的乌拉乌拉的守护神。
tapubulu.flavorEn: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

tapufini.name: Tapu Fini
tapufini.flavor: 被称为守护神，但有时会给 随便靠近的对方带去恐怖的灾难。
tapufini.flavorEn: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

tapukoko.name: Tapu Koko
tapukoko.flavor: 操纵雷的美乐美乐的守护神。 好奇心旺盛， 会时不时在人们面前现身。
tapukoko.flavorEn: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

tapulele.name: Tapu Lele
tapulele.flavor: 被称为守护神，却兼有 天真无邪与残酷的性格， 被誉为自然的化身。
tapulele.flavorEn: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

tarountula.name: Tarountula
tarountula.flavorEn: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

tatsugiri.name: Tatsugiri
tatsugiri.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tatsugiricurlymega.name: Tatsugiri-Curly-Mega
tatsugiricurlymega.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tatsugiridroopy.name: Tatsugiri-Droopy
tatsugiridroopy.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tatsugiridroopymega.name: Tatsugiri-Droopy-Mega
tatsugiridroopymega.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tatsugiristretchy.name: Tatsugiri-Stretchy
tatsugiristretchy.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tatsugiristretchymega.name: Tatsugiri-Stretchy-Mega
tatsugiristretchymega.flavorEn: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

tauros.name: Tauros
tauros.flavor: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗 性格暴躁，决不允许 人类骑在自己的背上。
tauros.flavorEn: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

taurospaldeaaqua.name: Tauros-Paldea-Aqua
taurospaldeaaqua.flavor: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗 性格暴躁，决不允许 人类骑在自己的背上。
taurospaldeaaqua.flavorEn: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

taurospaldeablaze.name: Tauros-Paldea-Blaze
taurospaldeablaze.flavor: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗 性格暴躁，决不允许 人类骑在自己的背上。
taurospaldeablaze.flavorEn: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

taurospaldeacombat.name: Tauros-Paldea-Combat
taurospaldeacombat.flavor: 栖息在伽勒尔的肯泰罗 性格暴躁，决不允许 人类骑在自己的背上。
taurospaldeacombat.flavorEn: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

teddiursa.name: Teddiursa
teddiursa.flavorEn: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

tentacool.name: Tentacool
tentacool.flavor: 身体的大部分由水组成。 在海中，会和海水混为一体， 非常难以发现。
tentacool.flavorEn: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

tentacruel.name: Tentacruel
tentacruel.flavor: ８０根触手伸缩自如。 会像撒网那样伸开触手 抓住猎物并刺入毒针。
tentacruel.flavorEn: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

tepig.name: Tepig
tepig.flavorEn: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

terapagos.name: Terapagos
terapagos.flavorEn: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

terapagosstellar.name: Terapagos-Stellar
terapagosstellar.flavorEn: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

terapagosterastal.name: Terapagos-Terastal
terapagosterastal.flavorEn: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

terrakion.name: Terrakion
terrakion.flavor: 代拉基翁为保护宝可梦 而与人类作战的传说 在合众地区广为流传。
terrakion.flavorEn: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

thievul.name: Thievul
thievul.flavor: 靠着轻盈的身体和锐利的 爪子到处去偷食物和蛋。 逐电犬是它的天敌。
thievul.flavorEn: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

throh.name: Throh
throh.flavor: ５只一组一起努力练习。 在练习中掉队的投摔鬼 会扔掉带子离开团队。
throh.flavorEn: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

thundurus.name: Thundurus
thundurus.flavorEn: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

thundurustherian.name: Thundurus-Therian
thundurustherian.flavorEn: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

thwackey.name: Thwackey
thwackey.flavor: 打着激烈的节拍战斗时， 由于过于忘我，甚至不会 意识到自己已经把对手打昏了。
thwackey.flavorEn: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

timburr.name: Timburr
timburr.flavor: 如果搬运小匠可以搬起 自己体重３倍左右的方材， 就代表它进化的日子要到了。
timburr.flavorEn: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

tinglu.name: Ting-Lu
tinglu.flavorEn: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

tinkatink.name: Tinkatink
tinkatink.flavorEn: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

tinkaton.name: Tinkaton
tinkaton.flavorEn: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

tinkatuff.name: Tinkatuff
tinkatuff.flavorEn: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

tirtouga.name: Tirtouga
tirtouga.flavor: 由化石复活的宝可梦。 人们认为它是很多 龟宝可梦的祖先。
tirtouga.flavorEn: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

toedscool.name: Toedscool
toedscool.flavorEn: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

toedscruel.name: Toedscruel
toedscruel.flavorEn: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

togedemaru.name: Togedemaru
togedemaru.flavor: 在危急时刻会把身体卷成一团， 倒竖起背上的尖刺， 不分青红皂白地发出电击。
togedemaru.flavorEn: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

togedemarutotem.name: Togedemaru-Totem
togedemarutotem.flavor: 在危急时刻会把身体卷成一团， 倒竖起背上的尖刺， 不分青红皂白地发出电击。
togedemarutotem.flavorEn: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

togekiss.name: Togekiss
togekiss.flavor: 被称为会带来恩惠的宝可梦， 从很久很久以前开始， 人们就视它为吉祥之物。
togekiss.flavorEn: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

togepi.name: Togepi
togepi.flavor: 好运的象征。 据说在它的壳里 装着满满的幸福。
togepi.flavorEn: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

togetic.name: Togetic
togetic.flavor: 不待在温柔的人身边 就会变得没有精神。 不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。
togetic.flavorEn: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

torchic.name: Torchic
torchic.flavorEn: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

torkoal.name: Torkoal
torkoal.flavor: 在弃用的煤矿中 住着很多煤炭龟， 它们会不停地挖掘煤炭。
torkoal.flavorEn: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

tornadus.name: Tornadus
tornadus.flavorEn: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

tornadustherian.name: Tornadus-Therian
tornadustherian.flavorEn: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

torracat.name: Torracat
torracat.flavor: 如果敌人实力强劲， 它便会更有战斗的欲望， 火焰铃铛的火力也会随之上升。
torracat.flavorEn: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

torterra.name: Torterra
torterra.flavorEn: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

totodile.name: Totodile
totodile.flavorEn: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

toucannon.name: Toucannon
toucannon.flavor: 因成双成对感情和睦而闻名。 它被视为一种吉祥的象征， 常被带到结婚仪式去。
toucannon.flavorEn: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

toxapex.name: Toxapex
toxapex.flavor: 体内的毒囊中储存着 满满的剧毒，毒性强到 能让吼鲸王都痛苦三天三夜。
toxapex.flavorEn: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

toxel.name: Toxel
toxel.flavor: 通过让自身的毒素产生 化学反应来发电。电力 虽然弱，却能造成麻痹。
toxel.flavorEn: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

toxicroak.name: Toxicroak
toxicroak.flavor: 制服了猎物之后， 便会呱呱地发出胜利的欢呼。 与蟾蜍王是相近的物种。
toxicroak.flavorEn: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

toxtricity.name: Toxtricity
toxtricity.flavor: 气势汹汹的急性子。 会大口喝下浑浊的水， 吸收其中所含的毒素。
toxtricity.flavorEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

toxtricitygmax.name: Toxtricity-Gmax
toxtricitygmax.flavor: 气势汹汹的急性子。 会大口喝下浑浊的水， 吸收其中所含的毒素。
toxtricitygmax.flavorEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

toxtricitylowkey.name: Toxtricity-Low-Key
toxtricitylowkey.flavor: 气势汹汹的急性子。 会大口喝下浑浊的水， 吸收其中所含的毒素。
toxtricitylowkey.flavorEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

toxtricitylowkeygmax.name: Toxtricity-Low-Key-Gmax
toxtricitylowkeygmax.flavor: 气势汹汹的急性子。 会大口喝下浑浊的水， 吸收其中所含的毒素。
toxtricitylowkeygmax.flavorEn: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

tranquill.name: Tranquill
tranquill.flavor: 头脑聪明而且记性很好。 似乎有许多快递员 将它选为自己的搭档。
tranquill.flavorEn: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

trapinch.name: Trapinch
trapinch.flavor: 建造了绝对无法逃脱的 捣蒜钵状巢穴，并在巢穴里 等着猎物自己掉进来。
trapinch.flavorEn: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

treecko.name: Treecko
treecko.flavorEn: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

trevenant.name: Trevenant
trevenant.flavor: 脚尖伸出来的根须 能连结森林中的树木， 并且自由自在地加以操纵。
trevenant.flavorEn: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

tropius.name: Tropius
tropius.flavor: 脖子上的那串水果很美味， 很受欢迎。在温暖的地方， 有许多培育热带龙的牧场。
tropius.flavorEn: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

trubbish.name: Trubbish
trubbish.flavor: 诞生于塞满垃圾的垃圾袋里。 它嘴里喷出的毒气 是伽勒尔双弹瓦斯的最爱。
trubbish.flavorEn: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

trumbeak.name: Trumbeak
trumbeak.flavor: 会将吃掉的树果种子从 口中射出。种子散落在大地上， 新的草木便会生长出来。
trumbeak.flavorEn: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

tsareena.name: Tsareena
tsareena.flavor: 用又尖又硬的脚尖施展脚踢， 朝对手的身体和心灵 留下无法磨灭的创伤。
tsareena.flavorEn: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

turtonator.name: Turtonator
turtonator.flavor: 在火山上生活，吃下的硫磺 就是甲壳上炸药的原料。 连粪便也会爆炸，十分危险。
turtonator.flavorEn: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

turtwig.name: Turtwig
turtwig.flavorEn: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

tympole.name: Tympole
tympole.flavor: 通过音波来联系伙伴。 人类和其他宝可梦都 听不见它发出的警告声。
tympole.flavorEn: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

tynamo.name: Tynamo
tynamo.flavorEn: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

typenull.name: Type: Null
typenull.flavor: 以神话中的宝可梦为原型所 创造出的宝可梦，被戴上了 抑制力量失控的面罩。
typenull.flavorEn: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

typhlosion.name: Typhlosion
typhlosion.flavorEn: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

typhlosionhisui.name: Typhlosion-Hisui
typhlosionhisui.flavorEn: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

tyranitar.name: Tyranitar
tyranitar.flavor: 当它带着巨大轰鸣声迈开脚步， 就连大山都会为之崩裂， 周围的地形也会因此改变。
tyranitar.flavorEn: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

tyranitarmega.name: Tyranitar-Mega
tyranitarmega.flavor: 当它带着巨大轰鸣声迈开脚步， 就连大山都会为之崩裂， 周围的地形也会因此改变。
tyranitarmega.flavorEn: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

tyrantrum.name: Tyrantrum
tyrantrum.flavor: 如果被它的大颚咬到， 连汽车都会变得粉碎。 是古代世界的王者。
tyrantrum.flavorEn: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

tyrogue.name: Tyrogue
tyrogue.flavor: 体型偏小却不可轻视， 因为它只要发现合适的对手 便会马上扑上去大打出手。
tyrogue.flavorEn: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

tyrunt.name: Tyrunt
tyrunt.flavor: 又任性又爱撒娇。 即使它只是闹着玩， 也会让训练家受重伤。
tyrunt.flavorEn: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

umbreon.name: Umbreon
umbreon.flavor: 在满月之夜或是兴奋的时候， 它身上圈圈一样的花纹 就会发出金黄色的光。
umbreon.flavorEn: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

unfezant.name: Unfezant
unfezant.flavor: 头脑聪明，所以自尊心也强。 如果能成为高傲雉鸡的训练家， 所有人都会对你刮目相看。
unfezant.flavorEn: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

unown.name: Unown
unown.flavorEn: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

ursaluna.name: Ursaluna
ursaluna.flavorEn: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
ursaluna.evoCondition: Peat Block when there's a full moon

ursalunabloodmoon.name: Ursaluna-Bloodmoon
ursalunabloodmoon.flavorEn: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

ursaring.name: Ursaring
ursaring.flavorEn: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

urshifu.name: Urshifu
urshifu.flavor: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。 通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑 来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
urshifu.flavorEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

urshifugmax.name: Urshifu-Gmax
urshifugmax.flavor: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。 通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑 来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
urshifugmax.flavorEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

urshifurapidstrike.name: Urshifu-Rapid-Strike
urshifurapidstrike.flavor: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。 通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑 来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
urshifurapidstrike.flavorEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

urshifurapidstrikegmax.name: Urshifu-Rapid-Strike-Gmax
urshifurapidstrikegmax.flavor: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。 通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑 来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。
urshifurapidstrikegmax.flavorEn: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.

uxie.name: Uxie
uxie.flavorEn: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

vanillish.name: Vanillish
vanillish.flavor: 性格和善，虽然会用 零下１００度的冷气冻住敌人， 但并不会伤及它们的性命。
vanillish.flavorEn: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

vanillite.name: Vanillite
vanillite.flavor: 据说它是从冰柱中诞生的。 为了能让自己生活得更舒适， 会吐出零下５０度的冷气冻住四周。
vanillite.flavorEn: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

vanilluxe.name: Vanilluxe
vanilluxe.flavor: 体温在零下６度左右。 据说是由２只多多冰 贴在一起而诞生的。
vanilluxe.flavorEn: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

vaporeon.name: Vaporeon
vaporeon.flavor: 身体细胞的结构与水分子相似。 它能和水融为一体， 让别人无法看见它。
vaporeon.flavorEn: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

varoom.name: Varoom
varoom.flavorEn: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

veluza.name: Veluza
veluza.flavorEn: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

venipede.name: Venipede
venipede.flavor: 牙齿上有剧毒。一旦 发现看上去能吃的猎物， 就会不假思索地扑上去。
venipede.flavorEn: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

venomoth.name: Venomoth
venomoth.flavor: 如果不小心把它翅膀上的鳞粉 沾到了身上，那不但会很难去除， 更糟的是毒素也会从那里渗入。
venomoth.flavorEn: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

venonat.name: Venonat
venonat.flavor: 在明亮的地方你便能发现它 具有雷达功能的大眼其实是 由许多个小眼睛聚集而成的。
venonat.flavorEn: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

venusaur.name: Venusaur
venusaur.flavor: 花朵散发出的迷人香味 能安抚激动的心情， 甚至消弭斗争。
venusaur.flavorEn: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

venusaurgmax.name: Venusaur-Gmax
venusaurgmax.flavor: 花朵散发出的迷人香味 能安抚激动的心情， 甚至消弭斗争。
venusaurgmax.flavorEn: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

venusaurmega.name: Venusaur-Mega
venusaurmega.flavor: 花朵散发出的迷人香味 能安抚激动的心情， 甚至消弭斗争。
venusaurmega.flavorEn: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

vespiquen.name: Vespiquen
vespiquen.flavor: 能释放越多费洛蒙的蜂女王， 就能让越多的三蜜蜂 听从自己的指挥。
vespiquen.flavorEn: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

vibrava.name: Vibrava
vibrava.flavor: 为了让翅膀成长， 每天要用消化液溶化 并吸食大量的猎物。
vibrava.flavorEn: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

victini.name: Victini
victini.flavorEn: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

victreebel.name: Victreebel
victreebel.flavor: 用花蜜的香味引诱猎物。 据说被它吞入嘴里的东西， 只要1天就会溶解到连骨头都不剩。
victreebel.flavorEn: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

victreebelmega.name: Victreebel-Mega
victreebelmega.flavor: 用花蜜的香味引诱猎物。 据说被它吞入嘴里的东西， 只要1天就会溶解到连骨头都不剩。
victreebelmega.flavorEn: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

vigoroth.name: Vigoroth
vigoroth.flavorEn: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.

vikavolt.name: Vikavolt
vikavolt.flavor: 如果它在飞翔时把虫电宝抱住 当作备用电池，就能连续发射 电力超高的电磁光束。
vikavolt.flavorEn: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

vikavolttotem.name: Vikavolt-Totem
vikavolttotem.flavor: 如果它在飞翔时把虫电宝抱住 当作备用电池，就能连续发射 电力超高的电磁光束。
vikavolttotem.flavorEn: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

vileplume.name: Vileplume
vileplume.flavor: 虽然花瓣越大， 就能放出越多的花粉， 但这样脑袋会变沉，容易疲倦。
vileplume.flavorEn: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

virizion.name: Virizion
virizion.flavor: 以敏捷的身手像旋风一般将敌人 玩弄于股掌之中，会用锋利的角 毫不留情地切斩对手。
virizion.flavorEn: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

vivillon.name: Vivillon
vivillon.flavorEn: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

vivillonfancy.name: Vivillon-Fancy
vivillonfancy.flavorEn: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

vivillonpokeball.name: Vivillon-Pokeball
vivillonpokeball.flavorEn: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

volbeat.name: Volbeat
volbeat.flavorEn: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

volcanion.name: Volcanion
volcanion.flavorEn: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

volcarona.name: Volcarona
volcarona.flavor: 从熊熊燃烧的火焰之茧中 诞生。在古代的壁画上 被描绘为火之神。
volcarona.flavorEn: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

voltorb.name: Voltorb
voltorb.flavor: 据说它与精灵球相似的外形 其实是它的保护色，但它 很容易自爆这一点也出人意料。
voltorb.flavorEn: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

voltorbhisui.name: Voltorb-Hisui
voltorbhisui.flavor: 据说它与精灵球相似的外形 其实是它的保护色，但它 很容易自爆这一点也出人意料。
voltorbhisui.flavorEn: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

vullaby.name: Vullaby
vullaby.flavor: 由于很快就会长大， 屁股上的骸骨会接着传给 巢里更小的秃鹰丫头用。
vullaby.flavorEn: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

vulpix.name: Vulpix
vulpix.flavor: 随着身体的成长， ６根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。 紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖。
vulpix.flavorEn: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

vulpixalola.name: Vulpix-Alola
vulpixalola.flavor: 随着身体的成长， ６根尾巴的毛发也会变得更漂亮。 紧紧抱着它时能感到微微的温暖。
vulpixalola.flavorEn: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

wailmer.name: Wailmer
wailmer.flavor: 喝入大量的海水之后， 身体会鼓成像球一样。 每天要吃掉１吨的食物。
wailmer.flavorEn: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

wailord.name: Wailord
wailord.flavor: 总之，因为超级巨大而受欢迎。 观看吼鲸王在各地都是 非常受欢迎的游览项目。
wailord.flavorEn: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.

walkingwake.name: Walking Wake
walkingwake.flavorEn: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

walrein.name: Walrein
walrein.flavor: 它的獠牙一生都会持续生长。 即使在战斗中被折断也能逐渐恢复， 只需要１年的时间便能完好如初。
walrein.flavorEn: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

wartortle.name: Wartortle
wartortle.flavor: 会灵巧地摆动自己 毛茸茸的耳朵和尾巴， 借此在水中保持平衡。
wartortle.flavorEn: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

watchog.name: Watchog
watchog.flavorEn: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

wattrel.name: Wattrel
wattrel.flavorEn: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

weavile.name: Weavile
weavile.flavor: 通过用爪子留下记号 来与伙伴联络。据说记号 的种类有５００种以上。
weavile.flavorEn: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

weedle.name: Weedle
weedle.flavor: 头上长有尖锐的针。 它喜欢藏在森林或 草丛里大量吞食树叶。
weedle.flavorEn: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

weepinbell.name: Weepinbell
weepinbell.flavor: 它在肚子饿的时候会 吞掉周围会动的东西， 分泌溶解液让其致命。
weepinbell.flavorEn: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

weezing.name: Weezing
weezing.flavor: 虽然吸入空气的力量 稍弱于伽勒尔的双弹瓦斯， 制造出的毒素却更加强力。
weezing.flavorEn: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

weezinggalar.name: Weezing-Galar
weezinggalar.flavor: 虽然吸入空气的力量 稍弱于伽勒尔的双弹瓦斯， 制造出的毒素却更加强力。
weezinggalar.flavorEn: It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.

whimsicott.name: Whimsicott
whimsicott.flavor: 每当沐浴阳光，身上的棉花 就会膨胀。如果膨胀过了头， 它就会把棉花扯开到处乱撒。
whimsicott.flavorEn: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

whirlipede.name: Whirlipede
whirlipede.flavor: 用坚硬的壳和带毒的刺 保护自己的身体， 积蓄进化所需的能量。
whirlipede.flavorEn: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

whiscash.name: Whiscash
whiscash.flavor: 会将大沼泽划为自己的领地。 如果有敌人接近的话，它就会狂暴起来， 并引发大地震。
whiscash.flavorEn: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

whismur.name: Whismur
whismur.flavor: 一旦开始喊叫，就会被自己的声音 惊吓到，然后以更大的声音 大吼大叫起来。叫累了以后就会睡着，
whismur.flavorEn: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.

wigglytuff.name: Wigglytuff
wigglytuff.flavor: 以自己细腻的体毛为傲。 尤其是额头上的卷毛， 更是有着天堂般的极致触感。
wigglytuff.flavorEn: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.

wiglett.name: Wiglett
wiglett.flavorEn: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

wimpod.name: Wimpod
wimpod.flavor: 成群聚集，随时提高警惕。 只要察觉到有敌人， 就会分散开来四处逃窜。
wimpod.flavorEn: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

wingull.name: Wingull
wingull.flavor: 利用气流， 不拍打翅膀就能飞上天空。 会在海边的岩壁上筑巢。
wingull.flavorEn: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

wishiwashi.name: Wishiwashi
wishiwashi.flavor: 感觉到危险时眼睛就会变得湿润。 眼泪的光亮会成为召集伙伴的信号， 让许多的弱丁鱼聚在一起。
wishiwashi.flavorEn: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

wishiwashischool.name: Wishiwashi-School
wishiwashischool.flavor: 感觉到危险时眼睛就会变得湿润。 眼泪的光亮会成为召集伙伴的信号， 让许多的弱丁鱼聚在一起。
wishiwashischool.flavorEn: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

wobbuffet.name: Wobbuffet
wobbuffet.flavor: 为了隐藏漆黑的尾巴 而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。 不会主动发起攻击。
wobbuffet.flavorEn: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

wochien.name: Wo-Chien
wochien.flavorEn: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

woobat.name: Woobat
woobat.flavor: 一边发出超音波，一边 飞来飞去寻找虫宝可梦 来填饱自己的肚子。
woobat.flavorEn: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

wooloo.name: Wooloo
wooloo.flavor: 要是身上的毛长得太长就会 不能动弹。用毛辫羊的体毛 织成的布结实得让人吃惊。
wooloo.flavorEn: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

wooper.name: Wooper
wooper.flavor: 为了在地面上行走时 不让皮肤干燥，会用 有毒的粘膜覆盖身体。
wooper.flavorEn: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

wooperpaldea.name: Wooper-Paldea
wooperpaldea.flavor: 为了在地面上行走时 不让皮肤干燥，会用 有毒的粘膜覆盖身体。
wooperpaldea.flavorEn: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

wormadam.name: Wormadam
wormadam.flavorEn: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

wormadamsandy.name: Wormadam-Sandy
wormadamsandy.flavorEn: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

wormadamtrash.name: Wormadam-Trash
wormadamtrash.flavorEn: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

wugtrio.name: Wugtrio
wugtrio.flavorEn: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

wurmple.name: Wurmple
wurmple.flavorEn: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

wynaut.name: Wynaut
wynaut.flavor: 具有集体行动的习性。 睡觉的时候会聚集在洞窟中， 和伙伴们把身体挨在一起。
wynaut.flavorEn: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

wyrdeer.name: Wyrdeer
wyrdeer.flavorEn: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
wyrdeer.evoCondition: Use Agile style Psyshield Bash 20 times

xatu.name: Xatu
xatu.flavor: 能够看穿过去和未来。 日复一日注视着太阳 动向的奇异宝可梦。
xatu.flavorEn: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

xerneas.name: Xerneas
xerneas.flavorEn: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

xerneasneutral.name: Xerneas-Neutral
xerneasneutral.flavorEn: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

xurkitree.name: Xurkitree
xurkitree.flavor: 被称为究极异兽。 也有像树木一样将手脚 插入地面后一动不动的。
xurkitree.flavorEn: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

yamask.name: Yamask
yamask.flavor: 古代人的灵魂变成了宝可梦。 为了寻找认得自己长相的人 而在遗迹里徘徊。
yamask.flavorEn: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

yamaskgalar.name: Yamask-Galar
yamaskgalar.flavor: 古代人的灵魂变成了宝可梦。 为了寻找认得自己长相的人 而在遗迹里徘徊。
yamaskgalar.flavorEn: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

yamper.name: Yamper
yamper.flavor: 因为想要得到零食而 帮助人类工作的贪吃鬼。 总是带着电火花跑来跑去。
yamper.flavorEn: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

yanma.name: Yanma
yanma.flavorEn: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

yanmega.name: Yanmega
yanmega.flavorEn: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

yungoos.name: Yungoos
yungoos.flavor: 什么都吃，但喜欢吃新鲜的活物。 所以会为了寻找猎物在路上四处游走。
yungoos.flavorEn: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

yveltal.name: Yveltal
yveltal.flavorEn: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

zacian.name: Zacian
zacian.flavor: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的 藏玛然特的姐姐，也有人 认为它们之间是劲敌关系。
zacian.flavorEn: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

zaciancrowned.name: Zacian-Crowned
zaciancrowned.flavor: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的 藏玛然特的姐姐，也有人 认为它们之间是劲敌关系。
zaciancrowned.flavorEn: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

zamazenta.name: Zamazenta
zamazenta.flavor: 以石像般的姿态陷入 长久沉眠的宝可梦。 几乎就要被人们所遗忘。
zamazenta.flavorEn: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

zamazentacrowned.name: Zamazenta-Crowned
zamazentacrowned.flavor: 以石像般的姿态陷入 长久沉眠的宝可梦。 几乎就要被人们所遗忘。
zamazentacrowned.flavorEn: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

zangoose.name: Zangoose
zangoose.flavorEn: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.

zapdos.name: Zapdos
zapdos.flavor: 传说的鸟宝可梦。 据说只要它一摩擦翅膀， 就会立刻发生落雷。
zapdos.flavorEn: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

zapdosgalar.name: Zapdos-Galar
zapdosgalar.flavor: 传说的鸟宝可梦。 据说只要它一摩擦翅膀， 就会立刻发生落雷。
zapdosgalar.flavorEn: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

zarude.name: Zarude
zarude.flavor: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后 会变成土壤的养分， 帮助森林中的植物成长。
zarude.flavorEn: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

zarudedada.name: Zarude-Dada
zarudedada.flavor: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后 会变成土壤的养分， 帮助森林中的植物成长。
zarudedada.flavorEn: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

zebstrika.name: Zebstrika
zebstrika.flavorEn: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

zekrom.name: Zekrom
zekrom.flavor: 在神话的描述里，如果人类 失去了正义之心，它就会用 狂暴的雷电毁灭他们的王国。
zekrom.flavorEn: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

zeraora.name: Zeraora
zeraora.flavor: 从手脚的肉球放电。 当捷拉奥拉奔驰而过时， 周围将充斥着电闪雷鸣，
zeraora.flavorEn: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

zeraoramega.name: Zeraora-Mega
zeraoramega.flavor: 从手脚的肉球放电。 当捷拉奥拉奔驰而过时， 周围将充斥着电闪雷鸣，
zeraoramega.flavorEn: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

zigzagoon.name: Zigzagoon
zigzagoon.flavor: 伽勒尔的蛇纹熊适应了 其他地区环境后的样子。 十分擅长找东西。
zigzagoon.flavorEn: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

zigzagoongalar.name: Zigzagoon-Galar
zigzagoongalar.flavor: 伽勒尔的蛇纹熊适应了 其他地区环境后的样子。 十分擅长找东西。
zigzagoongalar.flavorEn: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.

zoroark.name: Zoroark
zoroark.flavor: 孤独的训练家会命令 索罗亚克为自己展现幻像， 借以排遣孤身一人的寂寞。
zoroark.flavorEn: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

zoroarkhisui.name: Zoroark-Hisui
zoroarkhisui.flavor: 孤独的训练家会命令 索罗亚克为自己展现幻像， 借以排遣孤身一人的寂寞。
zoroarkhisui.flavorEn: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

zorua.name: Zorua
zorua.flavor: 为了寻找食物，有时甚至会 幻化成人类出现在城镇里。 多数情况下会幻化成小孩。
zorua.flavorEn: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

zoruahisui.name: Zorua-Hisui
zoruahisui.flavor: 为了寻找食物，有时甚至会 幻化成人类出现在城镇里。 多数情况下会幻化成小孩。
zoruahisui.flavorEn: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

zubat.name: Zubat
zubat.flavor: 栖息在晒不到阳光的洞窟里。 到了早晨便会和同伴聚集起来， 一边互相取暖一边睡觉。
zubat.flavorEn: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

zweilous.name: Zweilous
zweilous.flavor: ２个头会争抢同一个食物。 明明没有去和别人战斗， 却总是遍体鳞伤。
zweilous.flavorEn: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

zygarde.name: Zygarde
zygarde.flavor: 据说，在与威胁到生态系统者战斗时， 它会变化为更强大的样子。
zygarde.flavorEn: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
